name: Matt B
text: It was OK. The staff was really friendly. With so many BBQ the price for the pulled pork sandwich was the same as most BBQ places. The flavor was OK nothing special.

name: Mike Shaw
text: Great food. Ribs are out of this world. Potato salad is outstanding. Friendly owners who care about the quality of their food and service. I have visited many times and will continue doing so.

name: Sarah Shulman Lantz
text: The quality of the meat is great. The pulled pork and brisket were cooked perfectly. The sauce wasn't my cup of tea.

name: Christopher Moore
text:
Ordered online for a large order via Door Dash, about 24 hours in advance of an imminent party.  I was informed less than an hour before the party that they wouldn't be fulfilling my order.  I didn't get the message until after the time the order was supposed to be delivered.  Incredibly poor customer service.  This is what they wrote:
"This email is to confirm your order has been cancelled and the order total has been fully refunded.  Please note this refund can take between 3-5 business days to complete, depending on your bank’s processing times. Feel free to contact us if there’s anything else we can help with."  Very very aggravating.

name: Jasmin Hollywood
text: Anne-Marie was very kind welcoming and attentive to catering me. I had the Jamaican Salmon filet with mango salsa and side of bbq baked beans and it was delicious! Thank you so much. I will be back to try the rest of the menu.

name: Joseph LaCava
text: Brisket is amazing, I'm a tough critic for the pork adn was not hugely impressed.  Tough parking lot, not entirely their fault.

name: Ethan Pilot
text: Brisket is excellently cooked, potato salad is also particularly good.  Price is very reasonable for the quality food and casual environment.

name: jennifer branigan
text: Best Salmon in NOVA. Try the mango salsa!

name: David Brundage
text: I Support YHS business and very good BBQ. That is all.

name: Pete Feinberg
text: Best BBQ nearby.  Brisket is very good.

name: Jonathan
text:
They don't make there own sweet tea...  And that should summarize it for any southerner.

Brisket is Ok but not dry enough for Texas and not Smokey or tinder enough for anyone. (btw they aren't trying to be Texas bbq)

Beans are great!  Not sweet, but good, and have a little tiny bit of heat to them.

Pulled pork is tinder, but not Smokey.

Sauce is Carolina style, wet, and liquid like

name: J Foodgeek
text: Good enough Brisket and BBQ pork but not great. Down home feel.

name: Chris Voigt
text: Delicious BBQ and ribs on the weekend.

name: Peter K
text: Awesome Food!

name: LAURIE PIPPENGER
text: EVERYTHING ELSE

name: Megan Whitherspoon
text: Title says it all. Big selection of combo lunches for less than $5.00 including canned soft drink. The place is clean and has seating for eat-in. In a store front at Old Fox Hill Rd and King St. Golden City Chinese Restaurant is a good place to quickly pickup some Chinese food. They have reasonably priced combination meals that include your entre, fried rice, and an egg roll.

name: Frances Martin
text: Okay I totally love my regular place, but decided to check this one out. First off it took 2 hours for it to be delivered, no biggie I think if the food is amazing. Unfortunately that isnt the case. I got chicken lo mein...could barely find chicken, was dry. General Tso wasnt good at all and the fried rice  and white rice was like rocks...I dont like wasting food but I tried to eat it...very disappointed, threw it all away. I will definitely be sticking to my regular place.

name: Barbara Saggio
text: Last night the food was delivered to my Hotel room with no problem...This afternoon, I place a order. I was informed the delivery may be an hour late...Well, one hour and fifteen minutes later, I recieved a call ..Meet them in the lobby. What?? I wasn't prepared for that. Just last night the driver came to my room..What changed over night?

name: William Green
text: It has a friendly staff and real reasonable prices!!!

name: Tamiko Banks
text: DO NOT ORDER FOR DELIVERY. They do not bring you your order and try to tell you that what they brought you is what you ordered… 🤬🤬🤬

name: Ashley Bouwkamp
text: Have been ordering from here for about 5 years. We have tried many Chinese restaurants in the area but we always come back here. We have never been disappointed in the food or service.

name: brittany horne
text: The people here are nice so this is a suggestion rather than a complaint. Please cook your stir fry veggies a little longer. I love a nice crisp sauteed veggie but these still taste raw and squeaky on my teeth. Specifically the green pepper and celery. The steamed rice is a little hard today, too. Skim the fat off your sauces too, very greasy. And the tea has a slight dirty water after taste and got dammit my fortune cookie is stale smh....this turned into a complaint. sorry. do better yall.

name: B Savvy
text: I love their dumplings and Singapore Mei Fun (pancit). The lady is always very nice to me and it's cool that it's a family run business. Their wonton soup has subtle flavors and the hot and sour has more bold notes. The tea is hit or miss, but I've never had a problem getting hot food or waiting too long, but in always do carry out.

name: Olivia Germann-Mc Clain
text: It's my go to place for Chinese take out. Nothing fancy, but it's always hot, tasty, and cheap

name: Storm Hall
text: So, I ordered food at 9:06 and was told it would take an hour. Ok, no problem. When it became 10:30, I called for an ETA and was told the delivery guy was on his way. Then, another 25 minutes go by with still no food. What time did my food show up? 11:16. Oh, but they gave me a free bottle of coke to make up for the time I waited.  This is absolutely ridiculous and will N E V E R order from this place again.

name: Delta Echo
text: Standard chinese carryout. Inexpensive. Sweet lunch special menu and an "open to close" combo menu.

name: Anointed By Christ
text: The Food was awesome

name: help I'm a disaster
text: If you're interested in eating within 2 hours of ordering, don't order from here.

name: Dalevon Gallashaw (Published Photographer)
text: Even tho I stop eating Chinese, this food here is still good.

name: Tyrone Washington
text: Great food and God bless them..

name: Brian Whitaker
text: Closes at 10pm but they take there phone off the hook at 9:30pm so they can't take anymore orders. Disappointed.

name: Inez Smith
text: Great food

name: Brian Whitaker
text: Closes at 10pm but they take there phone off the hook at 9:30pm so they can't take anymore orders. Disappointed.

name: Joya
text: Why. The service HORRIBLE! The undertone was a tad bit creepy... after waiting over 15-20 minutes for a waiter to take a drink order... (busy  - not at all)... didn’t get farther than that prior to my departure. Unacceptable!  My hard earned money goes to where the respect and service is given.  Know better to DO better. But I will never come back to this location. A disgrace.

name: Tisha S
text: Sampler appetizer was very good. My crabs were seasoned but it had absolutely no flavor. I really should have sent it back but in this climate I just didn't wanna seem like the angry black lady. Such a waste of money. Now I see why Olive garden next door had a long line and you could walk right in here. 🙄I won't be going back.

name: Tracey Brown-Miller
text: They just reopened recently so the one lost star is due to limited wait staff.  It looked too us like there was only 2 waitresses and one doubled as bartender.  Our food was amazing! We had crab cakes and the shrimp and fish platter, calamari,  and calamari chowder. All were great. Our waitress was friendly and did a good job keeping up with our drinks.  Will definitely be back.

name: Pablo Buendia
text: The food was horrible.  You can tell they are really struggling and cutting food quality and costs to the bone.  Instead of melted butter they give you some oily water.  I drank a bit of this oily water to see if it tasted like anything; it tasted like water, not even salty.  The poor crabs must have been bargain-cheap last week's leftovers, the shells were more than half empty.  Really just a waste of time and money opening mostly empty shells.  I left hungry having eaten mostly corn and potatoes.

name: Chris Brazil
text:
Service was excellent, Food was great.
Took my oldest son there for his Birthday, it was fantastic.

name: Herman jones
text: Great place to go and relax and enjoy good food

name: Chris Emerson
text: The food is excellent. Good choices to choose from and hard to decide

name: Dorcella Grate
text: The Salmon was "AWESOME " and the "BEST " I have had in years.  I will be back for more.

name: Nadine C
text: The prices have gone up a lot. Was going to get the crab bucket for my birthday,  but too expensive.  Got swordfish and it was on the cold side, but had good flavor. Good server.

name: Donna Ward
text: Service was great. Drink was good. Food was just average.

name: Jeff
text: My wife and I just finished an early dinner...great choice. Our appetizer and meals were excellent; our server, Ava, was fantastic! I recommend that you ask to be seated in her area. Shrimp and mahi were fresh, and the crab/shrimp dip was scratch made and very tasty! You won’t regret a visit to this Joe’s..

name: Wil Jones
text: Food was very good. I got the bite size shimp dinner which was a generous portion. Our waitress Kasey was awesome.

name: Mike McCabe
text: The staff here is incredible.  Friendly, helpful, and there when you need them, not when you don't.  Typical Joe's experience as far as food.

name: Kimberly Burden
text: The establishment was not very busy, and the tables were well spaced. I noted two servers and one behind the bar. Service was good until our food came. We realized ordering the crab legs a la carte would have been cheaper. My drink was already empty before I began eating and my husband's emptied shortly after. We noted two of the three servers pass the table multiple times, and even look at the table. No one stopped to refill the drinks or long enough to be flagged down. Finally the manager stopped by and asked how our meal was and I had to ask for refills and noted that the glasses had been empty for awhile. No apologies were offered and we never saw who I assumed was our server until they brought the check. The food was subpar for the cost as well.

name: Jonathan Madison
text: Pricey but delicious.. Amazing for our date night.. you guys rock and we'll be coming back to see you all..

name: Catrina Washington
text: It was good but it was so much better in the past.

name: Malcolm Prosser
text: Good service food was also good and hot also a play area outside for kids

name: S. Edward Tj Gerety III MBA
text: We had an outstanding time with great service, fabulous food all in a fun environment.

name: Niecey Anderson
text: While we were there socially distant seating existed and we felt safe.  I am so happy they are still in operation since some other JCSs in our area have closed in Fairfax.  We were very appreciative of all the attention they gave us.

name: S. Gehring
text: Good to see them open again, but still pretty expensive for okay seafood. Good oyster deal if they have them. Excellent service! Dont expect to get a branded shaker with the marg deal they have on the menu but you may end up with an extra drink on the house.

name: Dorian Reviere
text: Definitely not what I expected no season and very undercooked

name: Amanda Locke
text: The food and service was great. The price was a little high but other than that I really enjoyed my experience.

name: leo schultz
text: Excellent service and food was out right away. Nicole was very attentive to our party of 5.

name: keep it real
text: Good food abit over priced but we love seafood

name: David Watson
text: Waiter very unknowledgeable. food mediocre.menu not what we expected.

name: Kevin Koehler
text: This is the second time my wife and I have gone to this restaurant. Just so you know I do not eat any type of seafood, fish, or clams nothing! I do not like the smell or taste, so the first time we went there I told my wife if the smell is to strong I will go to another restaurant near by and eat there (we went there for a friends birthday party and they did not know about me and fish). But it has no strong smell like at a fish market and I have been to ones in Seattle, Washington and Bergen, Norway. So both times I have eaten a cheeseburger which I think is very good, my wife had a fish taco and some of our friends had crabs and clams and they said it was good (the reason why we were eating here in the first place and same birthday party gang). This is a very casual dress place and the decorations and stuff hanging on the walls is like being at a sports bar / bait shop with all of the photos hanging up and of course large fiberglass sea creatures like a Great White Shark (about 8-10 feet long) a Leather-back Sea Turtle and other items.

name: Edward Tj Gerety BACKUP
text: A great family friendly location.

name: Jacob Moz
text: The fried food was decent, the grilled food was overcooked, prices were mildly high for what you get.

name: Kathy Fowler-whitaker
text: Great customer service by my waitress and the attendance who worked the door. Me n my coworker arrived at about 8:30-9:00pm

name: Kitch Pilapil
text:
We made a random exit to check out something to eat for dinner. We chose this Joe’s Crab Shack. This is my first time to eat at a seafood restaurant and I wasn't disappointed. We ordered Ragin' Cajun
Pacific dungeness crab, queen crab, shrimp and smoked sausage. One word, delicious. The staff is great. The ambiance is good. Clean and unique restroom.

name: Rob Hutchins
text: Got the chicken tacos (I know, chicken in a fish place) and they were delicious but half an hour later my stomach hurt so bad it took two doses of Alka Seltzer to get to the point where I could go to sleep. This was my first time there and sadly, it's my last. Unfortunate since the food was delicious but cross-contamination can ruin people's nights.

name: Mike McCabe
text: The staff here is incredible.  Friendly, helpful, and there when you need them, not when you don't.  Typical Joe's experience as far as food.

name: Linda Fincher-Mason
text: Great calamari, blue motorcycle, coconut shrimp with pineapple plum sauce and front manager..he handled customer service issue  excellently..♡

name: Edward Tj Gerety BACKUP
text: A great family friendly location.

name: Olaf Herrick
text: Great but expensive

name: Vanessa King-Hardy
text: Had a great meal with family, the staff was great, meal was good.

name: Charles Stanton
text: So glad they are open and serving. Seafood is very good and nice to have nearby.

name: Ricardo Alvarenga
text: Wonderful restaurant food and service

name: Amabella
text: Although our server was very late in approaching out table (almost half an hour) about a third of our orders wrong or missing items, she was still up beat and charming! We truly appreciated her efforts. The food however was was unforgivably flavorless! The menu mentioned that The Steamer option had garlic but there was no trace of garlic flavor on it. It was so disappointing! The calamari was over fried and too crispy and again flavorless. It's like they just steamed and fried frozen food straight out of a Sysco truck. Their garlic bread, which was also forgotten by our server, was stale and tasted like a yesterday's bread. Definitely never visiting a Joe's Crab shack ever again. Since we live close enough to Maryland we'd rather go to a proper seafood restaurant than this place, which is sad because we live close to this franchise.

resp.text:
Hi Amabella. We sincerely apologize for your recent experience. We are always looking for ways to improve, and would appreciate any feedback you would be willing to provide at the link below. Thank you.
http://www.bit.ly/landrysfeedback

name: sharon R
text: Food was good when it finally came to table had to ask several times where it was. Took forever for the drink at the bar had to ask where that was. The one  manger is always nice and friendly he walked around checking on everyone. Nice for large parties,  will return.

name: Heather Nicole
text: Delicious but very over priced

name: Wayne Brearley
text: Really nice place for lunch and dinner.  Although we missed the lunch specials the happy hour specials start immediately following the lunch specials.  Food and drink selection on happy hour is very good.  Staff and management are very friendly and visible.

name: jeffrey rollins
text: Thank God it reopened love this place

name: Dee
text:
Visited here Saturday 3/7/20 around 12:30p after we left Fun Land around the corner. Food was much better and hot since the last time we visited about 2 months ago. Ordered the Joe’s Classic for two Steampots (which me and mom shared and it was more than enough) -my favorite in the steampot were the sausages and the potatoes. Seasoned well and potatoes steamed just right. I also ordered a special they had which was the fish and chips for $8 . And that was so cooked perfectly with tartar sauce on the side. My kid had fries which were hot and good surprisingly.

Note to staff: Our waitress was very accommodating and nice. Very attentive and personable.  And also I don’t know what you all did since my last visit but keep it up. We spent over $150 last time we visited but our food was cold and not anything to write home about. But this visit everything was great ! No complaints. Seems like the kitchen paid more attention to detail and making sure food was edible.

name: Spencer Williams
text: really enjoyed it ...food was amazing

name: Joe Hebert
text: Over 1 HR wait that was extended without contact or information.  We didn't stay.

name: Larry Miller (Red)
text: I love seafood, so....this is the closest one to me and at two hours away...the restaurant has always been clean fast and friendly. The associates always willing to help-without the eye roll! Just ate lunch. Food presented well, good portion size, way better than McDonald's. And they have great gear!!

name: Vanessa King-Hardy
text: Had a great meal with family, the staff was great, meal was good.

name: Linda Fincher-Mason
text: Great calamari, blue motorcycle, coconut shrimp with pineapple plum sauce and front manager..he handled customer service issue  excellently..♡

name: Dr. Shonda Harris-Muhammed
text: Food was awesome!

name: Linda J. White
text: The food was Delicious

name: Da'Ron Harvey
text: Good atmosphere

name: Betty Odom
text: I got the Joe's classic usually it's good everything is cooked. Not this time the potatoes were hard and the sausage wasn't thoroughly cooked. The shrimp was still white..I will be going back n April I hope it will be better.

name: Frances Knighten
text: Had a good time at this place I enjoy Joe's Crab Shack to the utmost the waitresses and waiters were gracious and kind and enjoy this place a lot

name: Bean UNmasked
text: FOOD WAS AWFUL! 🤢🤢Crab legs were small and overcooked. The potatoes were undercooked. I asked for extra shrimp and I got 6 very small shrimp.The only thing that I did like was the corn on the cob and my bf liked his sausage. The food wasn't like this a few yrs back but I will not be returning. The only reason for the 1 star was for the guy who took out to go order!

name: Pam Evatt
text: Good food excellent service!

name: Mike Strickler
text: Great food. Service was a little slow at first. I think we hit shift change but once our order was taken the food and service was excellent.

name: Clarence Ross
text: Great food just a little pricey for what you get.

name: Tara Thomas
text: Y’all need to update your online menu to your COVID menu you have in the restaurant very disappointed 😢

name: Christopher Carter
text: Good food

name: Mis Sanford
text:
Crab legs ➡️Bland and watery... corn tasted like basement dirt..
Service was good and friendly..
great atmosphere.
When you spend that much money on a meal.. you should enjoy it...

name: Tom Lindquist
text:
Great seafood! Seems certain times are bad-sometimes very bad.  I think we have been lucky, cause we have NEVER had a bad meal!
Keep improving the help and all the problems will likely go away.

name: Marshelle Marshall
text: Great fast service. Our server Coleman was super cool and made sure we had everything we needed. His trainee also would stop by and make sure that our drinks were full.

name: Christopher Carter
text: Good food

name: Tom Lindquist
text:
Great seafood! Seems certain times are bad-sometimes very bad.  I think we have been lucky, cause we have NEVER had a bad meal!
Keep improving the help and all the problems will likely go away.

name: Vincent Eberhardt
text: The service was great but the food was cold and not at all what I expected and for the price I expected a bit more and for the food to be at the least warm after all who wants to eat cold snow crabs. On the plus side of things we did get these cool little things to cut the crabs open and me and my family did buy a few of the cool shirts they have for sale.

name: Cindy Mitchell
text: Was pretty cool. I can see this being a popular place during the summer. Food is average.

name: yanira Medina
text: The waiter was very nice but the quality of food was really bad. We got 2 crab buckets and they smelled old and they were slimy in the inside. Came out of there feeling very nasty

name: Valeria Sedano
text: Exquisite food

name: Kelley Monahan
text: The fact that there is an outdoor play area for kids earns this 5 stars.  Being able to have lunch while my daughter gets to play is priceless.  Especially not at a McDonalds

name: titus morgan
text: The waitress we had here was amazing!! But the food is definitely not worth the price in taste. I do not recommend if you like good seafood

name: Anna Shkrebtii
text: Very nice place. Their cocktails are delicious and you can take they give you a glass/cup to take home (new one, not the one you drink out of)

name: Cheyenne Kozak
text: We had James as our server and he was so polite. He was even attentive when my daughter talked to him.

name: Colleen Watts
text: Waited over 10 minutes for a drink order or something and no one showed up at our table ever so we left

name: Frank Farmer
text: I had to ask the waitress twice " where is the crab pictured on the menu?" She replied that they didn't have that crab on the menu. The crab pictured was a blue crab indigenous to the Rappahannock and the Potomac river which are both close to Fredericksburg VA. I would suggest that Joe change the name to Snow Crab Shack or King Crab Shack because he has no Blue Crabs. After learning the sad truth I settled for a Snow Crab bucket with corn and potatoes which was good. Service was good. Bathrooms not well marked but clean and modern. Bar well stocked and a good happy hour that I missed.

name: Dien Truong
text: The staff is really nice and the birthday celebration we witness was cute. The food is good, but not as tasty as we though it'd be. My girlfriend got the coconut shrimp, which was really good; I got the Joe's classical, which had seasoning sprinkled on top, but as far as the taste, it was very bland. The corn that came with the plate was not fresh.

name: Blake B.
text:
This location was the first and last time I'd eaten at a Joe's Crab Shack. Maybe it was mostly a poor experience because my date itself was a bit awkward (we decided to bring our kids which made everything a little more complicated and hard to talk (I'm not a smart man)), but the server was also a little annoying and kept talking to us, and the food itself was hella pricey despite being slightly sub-par.

Do not recommend this spot, or probably any of the crab shacks that Joe owns.

name: Maurice Powell
text:
It was good to know that Joes crab shack still exists 🙂.

The food was pretty nice, along with the service.  It wasn't busy for the time we came but definitely a nice restaurant.  I will be there again soon

name: JUSTDORIGHT
text: My very first visit there today was AWESOME! The food & hospitality was very pleasant! I will definitely go back again. :)

name: Shavon Miller
text: Food wasn't cooked and bill wasn't adjusted after manager agreed to take the entree off my bill. Was in such a rush I paid the whole bill and even left the waiter a %20 tip because he was attentative. Still not too thrilled with my eating experience.

name: jay R.
text: Great place for a variety of seafood. They also have happy hour specials at the bar. Great place to bring kids. Outdoor seating is available during warmer seasons. They sell tshirts too.

name: Diana Mellinger
text: Food is great nice variety of seafood, sandwiches and salads etc. Service was friendly and fast.

name: Roxanne Brown
text: This is my number one place- my main man!! Love you love you love.. I will see you soon.

name: MZ DEE 2U
text:
I would have loved to give this establishment 5 stars. Our waitress was a young Caucasian female who was expecting (pregnant) looked as though she was due at any given moment. Her customer service was phenomenal. She was amazing.

She did not look tired, stressed nor out of sync. She Checked on our table regularly, refilled drinks often and even asked several times if we needed anything. She definitely deserved the $20 tip that I gave to her. I ordered the raging Cajun snow crab pot and my snow crab legs were super small.

I mean for the price that I paid I could have went to giant seafood section. Super disappointed. I figured driving over a hour and a half away from home for seafood would have been a great idea but oh boy was I so wrong...

name: J Box
text: Good food, good service.. pricey but worth it

name: Wayne Jackson
text: New and better menu items. Fast and courteous service with reasonable prices. We plan to return.

name: Mark Collins
text: Wow this is the BEST Joe's crab shack that we have ever been to. The staff is friendly and helpful. Even the managers and general manager stopped by to make sure they were providing great food and service.  The  Bourbon shrimp appetizer was fantastic. Along with a couple of pieces of garlic bread that made sopping up the sauce even more delectable. We also had the East Coast platter. This had to nice pieces of fish-and-chips with it as well as some shrimp wrapped in bacon And some great clam strips and a wonderful crab cake. We would highly recommend you enjoying a meal here.

name: Teresa Meggs
text: Love sea food! The Pena Coladas were the best. The birthday dinner for my friend was  successful, Thanks

name: Rahla Has Scars
text: Not the same. Used to be fun and friendly atmosphere. Told waitress one person had nut allergy. She responded that they had a gluten free menu. Had to ask for manager. Food was sub par.

name: Anthony Sam
text: I had a very good experience my food was good & excellent service.

name: Joseph Voss
text: Joe's Classic Steamer Pot for two... A good meal for three if you add 1/2 pound of shrimp. Good service, and management stopped by multiple times to check up on us.

name: Vicki Brown
text: We haven't been here for a long time! Hubby treated us to the Valentine's Day seafood boil! Delicious!😋😋😋

name: Jay Anderson
text: Great customer service. Amazing food. Never had a bad experience here

name: Charles Curry IV
text: Friendly staff, great service and awesome food. Shout out to Taylor for being an awesome waitress today and even gave me a to go cup for my soda without me asking. Can't recommend enough!

name: E S
text: disgusting on all levels. soggy fried fish and bland sides. fresh seafood smells like seafood, but doesnt stink. this place left a horrible smell on my clothes. like old bay and dumpster.

name: AX HD
text: Omg this one the first time I have ever been to Joe’s Crab Shack ! My girlfriend who took me out there ! it was her second time at one in Greenville SC ..Our first time together in lovely Fredericksburg Virginia! We had so much fun thanks to our awesomeness server named Joshua ! We definitely hope that we get him again ! He made us feel so special! And he had us laughing and smiling the whole time! Omg we needed this ! And was so attentive us .. He made our first time there very happy and we will definitely be back again ! We have just relocated to the area and so excited! This is our first restaurant in the area to visit! The food was so delicious and prices are very reasonable and lots of great things on the menu to choose from! We ordered two steam pots of seafood omg so good ! We highly recommend this location! All the staff are so sweet and friendly! Has a very cozy vibe too ! Thanks so much guys for making our weekend so sweet ! See y’all soon!!

name: Melissa Ehler
text: The food is good. Service was good. The restaurant is clean. Desert is delicious!

name: Chiniza Batiste
text: Josh made our first visit lovingly memorable #lovedit

name: TJ Ratana
text: Super busy on Valentine's but the staff was very friendly and food was awesome!

name: Donny Mock
text: Good experience for the most part. Our food took a long while to arrive considering there were few customers there at the time. The food itself was delicious with nice portions.  I would recommend this place.

name: William W
text: Usually get served terrible seafood here. Also one of the waiters spilled tea all overly Mom one day because, as he put it, "Didn't like her." No other explanation was given.

name: Trevor Largent
text: Happy hour has great specials the food was amazing and our Bartender, well she was amazing a bright friendly smile and she provided the best service we've had in such a long time. We'll definitely be back to Joe's soon.

name: Angela Hill
text: We were so excited to see this one still open. They were so good! Nice to see nothing has changed, same good service and food!

name: Margaret Cole
text: What great little spot...first visit but not the last

name: Ken Hill
text: Good food and service for decent prices.  I would bring my family.

name: Todd Porthouse
text: Overall fair dining experience. Waiter must have been new because he had trouble knowing w oi at certain items were. Had no idea what a craft and/or an IPA beer were even though the menu stated..."ask our staff about local brews...". Had trouble with knowing what was available food wise as well. Once everything got ironed out...which took way too much time...the food got to the table. Not sure if I'll go back.

name: Shawn Winn
text: Pricey, but good food, fast service and a playground for kids.

name: Alan Douglas
text: IF you understand this is a laid back seafood restaurant, part of the Landry, empire of various restaurants and casinos, you will be happy you came here. Great for kids or a cold beer or eating seafood without silverware. You can take your mother in law to the small gift shop, not Crackle Barrel. Sign up for Joe's emails a week before you visit to receive a free appetizer.

name: Nader Shaar
text: The service is great, the food the good, the prices for the crab legs is a little too high.

name: Sarah
text: Great staff and yummy food! I was happy to see there was a Crab Shack when we moved here and I'm happy!

name: Kim Arnold
text: Awesome service! Fast and hot! Best crabcake sandwich I've had in a while. All lump, very little breading.

text: Crab was good, lobster not so much, prices were as high as any other seafood place in the area.  Would have given a 4 but the staff literally acted like we were a bother to them. 2 waitresses were jaw jacking at the hostess stand when we walked in, I smiled and said hello. They looked at me like a deer caught in headlights then seemed annoyed when she asked us how many. The place was practically empty yet they were scrambling to figure out where to seat us, mumbling amongst themselves.  Once seated, a young lady came over to get our drinks, another server came by and asked if our drink order was already taken we said yes and I asked if I could ask her a question, she said she wasn't sure if she was our server and walked away. When our server finally got to us, she did apologize for the wait. She seemed nice but, then disappeared. We got our food and about 3/4 way through I wanted to order more crab. We didn't even see her for 15 minutes and when we did she went out to the patio through one door and came back in through the front, bypassing us. I decided to forgo the extra order of crab and dessert for our son because we didn't have another hour to wait in an empty restaurant. We will not be back.

text: The food taste good. However we have gone several times just to find out they are sold out. The line is always long. So order ahead, with hopes that they have what you want available. The smoked pickle taste pretty good. Ever time i go they run out of the potato for one of the meals. This last time i went they had it and it def. Was not what i expected. Was just a regular baked potato with toppings. I gave them a 4 star because of the line and you just don't know if they will be opened when you go/ sold out.

name: Will Richardson
text: I want to start by saying that the brisket was delicious as usual. The service on the other hand left something to be desired. We got two sliced brisket sandwiches, one side and one drink and it cost $32. I love BBQ but that's just too much money for two sandwiches one side and one drink. Really for cuts of meat that have traditionally been used to serve the poor!!!....that's just too much money for me

resp.text:
Hi Will, I'm sorry you had a negative experience, I'd love to chat with you to gain some clarity regarding the service you received that day. Please call me at 757-624-1000. Thank you.
- Floyd
General Manager
Redwood Smoke Shack, Ghent

name: Heidi L
text: Amazing BBQ, the best I've ever had. Served simply on picnic tables with traditional sides. The brisket was melt in your mouth. Many sauces for different tastes.. I honestly can't wait to go back. The rub and woodsmoked method make the food like none other. I was so into eating the food.. I forgot to take pictures. Next time!

resp.text: Thank you for the review Heidi, come on back and get you some photos!! See you soon!

name: Josh Kight
text:
One word
BRISKET
That is the main food item that keeps me coming back for more. Not saying their other items are bad by any stretch but that brisket for me is where it is at.

I also can’t say enough about the staff. Including the owner Bob and his pit master Floyd. They take customer service to the extreme for sure. From Greeting you at your table to make sure everything is good to go to giving you a tour of SmokeTown.

Let’s not forget the friendly smiles you encounter in the front of the house. From the moment you walk in the door you are greeted with a friendly smile and a welcome. Don’t know what you want? Just ask! Just like their meats are cooked low and slow you can take the time you need to get exactly what you want with out being rushed. Making sure you get exactly what you want. Really don’t know what to try??? Go ahead and get the meat sweats sampler. If it is in season don’t pass up on the street corn. You can thank me later!

Two thumbs up to a NY native cooking Texas style brisket in Southern VA!

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words and glad to have you part of the Redwood Family!   See you soon

name: Richard DeJesus
text: The best. Hands down don't sell yourself short. Go in and enjoy yourself.

name: Devontay Harrington
text: The food was really good I bought the platter for $27 and added sausage for three dollars.. my meal also came with two sides and a fountain drink.

name: Sal Net
text: Definitely good barbecue. Brisket was slightly dry but good. Had the sweats meats with sausage added. My sides broccoli salad,  baked beans, green chili mac and cheese, and cilantro coleslaw. Let my say sugar sugar sugar. Most sides sweet. Mac and cheese was delicious. Ribs had that perfect tenderness. Homemade pork rinds some of the best we ever had!

resp.text: Sal, thanks for the visit.  What cut of brisket did you get, lean or moist?  Our slaw sauces and beans do have sugar in them, maybe double up on the mac and cheese next time or give our collards or potato salad a shot next time.  See you soon

name: Lara Brown
text: I am not usually a huge BBQ fan but this place is delicious.  We ordered the Meat Sweats,  it was a lot of yummy meats with some delicious sides.  I really liked that the sauces/dips came separate so I could try the different ones and only use as much as I want.

name: Chris Booker
text: great food, loved the brisket...the pulled pork sandwich was great...the baked beans were just ok, definitely NOT the normal baked beans, they were more like chili beans or kidney beans i think they are called...the big burgundy ones...only one star less than i really felt bc the price point was sub par...what i paid vs what i got was not equally proportioned based on eating bbq from other spots

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by Chris.  You are correct our beans aren't normal, we use a blend of 3 different bean in ours and one of them is the red kidney beans that you commonly would see in a northern chili.  Sorry the price point isn't where you want it should be.  I hope you find what you're looking for out there and maybe we will see you again if you are around the neighborhood

name: Maya P
text: The brisket was everything very tender and moist. Won’t a fan of none of the sides disappointed with the Mac and Cheese but again the brisket was greattttt !

name: L. Oliver
text: Pretty Good, with Texas inspired in the name I had to give it a try. We got the Chopped Brisket sandwich lunch combo which was good. Being from Dallas Tx I grew up eating Chopped Beef sandwiches and had them about once a week as a teenager. This sandwich might have took me back to those days if I hadn't visited home less than 2 months ago. We also tried a couple of the sausage links( reg/ jalapeno cheddar) they were good.... for here. To be honest I have been chasing something to take me back to Texas for the last 26 years and Redwood Smoke Shack has come the closest. I will be back to try more of the menu. Keep up the good work!

name: Tourist
text:
Homer Simpson gurgling is all I can say!
Best barbecue I've had in the 7 cities AND North Carolina. Hands down.

text: Very good brisket. Good iced tea. Prices are a little high for what you get. I go every once in a while and enjoy it.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by.  We love seeing you when you're able to come through

text: Sooo good. Have been before and had the meat sweats plate and some other amazing food. This last time, I had the Mac and cheese topped with brisket and broccoli salad. It was a feast. All the sides I’ve had are amazing. The corn bread is very tasty, and the bananamisu is outrageously good. Staff is friendly, all wearing masks appropriately. Will definitely go back!

name: Andrea Hussen
text: Went to Redwood Smoke on Saturday. I ordered their sides of Mac and cheese and collard greens. They were sooo salty I thought the cook had turned the salt shaker upside down in both my sides. They were awful. Had to throw them away. For as much as this food costs it was a total waste of my money. Won't be eating there again anytime soon.

name: Devontay Harrington
text: The food was really good I bought the platter for $27 and added sausage for three dollars.. my meal also came with two sides and a fountain drink.

name: michael adams
text: Great ribs, brisket and bbq. Good smoked flavor. Highly recommended.

name: Angelo Taylor Jr
text: The food is great. I love the smoke on the brisket and the beans have a great taste. When you walk in you feel welcome by the staff

resp.text: Thanks for coming out and giving us a try Angelo, we hope to see you back soon.

name: Faith Jones-Arthur
text: I HAD to stop by here today..after a coworker let me taste her leftovers...ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS!! I dont know who's grandmother picked those greens and touched them by a Angel's hands but HOLY MERCY...I mean...you can't stop eating them. The Meat sweats ❤❤...price portion deliciousness‼‼...if triple threat was a spot it would be here...I have more than enough for at least 2 more meals

name: Andy Hulme
text: Friendly staff and cool spot. Good BBQ, the slaw was actually my favorite part of the dish! Biggest downside for me was really small portions for the price.

name: Tammy Barnett
text: Omg 😲 I'm from Texas so BELIEVE ME 😍 when I say hands down this is the best BBQ 👌 in Virginia Beach! Great food but the people working the service line could be a little bit more friendly 🙄.  Other than that it's great BBQ 👍

resp.text: Thank you for the love Tammy, it means a lot. I'll talk to the staff and remind them of the Redwood standards of customer service. Believe me when I tell you they work hard, and sometimes they get a little ornery but we wouldn't trade them for the world! Hope to see y'all again soon!!

name: David Stein
text: Best BBQ in Hampton Roads. And I've spent a lot time in Texas, St Louis and other places with great BBQ.

resp.text: Thanks for the visit David.  We hope to see you again soon

name: Anthony Mortillaro
text:
From placing my order over the phone, & then the turn around time , even though it was almost closing , the food tasted so fresh!!
Great location, great staff & great food.

We ordered a platter, which hit the spot.
Appreciate your hospitality Dakota.

Best wishes & happy holidays.
Anthony
I.g.@THASMgallery

resp.text: Thanks for visiting Anthony, we hope to see you again very soon

name: Declan Howard
text: They all wore their masks properly and wore gloves. It seemed very clean overall but the food wasn't very good to me and I like bbq. I might have just gone on an off day but it wasn't very good sadly.

resp.text:
Hi Declan, sorry to hear that we missed the mark for you, if you could please give me a call I'd love to get your feedback so that we can pinpoint what the issue was.

- Floyd
757-374-7295

text: Great brisket sandwich & loved all of the sides! We'll definitely be back!

resp.text: Thanks for the love Liam!

name: Jonathan
text: Good for Norfolk but average barbecue.   Tasted like pecan smoke  was used for all of the meats in the sampler and thats too strong of a flavor for meats like pork and chicken.

resp.text: Jonathan, thanks for giving us a try.  We do use pecan but also oak and hickory, which are the stronger woods that you are probably tasting.  Sorry you think they are too strong for some of the meats but unfortunately with our setup we are unable to use different woods for different cuts of meat.

name: Sue Trussell
text: I highly recommend this place.  Came across it by accident on the way to the bike shop nearby.  Came back for lunch.  The brisket, pork, beans, fries and cookie were outstanding.  This is my new favorite place to go, cannot wait to go back.

resp.text: So glad you found us, hope you make it back soon

name: Michael McAlea
text: Awesome food but small portions for the price. Would still return

name: Jei Cynth
text:
Loved the BBQ... The one drink policy (no refills) during this whole thing kinda blows goats though... Spend 80$... One drink 🤷🏻‍♀️ate at in the open air seating area. Maybe have some bottled or canned non-alcoholic beverages available at lesser price than the ONE DRINK, maybe water bottles for the kids?

Recommends: Red Potato Bliss Salad, Burnt Ends (real MVP),  Bananamisu (reminiscent of Asian Bakery flavor).

Will be back WITH A COOLER FULL OF DRINKS 😎

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by, sorry about the no refill policy right now, its a mandate from the State due to COVID 19.  Hopefully we will move into Phase 3 very soon and that will be lifted.

text: Good service.  Get there early before they run out.

name: Dolana Locklear
text: Very good ribs but everything else is ok.

resp.text: Hey Dolana, glad you found you are a rib fan.  We hope you come back and double down on them!

name: Madison Deans
text: I wish you gave 10 stars!! Excellent in every way!Bbq Brisket smoky &tender mmmm!Bananamisu outstanding creamy rich with a hint of cinnamon,wow!!

name: Judy Dale Adams
text: This place rocks the best BBQ and sides!  Oh, so delicious are the freshly cooked collard greens!

name: Robert Camper
text: Pulled pork was tender and tasty, the cilantro slaw was fantastic and the beans were savory. Highly recommend for great BBQ.

resp.text: Thanks for the support, see you soon

name: Eliot Ness
text: Decent BBQ but it is quite bland. Had to use my own spices at home to make it good.

resp.text: Eliot that's aweful!!  Can you please call 7576477500, I'd like to get details of what you ate so I can get down to the bottom of this.

name: Jane Sudds
text: I heard a lot of good things about this place so I wanted to check it out. It was not as crowded as I thought it would be. But be aware that parking can be difficult. I didn't see a parking lot here and I parked on the street. So I imagine if it gets busy it might be hard to find a spot. I ordered the Mac and cheese with pulled pork and my friend got a brisket sandwich. One of the main things that stood out to me here is everyone is so friendly! From the person greeting me when I walked in, the person taking my order, making my food, checking me out at the end, and even when I went to leave. They told me "we hope you had a great time and we hope you come back!". Everyone there made the experience great. The food was good and my friend said it was the best brisket she's had and that the espresso BBQ sauce was perfect. I can't even say that I have a complaint but I do have a suggestion. They have a lot of different bbq sauces from espresso BBQ, to vinegar, to a house made. I would just really like to see a sweeter sauce. I know living so close to Carolina I'm going to find a lot of vinegar style sauces. But I do enjoy a sweeter sauce. The house one is ok but for me it was still a little on the vinegar side. Either way I will definitely be back!

name: Kiska Morris
text: I ordered the brisket platter and pulled chicken sandwich with beans macaroni and cheese greens and the banana pudding the tast of the brisket good the greens were a bit spicy the beans had a unique taste but edible macaroni and cheese was different and pulled chicken was good banana pudding was a hit and the little piece of cornbread was very yummy!!!

name: Roy Jackson
text: Food was OK but the price of the food is a joke 3 pcs of beef brisket and 4 bones of ribs and some fries for 42 dollars Are you serious

resp.text:
Hi Roy, we're sorry to see that you had a negative experience. If there was an issue with the food, please shoot me an email at redwoodsmokeshack@gmail.com, I'd love to hear any feedback you have that may help us to improve our products or service. As for the price, it may offer little comfort, but we want you to know that we only use the best quality products and put days of effort into producing each handcrafted item on our menu. We appreciate you giving us a try and hope that you might visit us again in the future.
- Floyd

name: Paul M
text: Very good food, we ordered the brisket sandwhich platter with Mac and cheese and cole slaw as well as the pulled pork sandwhich with baked beans and collards. Eveything was delicious. Corn bread and banana pudding was pretty good as well. I'll definitely be back to try more!

name: Crystal
text: First time trying Redwood Smoke Shack. Food was flavorful and tender. We got the meat sweats platter which comes with 2 bones, pulled chicken, pulled pork, brisket, pickled onions, jalapenos, pickles, cornbread and 2 sides. We got mac n cheese and baked beans. The mac n cheese was average and the baked beans were delicious! The cornbread was how I like it moist with a hint of sweetness.  We also got burnt ends which was very good as well. You can make it into a platter,  but I choose not to because I wanted the corn and that wasn't offered as a side. The corn was amazing! They slather some creamy cilantro sauce on it after it's been roasted. I absolutely loved it. The customer service is awesome. Very friendly people. They have a sink next to the drink machine, which I loved because it's bbq, so of course your hands are going to get dirty. There is indoor and patio seating.  6 tables inside and 8 outside. The flies were a both at the outdoor tables but that's to be expected. They have rolls of paper towels at some of the tables and sauce trays. The sauces were okay. But I personally didn't need sauce on my meats because it was seasoned perfectly well. Next time I'm going to try the pulled chicken sammich with cole slaw.

name: Kika W
text: Ordered the Meat Sweets Platter several times. The first two times platters were very good. I saved some of the platters to eat later. Food was still fresh after I microwaved food. I ordered again and platters were horrible. The ribs were not fresh and burnt. The Slaw wasn't like the first two times. Your platters are expensive so you should bring it in every time you sell them. I don't know if there are several different  people cooking and preparing your food but notice different taste in seasonings cooking. I was looking for consistency. I'm very disappointed for what I paid for.

resp.text: Kika, sorry for the unsatisfactory experience you experienced this last time.  Im not sure what the hiccup was but I can assure you all of our products are made by a recipe so consistency shouldn't be an issue.  Please contact the restaurant at 7576241000 and ask to speak with a manager to get this order credited back to you.  Sorry again and I hope you give us another shot.

name: scovode
text: Fabulous TX brisket.  Great mac and collard greens sides, and dessert sweet cornbread.  Have a beer, sit outside and savor the moment.

name: Alan Barrett
text: Great authentic BBQ! Finally got a chance to try this place and it did not disappoint! The smoked meats were great and the sides were ok but not bad being open only a week. I absolutely love seeing a smoker out back too. If youre in the mood for some good barbecue then check this place out.

name: Samantha Price
text: This is the business that replaced the Dog N Burger joint 3 years ago which we enjoyed. So I suggested to my husband that we should try that place out since we were in the area. So glad that he obliged me. OMG their food was so delicious! We ordered 2 lunch specials,the pulled chicken and the cheddar jalapeno one with sides. (beans, collards and corn pudding) And our desserts were banana misu and bread pudding. Also washed it all down with some delicious sweet tea. We will definitely patronize that place again in the future.

text: The ribs are fantastic.  Best I have had in quite a while.  I also like the cheddar jalapeño sauage.  Brisket and pull pork are  not bad.

name: Lyce xxo.
text: We stopped by yesterday and are very impressed. The staff are very nice and helpful. The food is AMAZING and the prices are great.  We will be returning!

name: KA Darnell
text:
Everything was delicious! The baked beans are so good. I haven't tasted anything like this from a public restaurant. The collards had a great taste too. In fact it was just right.  The cornbread was really good. I imagine the corn puddin is as well although i didn't get it.

My only complaint was the pricing. My plate was $17 before tax. It was $13 for a sammich platter and then it's an extra $3.50 to get "sliced" brisket. Ive been to numerous BBQ places and have never been charged to get it sliced.  But the food was good and I'll definitely be back.

name: Clark Clark
text: Can t drive thru Norfolk without stopping.

name: Dorothea Phillips
text: Meats so tender it practically melts in your mouth!

resp.text: Thanks for the love Dorothea!!

name: Jeremy Ferguson
text: Been there twice now. The brisket is super good. Really tender with a perfect bark. The sausage is good. The sides are awesome. I had the green chili mac and cheese and the collards on my second visit. My wife got a pulled pork sandwich and she enjoyed it.

name: Jason Jordan
text: Always beyond excellent! Burnt ends are to die for... MEAT CANDY!

name: John Schools
text: Delicious & fun menu. Competition grade meats and the green Chile Mac & cheese has just a touch of heat.The Tomic Tater was cooked perfectly with chicken, slaw, and BBQ beans on top. The Loaded Mac & Cheese was good. I chose pork on top. Both $22.50 with tax.

name: Dee Hall
text: Having lived in central Texas for a decade, my expectations for Texas style bbq are pretty high. Redwood always exceeds expectations. Have the brisket with smoked beans and potato salad, you won’t regret it!

name: Mark Morgan
text: Damn best in Norfolk.

name: Dennis Boyd
text: Food and Service is worth the drive and time. I promise.

name: Audrey Clifton
text: Was very excited for my family to try this restaurant based on several reviews...but ended up mostly DISAPPOINTED! Ordered through doordash and food came quickly. First issue, we ordered $70 worth of food to include 3 platters, two platters were BOTH MISSING FRIES! We paid $18+ for a brisket platter that literally had ONE SLICE of brisket, that's not a platter, and way overpriced for the amount of food! The pork bbq tasted like smoke, not pork or bbq sauce at all! Ended up doctoring up my pork bbq for my son to eat and got me food from somewhere else! Oh, my children said the bananamisu wasn't all that great as I bought each of them a dessert! Didn't do one star only because of on time delivery. Very disappointing taste and experience!

name: Sharif Brookhart
text: I Love all of The dishes that I've eaten this far, and would like to enjoy more of The added Menu.

name: Derrian Bolds
text: The food was delicious and the price for it was decent. Good customer service.

Unassuming spot on the side of the road with indoor and outdoor bench seating. Several sauces to choose from. The sides are amazing to. The Mac and cheese is some of the best I've ever had; the French fries, baked beans, and cole slaw don't disappoint either. Filling portion sizes and good prices considering quality and quantity.

name: Mike H
text: Call before you go! The fact that they run out of food on a daily basis is a testament to the satisfaction of their clients. They take great pride in the smoking of their foods and offer the traditional items you'd find in most quality family backyard barbecues! It ain't cheap! My wife and I sat down for a piece of brisket, an order of burnt ends, two ribs, two sides, a beer and a Coke and the bill before tip was almost $60. There's only a few seats inside and their covered back porch can seat slightly more than 20 people in four table settings. On good weather days, they offer unprotected outside seating were you might find some local quality entertainment. Like most good barbecue joints, they have a variety of sauces offered. I particularly liked the espresso. They have a nice dry rub that appears to be a simple salt and mostly pepper seasoning that allows you to eat the meat without the sauce if you choose. It's a great family setting and you can expect to find everything from younger adults to families with younger children enjoying the surroundings and a simple meal prepared the right way.

text: Outstanding BBQ that this area really needed! I had the lunch special, which was a pork BBQ sandwich with a side (I picked the green chile mac n cheese), cornbread, and a drink. I also added bananamisu pudding for dessert. At the front counter, the chef preparing the meal gave us a free sample of pulled pork. It was amazing... melted in our mouths. The pork on the sandwich was the same way. The mac n cheese was delicious, and it was a unique take with the green chile flavor (it's not spicy so give it a try). The dessert was banana pudding which was a generous serving that I split with 2 others. Very rich and cool temperature, which was very refreshing in the summer. Lastly, they have 5 sauces available to try. My personal favorite was espresso bbq sauce. They also had a vinegar, house bbq, hot sauce, and ketchup. I am definitely going to go back for lunch again, this is a new favorite spot of mine. The only critique I have - please add sweet tea to the drink menu!

name: James Davenport
text: Redwood Smoke Shack won Veer Magazine Best Food Truck in 2017 and 2018. Bob and the crew are down to Earth, eager to please, and customer service oriented. His Texas inspired BBQ is smack your Mom good, and my Mom agrees! All the sauces are scratch made, of which I highly recommend the espresso BBQ. It's like if Seattle's best and Franklin's got real drunk one night. Everything on the menu is delicious, but far and above all offerings are the burnt ends. They're just little chunks of meat candy cascading down from smoker heaven. Bob frequently makes one off specials, the most popular being the pork belly burnt ends or the brontosaurus ribs. The best menu item to cut your teeth on Bob's carnivorous genius is The Woody - several of his smoked meats, the cilantro lime slaw, and sauces on a Krispy Kreme donut. Sweet and savory!!! I really love it when he posts up outside of MoMac Brewery. Beer and BBQ go together like Forrest and Jenny . . . minus all the rampant drugs and whatnot. Buy some Redwood SWAG and get the discount! #MeatManCometh #RedwoodDisciple

text:
This is my first review in forever and I'm here because YOU need to be here. I've been wanting to try auntie's for a few weeks but between mixed reviews and an obsession with the sub shop across the street..well, anyway. The sub shop is closed for labor day weekend...to aunties we went. As other reviews noted, the hostess was so sweet and very chill. I'm not sure if it was Heidi Joy, but she was nice as pie. We chose to sit outside as it was an absolutely beautiful night, we weren't bothered by any flies or anything. I loved all the plants outside, but I also wanted to give them some love (call me!)
I ordered a Ting to drink as I don't drink alcohol, it's a great option to have and I hope they keep it. We started with pork lumpia, obviously, but next time we'll try the spam. It was lumpia, and as always lumpia is delicious. Served with a side of sweet chili sauce and some sort of vinegar, you can't beat lumpia and a sunset. I was brave enough to try the vinegar and I totally get it.
This is getting lengthy but I've been thinking about this dinner for hours guys...
It took some time for our food to come out, but we don't lean towards the impatient side usually and it was totally fine. Just maybe don't go if you're in a hurry! We ordered the chicken adobo and aunties double cheese burger which is actually a beef patty AND longanisa which is a delicious Filipino sausage. You guys..this was literally the best burger I have EVER had. It was juicy, perfectly cooked (she didn't ask how i wanted it cooked and i didn't tell her) it came out medium well but still amazing somehow?? And it was topped with BANANA KETCHUP MAYO oh man. You can't make this stuff up. I had a bite of the chicken adobo and the chicken was sooo flavorful and tender, without any sauce! The sauce was just a bonus. I believe they used a jasmine rice which I loved.
Between the 2 of us it was about $40 and we don't usually spring for an appetizer. Next time I'm trying to calamansi pie!!!
Thank you Auntie's, I love you.

Edited to add: I ordered the mac salad side and I ended up not liking it much at all. Just not my thing, other friends love that stuff! When the server came out to check on us I told her how much I loved the burger and said "I can't say the same about the mac but that's okay cause the burger makes up for it" she asked if I wanted a replacement and I kind of did but I hate to be that person "I dont want yall to have to do that..but i do love fries"
She was more than happy to get me some and let me tell ya they were equally amazing. I told her it was like they soaked up all the flavors in that kitchen, I really don't know how these fries "tasted Filipino" but they did.

Edit 2 its the next morning and I'm having my leftovers for breakfast. Honestly I can die happy

In the meantime, there was a couple that came in and they left  immediately. This is not a place that I would go if you have asthma, any long conditions, on oxygen, sinus issues, allergic to smoke, and etcetera.

My breakfast was cheap, but not worth the money. My pancakes and omelette were PAPER THIN!!!!!! Which even made my experience even worse. I was told by a staff member that they had just gotten a new chef/cook and that the food has been different and not as good.

I wouldn't go back or recommend someone. I know someone that went at lunch time and she said "They weren't busy, it smelled terrible and awful of cigarette smoke, and the food wasn't all that good."

The baklava with some of the best that I've had in a long time.  Oh he also added ribs to the menu...  Sooooo good.  I haven't ordered any yet, but he was passing them out as samples when I went to pick up my order.  Yum!  I was very surprised at how good they are.  Moist sticky fall off the bone ribs.  He said that he's not going to cook them for the menu as spicy as he was giving them out of samples.  I love spicy food so I thought it was excellent the little bit of heat that it did have which wasn't much.  So if you like spicy tell him to add a little heat to it and you'll love it.   If you like spiced fries you'll enjoy them from here.

To reply to people saying the owners are racist, they are not from the US, and they treat everyone with the concern that they might add marijuana and point out the cameras work so you don't try to add it because they've had issues.  I'm their enough that I myself have smelled when someone adds it.  I'm a 35yo white guy and was told to be careful they are watching.  I've seen people walk out and smoke at their cars.  I've also seen people be cheap and add liquor to their drink and take it back in.   So seems to me they are just trying to protect their business with very good reason, because people are trying to regularly break the rules.  Their staff has Latino people, African American, and Middle Eastern as well as white.  So the owner doesn't have racial hang ups.  He's worried about getting his licenses pulled as any owner would be.

text:
So I was apprehensive about visiting because there aren't many reviews and when there are a couple 5 star reviews and one one star review, I often wonder what the real story is. So I've loved Maggios for years but had not tried them after half of their restaurant became a hookah lounge.

I have gone to many of the local hookah bars... Alf Laylah, Skyline, Andalusian... Maggios might now be one of my favorites. The hookah was great. I had Turkish coffee and falafel. Both were so tasty!

The thing you should know about any hookah bar is that you will not receive American style table service, and you should not. American style table service is too intrusive. So they get it just right to be polite and speedy. They keep good coals on the hookah, they don't let them get too small and bring them out after they've caught.

For my first half hour there, I was thinking should I give them 4 or 5 stars? Do I like it or do i love it? In the atmosphere and with the hookah, I decided 5.

Their food menu is good. The hookah menu has 3 tiers for price. There's the house brand, which it doesn't specify because it's probably ftom that brand that comes in a pink box. I recognized the flavors. The other 2 are starbuzz and another expensive brand (brain fart).

Friendly wait staff so I recommend to diners who love spicy food.

name: Jasmine Hindman
text:
We had reservations for my husbands birthday and arrived a little early and were told we would be seated in a couple of minutes. 25 minutes later, when I asked the hosted how much longer it would be, she rudely responded that it "takes 2 plus hours for our diners to eat". I totally get that, but they shouldn't be booking reservations so close together if that's the case. (We were among many others waiting quite a bit of time)

Thankfully, our waitress, Beth, Joel, and all the food were amazing and redeemed the rest of the night! Beth went above and beyond with her service, and made some wonderful suggestions. She even brought Joel over to speak to us about the tequilas they use and make drinks suggestions - all amazing! We enjoyed the food so much, I highly recommend the calamari and the pork spare ribs! If they iron out the reservations and the way they respond to long waits, they will go very far!

name: Rupert C Ryker
text: Little Star is where Threepenny Cafe used to be. With its warm energy, and kind staff, the restaurant welcomes you but after that, everything is subpar. At that price point, with all the hype, we expected to find more than a menu of dishes that were either too flat in taste and looks or too overwhelmed with some type of ingredient like mustard, mayo or cheese. We were expecting an elegant delicacy from the trio of Chef Ryan Collins, Chef Tristan Wraight and Ben Clore, yet found nothing close to what they can potentially offer. You would be much better off going to Oakhart Social or Más for a delicious fare. I am not sure what Chef José Andrés would think of these dishes but I certainly hope that we stop the slew of restaurants that offer blend food at big city prices. Charlottesville deserves better.

text:
With all of the reviews posted, I was so excited to try this place.  The concept of noodles being made fresh and cooked before my eyes was so appealing.

Because of other reviews I ordered the Mongolian Beef.  For me I thought this meal was too heavy and the sauce the noodle was cooked in was a bit on the salty side for me.  It reminded me more of a Chinese lo mein dish.  So if you like lo mein, you would probably enjoy it.

I also got a taro milk tea.  I asked first if it was water based or tea based.  She assured me it was tea (which is how I like it) but I'm pretty sure it was water based.  For me it was too creamy and heavy.  I also found the boba to be plain.  I'm used to boba having a sweetness to it (the way boba tea shops usually soak theirs in honey or something sweet).

I really wish I could have given a 4 or even 5 stars as the staff was friendly and the concept is cool.  I'm sure my preferences are not the same as everyone's but based on this visit I thought it was just "ok".   I do plan on trying them again and perhaps ordering one of their soups.

text: If you're a plant lover or just want to beautify your household this is the most helpful place you'll find in Newport news

name: Bee Tickler
text: Reserve plenty of time to shop here. You will find varieties of plants that you won't see in the "big box" stores.  Restaurant is nice.

name: Jim Pouchot
text: Best burger I have had in years.  Everyone else enjoyed their meal too.

name: HittaHitta
text: The Shrimp & Grits we're amazing great service great open dining space with outdoor seating as well. The kitchen area is open & visible which I like.  Also tasted the chicken salad sandwich & chicken & dumplings both A+

name: Diane Sprecker
text: This was Sage Kitchen. Food was fantastic. Had the wrap and fries. Delicious.

name: Christina Gaffos
text: Always find something interesting for a unique gift. Wonderful plants. Great restaurant. Prices are high. That's my only complaint.

name: Trish Underwood
text: Awesome place

name: Jason G.
text: The food is delicious. The one down side that I found is that their pasta salad is made with dried herbs, which wouldn't be bad if they had been rehydrated in some way, but they weren't, and while the taste was good, it was like eating a tree. Otherwise it was quite good.

name: Faith Bloxom
text: A wonderful.place always puts a smile on my face all t wonderful plants n flowers the gitts n cards are super cool n its a wonderful place to dine also thank u andersons

name: Lee Horrell
text: Andersons is great. Been going there for my gardening needs my whole life.definitely well worth the extra dollar for the quality.

name: Heather Eans Gayeski

name: Fidelite Gerson
text: I love your chicken salad and key lime pie, so delicious, the pomegranate tea, I highly recommend you to everyone to stop by and test your delicious food 👍

name: Bruce Good
text: Had lunch @Sage Cafe in Anderson's. Very good food and wait staff was excellent. Plan on going back. More stuff on the menu I want to try.

name: Rebecca Buszek
text: While their garden prices are a little higher than a home improvement store, they have plant choices you don't see and each plant is down-right vibrant.  There are fountains, flags, boots, soil, pergolas... The garden department is a five star.  The boutique is not for me.  $149.99 for a shirt I touched on the rack on my last visit was a wow.  You will find patio furniture here that outshines too, but you will pay furniture store price for it. I have never eaten at the cafe.  Can't speak for that.

name: stacy oakey
text: Menu says one price and they charge a higher price, when we said something about it the manager said that was the correct price and we were confused. Which was not what the menu said. Management was really rude.

name: Brenda Quillin
text: Excellent food and service.  You will not be disappointed if you choose to dine here.

name: Petra Holden
text:
The food at this unpresumptuous cafe  is simply excellent. A variety of options, both healthy and decadent, including a make-your-own salad and at least ten exquisitely thought out juice mixes, all with organic agave as the sweetener and including fresh ginger, kale, green apple and celery, or many other combinations.  I have never been disappointed at the service or the quality of the food.  You may wait for a table, as the cafe is quite popular around lunch hour, but they give you buzzers so you can visit the gorgeous home and garden showroom while you wait.

I love this place!

name: January Serda
text: I walked around for an hour browsing plants and not 1 employee said hello or asked if I needed any help. They have a lot of plant inventory but prices are high. When I went to check out to purchase a few plants, the cashier wasn't friendly and did not smile or greet customers. I went because I had a mother's day gift card to use. Doubt I will return due to the high prices and poor customer service.

name: Amy Williams
text: There are so many interesting gifts and plants to see here.

name: Earl Glenn

name: Aaron Gardenia

name: Matthew Palagyi
text:
Highly recommend. I have never had a bad experience during my visits. My personal favorite food item is the
Tragermeister.

name: Barbara Cooper

name: Hunter Carr
text: Great selection, great service, and good prices.

name: Butch Gibbs

name: Annie Oakley
text: Try as I might I always find a "Got-to-have" plant, so I never leave empty handed.... no window shopping.

name: Collin Gilland

name: Stephen Flippin
text: Awesome food and great service.   Tragermeister is my favorite sandwich  and the BlackBerry sage tea.

name: Mark Kamischke

text:
I love the chicken salad and build  your own --its awesome
I have also had the breakfast which is very good !!

name: Dennis Manvell

name: Chris Hall
text: This place has tons of shopping options, food, and even beer and an arcade.

name: Katie Garry
text: They have absolutely gorgeous flowers, plants, etc to choose from...and a good variety. I was walking around there for at least an hour and a half and not one employee talked to me or asked me if I needed help with anything. While I was in the greenhouse, I said, "I have no idea what I'm doing!", right when an employee walked by (a little passive-aggressive, I know lol)...he laughed and said that he will go and find someone that can help me. So I waited...and waited...waited a little more...and no one ever came over to help me! Smh. Not to mention, it was brutally hot in the greenhouse, which is fine, but I was standing there, waiting...feeling like I was going to burst into flames at any moment. I'm surprised by all of this, beings they have stellar reviews. Also, their merchandise is waayyy over-priced. So I left, an unhappy customer. I will not be going back.

name: Tiarra Henderson
text: Very racist place. They like to fire black employees as soon as they hire them

name: Linda K

name: Maria VAWitch

name: Jim Pereira
