name: P C
text: Scaling down the nautical decor.   Super sad to hear of this.  Y'all were the best place for home/decor. 😢

name: Kenneth Watson
text: Simply put, Greek comfort food at it's finest.  You will not be disappointed.  Had the chicken souvlaki traditional style and it was fantastic.  Everything is freshly prepared and the portions are generous.   I will be coming back soon.

name: Shirleena Chatman
text: Ordered ahead, ready on time and fresh. Delicious Gyro bowl with rice. Picture was after I started eating but it started out pretty 😆

name: Nun Ya
text: This place has the best peta bread, so fresh and crispy. The beef and lamb meat in the gyro was one of the lamest I've had so far. The lettuce was good quality and the tzatziki tasted good but was not spread across the gyro.

name: George Scarbrough
text: Delicious food, great customer service, amazing fries and the kids loved the kids meals...a little pricey but, I feel it's worth it for this top notch quality!

name: Nathaniel Danley
text: Awesome gyro and fries. Baklava is great too

name: Rachel Smith
text: Oh my, SO good!! I love everything here, especially their french fries and bacon ranch pita!

name: Sarah M
text:
I decided to give this restaurant a try when I saw a Lamb Burger on the menu.

The pattie was juicy, flavorful,  fulfilling- just delicious.  The perfect burger bun layered with fresh veges like lettuce, tomatoes,  pickles, etc.

I also ordered a side of the Greek white sauce. My Lamb Burger didn't need it, but it was a nice compliment to my pattie.

I'm looking forward to trying other items on the menu.

name: Journi
text: Great quality gyros here. The pita bread is amazing!

name: Debra Miller
text: They have the absolute best gyros in Eastern Virginia...maybe even in the country! Their tzatziki is phenomenal!

resp.text: Thank you Debra!

name: Jason Hoyt
text: The lamb burger was delicious. Just a little pricey for the size.

name: Oscar MV
text: Pleasantly surprised. First time at a drive thru Greek food place and it was fantastic.

name: David Walter Sr.
text: One of the only places left around that have really good Gyros!

name: Richard Mullin
text: Very tasty food but I wish they had a place to sit down and enjoy the food.

resp.text: Hi Richard. We do have seating inside and now with the weather warming up you can enjoy your food on our patio! Hope to see you soon.

name: Dylan
text: Definitely a great hole in the wall type of restaurant. I'll admit to driving way to far when I'm having a craving for a gyro because no where else can compare

name: Dustin Davis
text: A bit of a wait bit always good food.

name: Rhonda Taylor
text: The cheesesteak gyro is AMAZING!  You won't be disappointed!👍🏾👍🏾

name: Stephanie
text: Finally! I haven't had a good gyro since I moved to Virginia. That changed today. I got the regular gyro with everything and it was the best one I have ever had. I will be back. I am sad that I am not hungry anymore because I could eat this all day.

name: Keisha B
text: The food was ok!!! The burger was pretty hood. The onion in the onion rings were very thick and hard to bite through.  I don't like the fries.

name: Mary Ann Braunbeck
text: Yummy and affordable!  Like having fare food in your backyard!!

name: Kevin Irish
text: Best Gyros in town. Used to own The Castle on Jefferson Avenue. The Tsiki sauce is amazing! Highly recommend getting extra, you'll wish you did.😋👍

name: C Jacob
text: Mr. Gyros has some awesome gyros. Been here a few times when fast food needs a change up. I think I will start to go more. The burgers here are ok, nothing too fancy but the gyros are spectacular. I would recommend this place hands down. There is rarely a line, probably because of the prices which are a few coins higher than most would expect. Still a great place to try if you haven't already.

name: bill Renn
text: Drove from virginia beach to try. I wasn't disappointed great gyro. Onion rings were delicious. Worth the drive for a great gyro. Next time I will try the lamb burger!

name: Emily Steele
text: A little expensive, but the food is worth it. I've had the Greek salad, fries, chicken gyro, garden salad, and baklava throughout my visits here. Small dining room and small outdoor seating. Seems most customers use the drive-thru as it's normally not too crowded inside. Customer service is excellent. They keep it clean, they're friendly and helpful. The food is excellent and the baklava is the best I've had. I really like the vinegarette for the salads. Don't let the hole-in-a-wall appearance throw you off, definitely worth a stop.

name: Jackie Watson
text:
The BEST gyros in town. If there is a line in the drive thru, it’s worth the wait!
Try the Baklava too!!

name: Alan Roach
text: Best gyro I've ever had. The original was Moist, flavor, spice,  grilled pita.  I went back for more. Wonderfull frys and onion rings. I would eat here everyday

name: Jennifer Webbert
text: Underrated establishment. Staff was super friendly. Their fries are my favorite, and I can't wait to try the homemade baklava and cheesecake!

name: Jeremy Scicchitano
text: Food is great and priced fairly.  We love it!

name: CARALYN JONES
text: Food and people were great. Really love that they cook food to order, well worth the wait. Let me add well worth the money.

name: blok229
text: Wow! I've been driving past this little place for years until today! Taste like  Real burgers! No more wendy's and mcdonald's for me!

name: Terrance Motley
text: I always enjoy going to this place. They gyros are amazing as well their lamb burgers.

name: Catrice Bess
text: Man my gyro was beyond amazing👏 I could eat here everyday until I die!!

name: Logan Jackson
text: Amazing food and service all the time! I'll keep coming back.

name: Kaitlyn Pooler
text: So good, you must check this gyro place out. I use to live in Newport News and moved out of state I miss this place so much.

name: Marcos Castellano
text: Always love coming here. Maybe a little more than I should (as they now know my order by heart). But great service, and great food. I don't have a single negative thing to say about them. A small family-owned restaurant.

name: Jennifer Kim
text: The restaurants was clean, had good customer service(she was really kind!) BUT I expected too much for the Gyro..I used to go to "Papa's greek pizza" in Virginia Beach and their gyro is the best!!! It could be just my taste. I like the gyro sauce with full of garlic flavor in it. This place's gyro sauce was just not really flavorful which made me so sad...:( I had an inferno gyro which supposed to taste spicy but their jalapeño pepper wasn't spicy AT ALL..it was almost had no flavor😅. That was funny.

name: CLAUDIA PARKER
text: Pretty good...fries taste good and always hot and fresh and the tzatziki taste homemade...meat is ok.

name: Louis Richardson
text: I miss the Castle but the food is still Great

name: Amy Kelley
text: Absolutely deliciousness. The Gyros are amazing and the fries are perfect.

name: Robert Cox
text: Food is amazing.  Great choices, even if your not a protien lover.  If you are a protien lover great choice.  Please don't be afraid to wait a little in the drive through.  It's more like ordering to go from a restuarant.  No pre made burger patties here.

name: Thomas Hunter
text: They have the best Gyros I've ever tasted.

name: Dan Baxter
text: Great people and excellent food.

name: Justin Dampf
text: Best gyro in the area. Doesnt skimp on the meat and it was the closest thing I've tasted to the vendors in Greece. Keep it up!

name: Shana Dymeck
text: Gyros and fries are sooo good!!! Always fresh and hot!

name: KC Loveabelle
text: Soooooooo goooooooood

name: Laura Kauffman
text:
Just moved to the area and craving some Mediterranean style grub. This place is outstanding! Family ordered the Philly rice bowl, veggie rice bowl, the traditional Gyro pita, the sweet potato fries, hummus w/ pita, and falafel. Everything was absolutely delicious!! And OMG can I just say that the regular French fries that came with the combo meal were probably some of the best French fries I've had in my entire life... and I am a French fry junkie! I will definitely be back!

P.S. Service was great too! The employee was polite and attentive and nailed our very long order! Thank you! 😊

name: matthew arbor
text: No question. This is good Greek food!

name: Andrew Kimbel
text: I can't say enough good things about this place. Their food is absolutely delicious and their customer service is always amazing. One of the best things that I love about Mr. Gyros is honestly their french fries. I don't know how they do it, but they're always perfectly cooked, with a crisp outside but soft inside, and seasoned to perfection, no ketchup necessary. I also haven't been anywhere in Hampton Roads that makes a better Gyro.

name: JT Skyles
text: Great tasting traditional chicken gyro. Cheesecake as well.

name: Sami Sankey
text:
The best, absolute best. Been coming here since we moved to the Peninsula and will miss it when we get moved again. Don't expect a super quick experience in the drive thru though, their food is made to order.
Also their Baklava is amazing.

name: David Spitler
text: Really good and can't wait to go back for more!!

name: Samer Abuasi

name: fnnykel1

name: Lindsay Sumner
text: Excellent authentic Gyros. Lots of menu options for the non-gyro lovers. All of it fresh and hot. Updated and very clean establishment, inside and out. Very tiny inside, only 5 tables I think. Ample outdoor seating for when the weather is right.

name: David Savransky
text: It's probably one of the best Greek restaurant that I have been too. The food is delicious and they have one of the best fries I have ever tasted. Also, they sell their salad dressing by the bottle, so if you really like your dressing you can take it home with you.

name: Renita Brown
text: GOT THE TRADITIONAL BEEF/LAMB GYRO & LOVED IT. GENEROUS SERVING OF MEAT IN EVERY BITE. THE BREAD WAS SOFT & WARM.  WILL BE BACK FOR THE BEST FLAVORFUL GYRO I'VE EVER HAD.  THANK YOU FOR CORRECTING MY PRONUNCIATION OF GYRO WHICH IS YEE-RO, HAD NEVER BEEN TOLD BY OTHER PLACES I VISITED.

name: Gary Watson
text: Always awesome, never a disappointment, which is why I travel there from hampton for take out

name: Amanda Adams
text: Locally owned and the staff take pride in their food and service. Falafel pitas are wonderful. The fries are the best. They have recently done some upgrades to the seating area which are nice. It is more if a take out place- dining area is small but a great quick lunch.

name: Oslin Tuulaupua
text: I never had a problem with my food. It's always fresh and hot. Dinning area is pretty small but they do have outside tables to eat at.

name: Darlean Basuedayva

name: Jack Mulligan

name: Allen Hartman

name: Chris Atienza
text: Great find. Quick, friendly and extremely tasty food. A new favorite and 'must go' when we are in town.

name: Andrew Castillo
text: Small & "Family Owned"?  Timely enough food wait time & friendly staff. I've only ordered gyros & Greek salads.  I don't eat fast food that often, but I'd visit Mr. Gyros & Burgers maybe once a month. - A/ATW

name: Mary

text: Tasted just as good as the gyros I had on deployment in Greece! Prices aren't bad, and the inside is small but very clean.

name: Anika Greene
text: Very friendly staff and great gyros!!! Will be back!!

name: Brandon Terry
text: Lived in Europe for about five years as a kid and much like Italian food is a popular choice here, Greek cuisine was popular across the bloc. This is the most authentic gyro I have had in a long time with the best tsaziki sauce in Hampton Roads period. Service could be a bit quicker but it's worth the wait.

name: Matt
text: Traditional Gyro was really good. They are my 2nd favorite. Other favorite is in Va Beach.

name: Adam Cometti
text: Great gyro and awesome prices

name: Aylin D

name: Kenyatta Dailey
text: One of the better fast food burger and fries that I've had. Never bothered to get a gyro. I keep it simple and they don't disappoint.

name: amy currin
text: Love it. Fries and gyro delicious, Hot and fresh. Great prices. Enjoyed

name: Becky S.
text: Excellent, locally owned Gyros place. We understand that the family is a long standing restaurant owner. They have a very good product; more for take out or outside seating, as the interior space is limited.

name: Louella Lenwell
text: Food was so good and got. Little pricey but we'll worth it.

name: Donald Jones
text: Good food but very expensive

name: A W
text: These gyros are so good. The fries are even better.

name: Broken Throne
text: The food was amazing, the Gyro I had was juicy and really big, came with seasoned crisp fries and a drink. I also bought a cheese cake slice. The place is small but very homey, it also offers a drive through and a table with bar space to sit at. It does have outside seating as well. I was worried about coming here but I'm very pleased that I did! 10/10 recommendation!

name: Jordan
text: They have been here for a few years and I've never had a bad gyro.

name: S. C. Alfsen
text: My wife took me here for the first time and it was wonderful!  The meat was done perfectly, the flat bread was warm, the sauce was really flavorful and the veggies were fresh and crisp.  I can hardly wait to go again!

name: Devon Dodson
text: Burgers here are always fresh and the fries are AMAZING. The price isn't terrible but does feel a little steep especially if you dine in since the dining area is super small. Overall though great place to stop in for lunch

name: Erika
text: Mmmmm.... soooo good! Traditional Gyro all the way

resp.text: Thank you! Glad you enjoyed it.

name: Angela Hammond
text: Best gyros and desserts! Very quick service

name: Des Hall
text: This is the spot that makes you want to eat and sleep there. If you are looking for consistency in every bite this is the spot to eat. Every visit to Mr. Gyros & Burgers feels like a first time. Try it!!!

name: Michelle Morrison
text: Love Mr. Gyros! Rice bowls, appetizers (mushrooms, hummus, tzatziki, pomades) are all amazing!

name: Timothy Turner
text: I visit mr. Gyro Burger at least twice a month however on my most recent visit we encountered a problem with the order. Got home to find the wrong item in the bag. Called back to see to get this rectified. Did not want to go back out just wanted to get a credit for the wrong item. The manager / owner said sure no problem just make sure you save and bring back the wrong order. My response was what am I supposed to eat tonight. She said if you want the credit you have to bring back the food. It was a $26 order so I said fine. Got off the phone confused and said wait call back and said you know what I'll bring all your food back. Took the food back end of the tour through the drive-thru and all all of a sudden she wanted to try to be nice I said don't talk to me just give me my money have a nice day you don't have to worry about me again good customers are hard to come by nowadays she should take care of her customers it's not like the doors are being beat down. But she basically called me a thief. I will never return to this place again.

name: Karin Blanchard
text: Our first time here today.  We both ordered the Lamb Gyro, Traditional & BBQ. The food is made fresh from your order,  even the fries.   The restaurant itself looks really small inside so we ordered drive thru.  Please eat here, you will NOT be disappointed.

name: Ashley moore
text: Got the chicken gyro and the lamb gyro with baklava for dessert. The lamb was great ! The chicken one was okay. the chicken was a little tough and hard to chew with some pieces, however the last time I got it the chicken wasnt like that.... The baklava was pretty good one of the better ones I've had around here. 🙂

name: Nan Geshepat
text: Don't be fooled by this small restaurant. Delicious gyros with fresh lettuce, tomato and onions, good sized. They have different sauces and meats in fresh round bread that's folded. I also tried the felafels which were delicious too in their sauce. Look up their menu that also has burgers, rice bowls, cheesecakes and baklava. Outdoor tables and drive thru too.

name: Benjamin Hinant
text: Love gyro's. The young man behind the counter was as nice as he could be. The fries and gyro where excellent. Best I've ever had. We also got baklava and it was delicious. We will be back!

name: Joey Waggoner
text: Food was amazing perfect portion fries are great.

name: Chateau Jones
text: Best burger I have had in a long time.

name: Promise B.
text: Awesome food

name: Samuel Mabry
text: Very good gyros

name: What's Up Eddie
text: Terrific Staff, Amazing food

name: crystal benning
text: The food is awesome

name: Rodney Reid
text: First time there.... will not be the last. Went with my nephew and had the best gyro I've had in years! Fries are great too. Do yourself a favor and check them out

name: Same Different
text: Best customer service. Food is always fresh and portion size is just right. Ive never had and issue and love this place for a real gyros! Its a little spot but great place to get something great to eat in Denbiegh Newport News area.

name: Daniel Moore
text: Great place! Wonderful Gyros! And their salads are always fresh and well mixed. This has become a bit of a go to because I know the food will always be great and the staff is always very nice.

name: Chris Allen
text: Gyros are pretty good. Ordered a burger all the way but didn't have any ketchup or sauce on it.

name: Bill Pollitz
text: Always a great choice when you're in the mood for a good gryo.  So many places try to make them and fail, but Mr. Gyros gets them right.  Fast and affordable with a friendly and professional staff you can't go wrong.  I love the gyros and the lamb burgers.

name: Geoff Wilson
text: I can tell you that without a doubt I'd like to come here again. Best lamb gyros in NN that I've had yet and very friendly service.  They've surprisingly been around for 2 years too, just because they're harder to notice from the road. While they've got multiple picnic tables outside for seating, inside is only able to sit like 10 tops, almost all around window bar stools. Prices are reasonable and the quality is definitely worth it.  Love those special crispy fries too.

name: Dominique Longo
text: Delicious food and friendly staff!

name: lolita lewis
text: The food was delicious and came out pretty quickly. Service was friendly. Glad I tried it.

name: Donny Reynoso
text: Presentation, Service, Cleanliness, Speed: Five stars; Gyro gets a 4.5, tried the one with fries and the dry crunchiness of the fries kinda take away the balanced moisture of the beef/lamb. Def would try again in my visit here to Newport news

name: Keith Countis
text: Gyro was packed full of meat, veggies were fresh, friendly service

name: Kim Delaney
text: Excellent gyro. Fries were great and refills on the sofa. The young man who took our order was friendly and helpful. Thank you Ian.

name: Thomas Borland
text: 3rd visit and it was delicious. I've only had the Gyros, but they are on point every time!!! Nice little place, good food, and nice staff.

resp.text: I am very sorry you had a bad experience. However, on each gyro we sell we weigh the gyro meat to ensure that it is the same for each customer as consistency is important. text: This place was lovely! A small place with great food. Not too crowded and staff was very friendly. Food was quick as well. They surprised us with a complimentary dessert which we appreciated! Thanks for the great meal!

name: Robert Wilson
text:
Simple menu, yes. But the depth provides a great variety with done really tasty options. There is always an option to add spice and such, but not dll gifs need this. Vietnamese cuisine died not need fire and spice, but the flavor varieties make this style of food a really good choice. The flavors dance around the mouth, with a final flavor touch hooting after the food has cleared the mouth.
This restaurant has only one draw back, being in a city (of sorts) parking can be difficult. Walking a block or two is rewarded with a great place to eat, good service, and right now knowing that you have supported a small business.
Go and enjoy.

name: Aleah Larson
text: Excellent food, hit the spot for Vietnamese craving.  Restaurant has a nice ambiance, feels nicer than your typical plaza stop.  The bun was warm, which was nice, in my limited experience, I feel like the noodles are often served room temp or even a little cold.   The bubble tea is really sweet (too sweet and syrupy for my taste but my kids were the ones enjoying it) and the shrimp chips and custard dessert are very lovely complimentary additions.

name: Jono Kenyon
text:
Fan-frickin-tastic! Why have I not been here before the past week?! I'll tell you why, because I've been a loyalist to Bale Family Bakery and Pho Sate in Falls Church. I just always went with what I knew, and never looked back.

What a disservice I did to myself. To have this gem, less that half a mile from the house is a game changer.

Very easy and relatable menu, nothing too crazy, but a great variety and good for those looking to delve in Vietnamese cuisine, without going overboard.

Pho is solid. Fantastic broth. Limited choice of selections, yet still ticks all the boxes.

Great shaky beef.great spring and summer rolls.

Dumplings are awesome, super filling and thin skinned.

Shrimp toast is awesome.

The grilled pork is worth the price of admission alone.

Looking forward to workingt5througj more of the menu, especially the bun bo hue.

The shrimp crackers and complimentary creme caramel/flan are a really nice touch.

Service is good, not hovering, yet attentive.

Reasonably priced.

Do it if you haven't already. You won't regret it. Support you local!

name: Rebecca Lee
text:
This was one of the most authentic, flavorful and delicious Vietnamese restaurants that we’ve ever been to. Totally a hidden gem in Fairfax.

They gave out shrimp chips as an appetizer. We both had the lunch specials with the garden rolls, which were excellent. Peanut sauce was good. The vermicelli bowl was, quote from my better half, “the best I’ve ever had.”
The pho broth was clean and perfectly refreshing even on a summer day. They gave us complementary caramel flan for dessert - perfect size. I also had a Vietnamese iced coffee, which was really good.

Customer service was amazing. Definitely coming back here again. We’ve been to a lot of Vietnamese restaurants in VA but this one has made it to the top of our list!

text: I recently visited this place with friends for dinner and turned out to be pretty decent. Thai iced tea was not as expected. We tried the basil shrimp appetizer, we liked it. I got the chicken lemongrass and I found it to be a little on the sweeter side. My friend got the curry chicken and it was a delicious dish. The staff is pretty friendly and the interiors are decent. They gave us flan on the house, it was really sweet of them. The tofu pho and lemongrass pho were okayish. Overall a decent place to dine in.

name: Sean Crook
text:
Cloudy with a Chance of Pho

East Wind offered me a delicious reprieve from the cold, rainy day. The expansive menu offers authentic cuisine while managing to add their own personality and flair. The egg noodle pho is personally the best I've ever had; and I just got back from Hanoi. Quail and dumplings in the broth may not be the most traditional but all Vietnamese restaurants must take note. It's a nearly perfect Asian fusion.

The atmosphere may be sparse on the inside with wide berths between tables (such a contrast from Vietnam) but the few pleasantries do add a touch of character.

Those wishing to satisfy any craving for real-deal Vietnamese cuisine - spring rolls, bun cha, and the pho, let the wind whisk you to downtown Fairfax for a delicious (ngon) dine.

name: JENNIFER KEEN
text: This Vietnamese Restaurant has extremely class act young people running the place when the owner is not around. The food is always fresh and delicious. They serve little custard after dinner if you are as nice to them as they are to you. It is a little gem of a restaurant in the heart of Fairfax City Main Street.  We love to come here to eat before going to the Cinema Arts Theatre.  Everything is delicious!

name: Rachel Brumback
text:
My favorite restaurant in Fairfax! We come here at least once a week. Everything is so delicious you really can't go wrong. For appetizers, our favorites are the EastWind Shrimp special and the rare beef carpaccio. For entrees, we usually rotate around between the crispy shrimp and squid, the beef wrapped in grape leaves, and the spicy beef hue soup! The pho here is amazing too though! The desserts are always delicious too... the caramel flan always has the perfect texture, the mango sticky rice is so unexpectedly enjoyable, and the fried bananas and ice cream is awesome too. Service is always super friendly and attentive.

I would upload more photos... but I'm usually so excited about the food I dig in and clean the plate before I remember to take my phone out. It's THAT GOOD.

Please do yourself a favor and come here, you won't regret it.

text:
I am confident in saying that EastWind is my favorite Vietnamese Restaurant in Virginia. Great service and great food. Portion sizes are pretty good and they even have shrimp chips as a free appetizer; I have not seen any other Vietnamese restaurant offer such a thing!
Strongly recommend coming to this place at least once if you like Vietnamese food.

name: Carol McCloskey
text: Nice little Vietnamese restaurant on Main Street in Fairfax City just east of the old Courthouse.  Of course they serve pho with all sorts of meat.  They also have spring rolls and vegetable rolls (I really like their sauce, I think it's a peanut sauce).  They also serve plates of lemongrass sauteed with your choice of meat or those thin rice noodles with meat.  Unexpectedly, they serve a small flan with a caramel sauce at the end of your meal.  The service is great.  Free parking is around the corner or a block away, but it is well worth the walk.

text: The atmosphere is clean, bright, and yet cozy.  They give you shrimp crackers with pepper sauce on the table as a free appetizer.  The service was good, and the Egg Noodle Soup is the best soup I have had at any Asian restaurant!  I recommend getting it with the red pork.

You are started out with shrimp crackers and some home made chili paste and a chili paste reduction with olive oil. There is plenty of seating as the building as very deep. Public parking is your best bet.

name: Tr Tr
text: A western looking saloon outside, cozy modern yet airy VNmese style inside, I was surprised to find this restaurant. Perhaps it is a new place. I was looking for the VNmese sandwiches place, Natalie's banh mi, and stumbled upon this. Tried the seafood noodle soup, but I ordered it dry (soup on the side). The dry version is not on the menu, but since it is a common dish the waiter said he will ask the kitchen to prepare it so. I kept my fingers crossed since most places make the dish bland, for they only prepared it as soup dish or didn't make the proper sauce to eat with it.  Eastwind did it right! I was please. The taste is still not full flavor as some places, but it is also fresh and well balanced.  They brought out fried cake (bánh phồng tôm) as appetizer for free! This is akin to breads in steakhouse. Pleasant surprise there. 4 stars because I don't know how the other menu items tasted, but if this dish is any indication, they most likely as good and authentic. I'm keep the last star for final judgement. Oh also the staff is a bit aloof. I guessed they were trained not to interrupt your meals as other places often do.

Our go-to Pho place in Fairfax. I prefer this place to Viet House (about a mile away). The inside has a bit more ambiance, and they have well priced lunch special with entree/app and soft drink. They have good service, and split our kids Pho into two bowls when we mentioned they would be sharing it (honestly, each half-portion bowl looked more "full" than "half"). Most places when we say that, they dont even bring out a 2nd empty bowl for us, and we have to remind them and then split it ourselves between the two bowls. They also gave us two free Flan desserts at the end. (honestly, they probably did this because it was a slow time (we were there at 3 PM) .On a busy day, i doubt they can give out free desserts).

If you're in downtown FFX on Main st, and want some good Pho with good service, this is the place.

text:
Staff was nice and order was ready on time and accurate are the only good things here. Ordered three pizza's (mediums) and a spaghetti for my daughter. ALL THREE pizza's were completely burnt and black on the bottom, we couldn't even enjoy them because of the overpowering burnt taste. My daughter also refused to eat the spaghetti because it smelled and tasted like "bad cheese" (her words, not mine). Would not recommend this place, sad to see a local restaurant serving ruined food.

**updated 2/7/21. Owner never responded to emails and requests to try again. Very disappointed in this business and response.

resp.text:
Brittany, thank you for your review and my deepest apologies for the overcooking of those pizzas. That’s not at all ok. The cheese we use on the spaghetti is a 9 month aged pecorino that we shave right off of the wheel and it might have a bit more “funk” than she was into but I can assure you that freshness is everything here. If you’d be kind enough to contact me directly here at Wild Wood, at the very least, I’d like to get you refunded for the let down of an experience. Please either call me, 703-443-1600, or email, Curtis@WildWoodPizzeria.com so we can get this rectified for you. Again, thank you for the review and I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Curtis Allred
Owner

name: Thomas Morrow
text:
We ordered takeout and it was ok, I think there was a mix up-our sand andreas pizza is spicy? Has like a weird chipotle taste. The caesar salad was ok, but in the same bag as our meatball appetizer got warm salad. The meatballs were ok. The dinner value was on par with the area. Not sure if the pizza was a mixup, but it had to be based on other reviews.

2 stars for atmosphere and speed

resp.text: Mr. Morrow, thank you for your review and I apologize we let you down. The San Andreas is made with our pepperoni sauce and it is a bit more spicy than a classic red sauce. We can always make that substitution in the future so it isn’t so spicy. Your note about meatballs in the same bag as a salad is a huge training opportunity for our team and not at all where we want to be. I’d love to have another opportunity to better prepare that meal for you in the future. Please ask for me when you call in and I will personally ensure it’s is flawless for you. Again, thank you. Curtis Allred-Owner

name: Pia Miranda
text: We're so glad we were able to stop by. It's such a cool place. The decor remind us of our childhood in Chicago, tasteful organized graffiti (yeah, yeah, we know it's NY). We came a little after lunch so it was quiet but we were so hungry and excited to eat that we forgot to take a bunch of pics. The lunch special is such a great deal, you really can't beat it. Salad, pizza and a drink for $8.50. Of course I pick a meatball topping a nod to the now closed balls of glory and the meatball was great as usual, now if I can get that Rosemary sauce on that pizza I may be addicted, who cares about being lactose intolerant! The Ceasar salad was fresh and crisp as always with a generous amount of cheese. My husband got the same with sausage topping, he didn't share but I'm sure it's good. We can't wait to go back for a full size pizza. Now for the service... Our server was great, funny thorough and attentive, couldn't ask for anything better. Overall such a great experience.

name: matthew Magee
text:
Our fav pizza place in the area is Fireworks. After visiting Wild Wood, I have to say this is prob our new fav pizza place.
The ingredients are fresh, the menu is big, and the beer selection is amazing. Adam, the bartender, is great. He surprised me with a concoction of his own (peach/blueberry mixture). I asked for the peanut butter cup and he recommended leaving that until the end. I'm glad he did; it was more of an after dinner beer.
The music is different but good; a lot of old school stuff.
We will definitely be back. Try the lamb meatballs, they are amazing!

name: Cory Laws
text: I'd met Curtis online through friends. My wife is from Western NY, and very picky about pizza. We were going to Delirium, another of his restaurants, and I decided we should try Wild Wood too. It was her birthday, and pizza would be the perfect comfort food to enjoy while staying in. We got Margherita and San Andreas pizzas, a caesar salad and meatballs. The pizzas were done perfectly, with a crispy crust that you could pick up folded with no sag. The salad was good, but the meatballs stood out. My wife didn't know that meatballs were a specialty, and the key staple of Balls of Glory that he'd also founded. A great combination.

text: I loved the atmosphere, colors, art (they even have Bansky), and we were welcomed by a nice smile. We ordered the Sunday Family Dinner that included a house salad, marinated olives, a 16” two topping pizza, and a sunday. We didn’t wait long when our pizza came out. Sadly before our salad and olives. They apologized and said it was a computer error. I wanted to cancel the meal but they gave us the salad and had the olives put in a to-go box. They ended up giving us a discount for the mistake. Great beer selection. The food wasn’t out of this world, but something to satisfy a NY style pizza craving.

text: Delicious pizza with some funky flavors makes a great destination in the Village at Leesburg. Highly recommend them, I am looking forward to seeing them open for lunch soon, too

name: Michael Walsh
text: Must stop for pizza and beer! This place has an incredible lineup of tap beers and the pizzas taste great. My wife likes their salads too and I always order the olives. Twice we have had Kara as our server and she was great!

name: Vin 0000
text: Great atmosphere and Melissa was super. Try the margherita pizza! It was on point.

name: Phil Sproat
text: Esthetics are ok, music was loud and all 90’s rap.  Beer selection is strong.  Started with the marinated olives, served with with pizza crust on the side, the appetizer was confusing and salty.  Pizza came out, hand formed, looked interesting.  Unfortunately the crust does not hold up under the sauce and grease from the cheese, so the outer ring was good, but the crust was a fail if it was covered in product.  The Margherita pizza was bland and we could not get the servers attention to bring over some spices.  So, if 4 beers and 2 10” pizzas for $70 and the experience as described fits your bill, then give it a try.

resp.text: Phil, thanks for your review and detailed feedback. We will take it to heart and use it to improve some of those missteps in the pizzas. -Curtis

name: Mathew Hailey
text: Absolutely fantastic pizza.   Better than Fireworks...  Yup I said it.  Only their 1st day open ....  Ignore the 1 negative review.

name: John Carnevale
text: Nice place. Food was delicious. They also server the best beer Tucher! I will be back!!

name: Brian
text: Pretty good pizza and amazing beer selection.

name: Trenton Pallone
text: Pizza was great. As always.

name: Ronnie Kegley
text: Absolutely a great hometown restaraunt with fantastic home cooking . Very customer friendly wait staff that makes you feel right at home with the feeling of walking back in time with the way the inside is decorated from the employees making you feel so comfortable to the black and white tile floor to a juke box . Wide variety of food on the menu with excellant choices . If you like fish , try the catfish dinner , excellant . Highly recommend , will be delighted .

name: Whitney Parks
text: Can't wait to see what else this establishment has to offer!! Great food! Good people!

name: Chris Santangelo
text: Great food at a reasonable price

name: Tony Reed
text: Great food might take a few minutes to get , but well worth the wait.

name: Gloria Falin
text: Good old timing eating

name: Angelea Russell
text: Glad to see it back in operation it has been a staple n the area for fifty + years

name: Jw Sudduth
text: Awesome after a long walk

name: Sabrina Stallard
text: Nasty

name: Robert Wilder
text: Pretty good.

name: Rodney Hurd
text: Super place to eat!

name: Susan Moore
text: First time at this location. Beautiful setting. Open walls and umbrella seating. Right on the marina and lots of boats. Cool breeze off the water. Good food except our fries were luke warm. Food arrived rather quickly. Our waitress was very attentive.

name: Carr Hibbard
text: We have eaten here many times over many years. Love the blackened tuna, the crab cakes, the calamari, and everything else we have had. The hush puppies are delicious. A great place to get a smaller serving of delicious seafood for a very reasonable price. Feels healthy. We always sit outside and love watching the birds and the boats. An easy place to take kids for dinner.

name: Denny DoesWork
text: This is a great place to eat. The shrimp appetizer is great. Crab cakes some of the best in town. Poboy’s are really good - made me appreciate that kind of sandwich more. The bay burger is great for a big appetite. Boat access. You can order straight from the dock.

name: Francis Bacon
text: Very good service by the wait staff. The food was better than I have had in a long time!  The food  portions were very generous, plan on taking some home with you.

name: Gina Lynch
text: Docked the boat and had a nice Father’s Day dinner. Hush puppies are great.  Their steamed Broccoli 🥦 with cheese sauce is perfect addition to the seafood.

name: Brian Lundstrom
text: Great food, excellent service, safe practices including masks, hand sanitizer, and plenty of distance between tables.  Would have given 5 star were it not for the owner's peculiar decision to play music via Pandora with commercials!  Heard the same 3 dumb commercials over and over while dining.  Very tacky; not what I want or expect when eating out.

name: Stacy Ralbovsky
text: Great food, friends and fun!!!

name: Take charge
text: I went in, asked for a table and was told it was closed due to weather. Only to see lots of people inside eating and people waiting outside to get in. Then watched people go in as I was waiting for my friend to show up so we could find another place. I guess I'm not one of the cool kids. I'm a member of the marina and I tip well but I was still treated like I wasn't welcome there. It's sad this type of stereotyping still takes place in this day and age.

name: KA Darnell
text: CLOSED FOR THE SEASON despite saying open. Call before you go!!!!!!

name: Robert Rogers
text: This is my favorite surf-rider restaurant. I used to keep my boat at Marina Shores and it was lovely to come here and eat after a day on the water. I think surf-rider may have the best crab cakes in Hampton Roads. This location is especially unique because it's open to the outside so you can dine almost directly on the water.

name: Jim Brewer
text: We enjoyed lunch here. Most of the food was quite good but the shrimp was a little rubbery and the fish somewhat dry.

name: Steven Hankins
text: Love the crab cakes. Great place to check out. Has outdoor eating over the water.

name: Vanessa Coria
text: Always DEEEE-lish!

name: Laurie Wood
text: Take out order     Service and food were great.

name: Ellen Crawford
text: Great atmosphere, service, and food.

name: Joseph Hammer
text: This place knows how to cook some good seafood! I would definitely eat here all the time if I could! Also the service here was great! Felt like we were right at home and we had a big party for one person to handle. She dd great!

name: David Vigil
text: Great seafood, great service, the crab dip is the best

name: Nick Mullins
text: The food was great and reasonably priced. If you like alcoholic drinks their Rum Runner is amazing. The staff was friendly and the service was great.

name: Dona Oldfield
text: Loved our crabcake and broccoli lunch - always a family favorite! It was a gorgeous day to have lunch at Surf Rider's open air restaurant at Marina Shores. Great breezes and views. Always terrific service and food.

name: Brandon Parr
text: Great marina-side restaurant with beautiful views and open air seating. Food is delicious, priced well, and comes in huge servings on most dishes. The waiters and waitresses are very good and give you quick service. Rum runner drink is a must to try!

name: Kelly Stenger
text: We love Surf Rider.  The food is always the best.  The only suggestion I have for management is to PLEASE upgrade your cocktail selection.  We've never been pleased with anything but the frozen specialty drinks, and I dont typically want to drink a frozen lemonade with my excellent seafood.  Add some crushes, margaritas, etc.

name: Iam Natalya
text: They have the best mojitos & crab legs! & when your done you can take a nice stroll down the marina

name: Kyle Manning
text: Good seafood...great atmosphere...great service

name: Ginny Shrimplin
text: Had another grwat meal. Service is always the best. Love those Rum Runners!

name: Don Gratton
text: Tough parking with next door construction. Great food service was good. Open air though.

name: DoubleX
text: Great food and service.

name: Paul McPherson
text: Good food, friendly staff and great ambiance

name: Debra Sunday
text: This is the place to go for seafood.  We went to the one off of Shore Road next to the Yacht Club. We sat outside and had a view of the yachts while eating.  I will definitely go back the next time I'm in Virginia Beach.

name: Pat Lowery
text: It's lovely to dine with a view of the marina. The wait staff is always friendly and knowledgeable. The crab cakes are the best I've ever had, all crab, very very little filler. Portions are well sized, and the seafood is well prepared. My girlfriends and I eat here at least once a month during their season. We switch to the Oceana location during the winter months.

name: David R. VanDinter
text: Way over priced and the food was basic. Served at tables next to the water on cheap plates  $155 for 6 people and we left hungry. Needless to say that this place is nothing more that overpriced white privilege. Dont waste your time or money.

name: Sade Graham
text: I've gone to this place about three times. The crab dip is amazing! The drinks are very tasty. Try the the strawberry lemonade! The staff was great and the service was as well. I have only been on Friday, and it gets pretty packed. Nice environment to go to with friends.

name: Heidi Grass
text: Fried shrimp not overcooked. Crabcake was good. Little to no filler. Good service. Great crab dip. Lovely view if marina. Just know that even the inside is outside. If it's hot outside, it will be hot everywhere. It was a beautiful might when we went.

name: Sharon Layden
text: Pricey but good! The rum runner drinks are SO good!!  Of course they're known for their crabcakes as they should be. Its all meat, no filler. The appetizer of calamari was also delish. Service is fast and they were packed!! Laid back atmosphere,  its all open and has a beach feel.  You can get away with shorts,  jeans or a little dressier with khackis or a dress.  Either way its good food and I will be back!

name: Michael G Antolak
text: Real good good food - had the black an blue tuna wrap - and great service!

name: Chuck Mehle
text: Their rum runners are amazing. Great food and atmosphere. Service is very good and pleasant people

name: D H
text: Good food,drinks and wait staff.nice atmosphere

name: Jacob Jackson
text: The food was delicious.  Our server was very attentive and brought us everything we asked for, sometimes before we even asked.  The only thing keeping me from giving 5 stars is that the place was very noisy; probably the loudest place I've dined for quite a while.

name: Macintosh Monday
text: The worst place I’ve every been the food was cold and it was too loud and it took for ever to get something this place is not kid friendly. The burger was under cooked the fan made it to cold in there I hated with a passion will not be back

name: Gwen Gadson
text: Good food.  On the pier. Beautiful view

name: Karen Laidler
text: Beautiful setting and great music..Lewis rocks ❤

name: Patsy Schutte
text: We enjoyed dining on the deck.  The broiled scallops were tender and delicious.  The menu is varied with offerings of seafood, pasta, steaks, burgers, etc.

name: Abbey Pachter
text: My fab place for a crabcake. Best in town.

name: Emily Davis
text: This is the best location, the food and drinks are amazing and the view is nice

name: John Phillips
text: Surf rider great food perfect weather good view  outside and wait staff was good. Always another good experience!!!

name: Brandy Mae Hartman
text: Great view, atmosphere, and food! Manager stopped by to greet, bartenders were attentive, food was perfectly cooked. This summer there will be bands. Feels like a vacation destination.

name: Brian Henry
text: Just not great at all. So so fish tacos. Asked 3x to multiple servers for a water which I never received. Avoid this place at all costs.

name: Colleen Drinkard
text: The flounder was fabulous and so were the frozen rum rumners!

name: anita parker
text: Delicious food!  Last night I enjoyed the lump crab and shrimp in butter, hush puppies, baked potato, and slaw.  Thank you again, King Neptune!

name: Michael Conte
text: Very good food, strong drinks. The best part is it is tucked away from the main part of town behind a marina. Great atmosphere, great vibes.

name: Brad MacLeod
text: Had a wedding party here and they were great, they let us set up a area on the patio and were able to handle the 14 top with no problem. Food and drinks were delicious, this is not my first time here, just first review, but the food, drinks and service are always great.

name: Jon Soares
text: Marina Shores location: good seafood great views and cocktails

name: James V Carlton Jr
text: Cold drinks, great seafood, fabulous water side seating. You'll enjoy every aspect of this landmark resturaunt, especially the crab cakes and fried butterflied shrimp. You got to give it a try!

name: Valentine Wendy
text: The view is nice. Great food and service!! Rum Runners rock.

name: Claudio Caprio
text: Great food cold beer superb service. We hrld our monthly East Beach men's bookclub mtg there. No,complaints. Accomodated 16 of us

name: Anne Masterson
text: Great meal, great view, great service!

name: Jim Shields
text: Love this place.  The food is excellent, try the Hot Crab Dip with mini pita rounds and order a Rum Runner to wash it all down with but watch out for the rum in that first drink (they fill the straw with rum bfore serving the drink)!

name: adam garrett1603
text: Great atmosphere with the indoor and outdoor setup. Crab cake and the peel and eat shrimp were good as well as the service.

name: sean lacroix
text: Best atmosphere on shore drive.   Food good.  Get the hush puppies

name: Edith Roth
text:
It was a very pleasant lunch   food was good
staff  very helpful

name: Sammy Peachy
text: Great view, nice staff and plenty of food to pick on the menu!

name: Mary Jsckson
text: Sea food at it's best.  Service exceptional.

name: Sonja Bruns
text: Cute spot,  good food, nice staff,  not open after summer season

name: Jill Savage
text: Always delish food and love eating outside by the water. Great gathering place.

name: jdedredhed
text: Everything was delicious. My only complaint is, out of my six raw oysters, four were broken. Not sure if it was a shucker in training, or their blade was dull, but it makes raw oysters difficult to enjoy.

name: Scott Cole
text: Great for boat side outdoor dining.

name: Trasea Mundy
text: Must try all their location's, each quite unique

name: Kay Cook
text: The best seafood around.

name: Valentin Ivanov
text: Very nice place. Great food and drinks.

name: Michaeline Yarnell
text: The food was on point and the size of the servings were so large I have another lunch and dinner. Mariah was our server and she was phenomenal!!!!

name: Paul
text: What happens when growth is good for the owner, quality of product goes down. we used to frequent this establishment, time out, and move on

name: Connie Napolitano
text: Outstanding Seafood great shrimp cooked to perfection, a must to try.

name: Tony McCormick
text: Love this place. Best rum runner in the world

name: David Roberts
text: Good food great staff. No Guinness tho!

name: Lavelle E
text: Great food, great portions, and consistent quality.

name: Kennon Poynter
text: Don't go there with a large party. They cannot accommodate. They made us wait 1.5hrs and we gave up.  We had 3 kids 5 and under. Disaster!

name: Mary Balcher
text: Great food and scenery

name: Nick Papageorgio
text: Best crab cakes ever!!!

name: Kevin Kratzer
text: Great time with friends.

name: Susan Shortridge
text: All the food came out cold. Waited for refill on drinks for 15 min. Waitress was to friendly. 😐

name: Brian Langley
text: Crab cakes.... seriously, their crab cakes!

name: Ty Nelson
text: Good drinks and food. Drinks are WAY over priced.

name: Jim “Birdman” McGavran
text: Awesome!!!

name: Kristin Twine
text: Get the rum runner!

name: Terrell Perry
text: Great meal tonight.

name: elwood gordon
text: Great place.

name: Lotus Thomas
text: Noisy

name: David Meadows
text: Wonderful Marina views and great food.

name: Ruthie Faris
text: Good Location, food is mediocre

name: Tonya Bose
text: Loud but good

name: Roy White
text: Ok, little pricy

name: Rich Goodboy
text: Rum runners​

name: Joe Gallop Sr (Tahoua)
text: Great tuna steak.

name: Terry GROFF
text: Rum runners,tuna bites

name: Brent Farrell
text: Good seafood

name: Rae M.
text:
Quite a pleasant surprise for Luray. Small, cozy eatery. Plenty of brunch options for any palate.

Street parking.

name: NRC
text: Had breakfast here. Amazing fresh food - eggs Benedict w ham and Shrimp & grits. Beautiful presentation. Lovely waitress. Highly recommended.

name: Amrit S
text: Really rude lady at the front who told us our party of 7 with a corgi could not be accommodated outside. She said "You can get rid of the dog and come sit inside." We said we can't get rid of the dog... It says dog friendly patio in the information online. She said she didn't even have 7 chairs to seat us outside. (There were 4 open tables with 2 chairs each). We said we wouldn't mind sitting separately. She did not seem keen on having us dine there. Then, as we walked away, she changed her mind and tried to get us to come back. No thanks though. Please update your info if you don't like dogs.

name: Jeff Stewart
text: Great food, attentive service and limited menu. Atmosphere seated on porch made a pleasant evening. Seating inside appeared comfortable.

name: Brian Miller
text: Fantastic venue. The food was very tasty and beautifully plated from the appetizers through dessert!! Would recommend for anyone Traveling to or through Luray; date night, birthdays, anniversaries, or just a yummy dinner!!!

name: Angela
text: The dumplins and crab cakes are awesome, the kids chicken tenders are also a recommendation even for adults yum

name: Knicholas Kennedy
text: Out in the middle of nowhere and you cannot ask for better food. Service is amazing, and fast. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The bread was local sourced and honestly good enough to steal. I would recommend this place even if it was in NYC that’s how stiff of a competitor it is!

resp.text: Thank you Knicholas - hope we see you again at Moonshadows

name: Eric Johnson
text:
Absolute must go to restaurant if you're passing through. I had a BBQ Turkey Reuben that was amazing for $7. The eggs Benedict were amazing as were the cheese shrimp and grits.

I cannot say enough good things about this place. The facility inside and out was clean and very nice. The service was top shelf. Give them a try!

name: Emma Q
text: Decent spot. Tons of mushrooms in the fungi pasta BUT the chicken was a bit burn from grill. No biggie. My bf had the burger and he enjoyed his meal.

name: Danny Oliveri
text: I loved every second of my experience. Reservations were made online, very easily. I received a text to confirm, and a reminder text the day of, which I thought was nice. We arrived a little early, but were seated right away. The staff was very friendly, and the atmosphere was incredible. My wife and I chose this place for a weekend getaway to celebrate our anniversary, and we felt like it was a perfect place for a couple to relax, and have dinner. We weren't rushed to order drinks, or food, it was nice to be able to enjoy everything without someone asking if we were ok every 5 minutes. Truthfully, it may have been the first time a didn't have to answer a server with a mouth full of food, which was perfect. I have absolutely nothing bad to say about the place, and fully intend to return next time we're in town.

name: Kenny Fallon
text: Very nice place my wife and I enjoyed our meals delicious and staff very friendly

name: Craig Emping
text: This is by far my favorite Restuarant in  Luray, Va.  Love the old Victorian Setting, Had my Easter Dinner their and then some! The food was cooked to perfection! My Waitress Dria was superb! Wore her out asking questions and going back and forth  to the kitchen and bar checking on things I had asked bout on a rating from  1-10, 10 being the highest she was a 20! If you are planning on going to Luray, this is the place to go for breakfast, lunch or dinner! Wil be going back many times more!

name: Shane Denmark
text: A beautifully orchestrated meal with local wines (ox eye riesling was delicious!), local beef, vegetables and delicate spices from around the globe. Easily one of the most flavor-filled meals that I have had in a while.   A must try if in the area.

name: Nancy Boyer
text: A culinary delight in a warm and inviting atmosphere.  A fantastic menu,  delightful, attentive staff and a BIG 5 rating!

name: Matt Powell
text:
When you walk in the front door it hits like home...well if home is an incredibly designed space. Color, texture  and ambiance! Service is efficient, proficient and unobtrusive. Cameron did a great job!!
The food: Color, texture, flavors subtle and bold. A pleasure to the eye and your taste buds!!!
There are few places I would drive an hour and a half to enjoy, Moonshadows is one !!!!

name: Howard Isenberg
text: Nice dining atmosphere, grouper very good

name: Chris
text: Service was full of good intentions but it was a long wait for water, another long wait for a glass of wine, despite very few patrons. Food was tasty but smaller portions for a considerable price. Probably not going to return.

name: Maziar Momeni
text: We got there during the brunch rush, and waited a short while for a table outside. Once seated we were given water and soon after fruit and scones. That was a nice treat. The menu had really good options and the food was beautifully presented and rated just as good. The burgers, pasta carbonara, and Spanish frittata were hot, delicious and beautiful. The kitchen and wait staff knocked this one out of the park. It's also a wonderful little place with great decor. We'll definitely go back!

name: Sheila Johnson
text: The entirety of our visit was awesome. The choice of table location, to the food, and service - all was spot on! Essence was a great server too. The food portions were perfect, well prepared, delicious, and we ate every morsel! We'd certainly return when in the area.

name: Carly Moore
text: If you are looking for a glass of wine and good atmosphere it’s a lovely place. Food is very overpriced. Costs 9$ to add 4 pieces of medium shrimp to a very small salad. Also they were out of a lot of things. The crab rolls were okay but they ran out of crab and used what seemed like one piece of medium shrimp cut up between 4 rolls and the rest was lettuce. We were seated first but other tables were served first.

name: Drew Brown
text: In February 2020, I visited this cute place while visiting Luray for my birthday. The experience I had here was exactly what I was hoping for, a humble southern meal and hospitable staff, in a comfortable relaxed environment. Very happy with the decision to eat here, it added to my great birthday in Luray!

name: Emily LeCompte
text: Moonshadows is a wonderful local restaurant in Luray. The staff was knowledgeable and welcoming. The restaurant boasts a delicious seasonal menu with fresh, quality ingredients. We enjoyed the BBQ shrimp and cheddar grits, the lamb pita, baklava, and Moonshadows Pie (a gingerbread and lemon treat). All of it was absolutely delicious. The cheddar grits and shrimp were among the best I’ve ever had! The Moonshadows Pie was amazing - combining gingerbread and lemon (two of my favorite flavors) in such an unexpectedly delightful way. We can’t wait to come back in the summer to enjoy a whole new menu!

name: Spenser Villwock
text: Vegan options at this thoughtful restaurant.  Reasonable prices and great service.

name: Benjamin Chartier
text: Good food and good service. Nice place for dinner for Date night.

name: Jason Hall
text: Great environment to have dinner. Good wine and beer list. The beer could have been a bit colder. The artichoke parsnip dip was not good at all. Tasted a bit like baby food. The Rabbit mushroom cannelloni was really good but was a small portion for the price. The oil used for the table bread could use some type of spice or seasoning added to it. Service was quick as well as the food preparation.

name: Robert Czarneski
text: Excellent dinner Small menu, but great tasting food. Great atmosphere, very friendly staff...

name: Carrie A
text: It's in a pretty setting. The food is fresh. The crab thai spring rolls weren't crab...fishy taste and smell gave it away. It was so fishy tasting/smelling, I couldnt eat it. The red snapper was good, but not great...not very flavorful but cooked well.

resp.text: At Moonshadows we only use fresh ingredients. The Thai rolls are are made fresh on a daily basis and we never hold them over to the next day. We only use quality fresh crabmeat in them. This is the first comment we have had that was not positive about the Thai rolls. I am sorry they were not to you liking. The snapper was also fresh. I am sorry that too was not to your liking. The sauce that topped it was a Veracruze sauce made with tomatoes, peppers, onions, olives and garlic witch seemed quite flavorful when I tasted it. Maybe you were expecting something with more spicy heat to it. I sincerely hope you return and try us again.

name: Colin Taylor
text: Truly top class restaurant. Elegantly prepared and balanced dishes. Superior service

name: Joseph Rahtelli
text: Great food. Great service.  Well run.

name: Christie Thompson
text: Great food and lovely atmosphere, got the crab cakes and they were delicious

name: Peter El Hashem
text: Fantastic service and delicious food abound in this cozy little spot in Luray! We showed up and my lady forgot to get reservations. The hostess made us very comfortable while we waited and even served us a bottle of wine when we waited for an available table. This place was extremely pleasant and welcoming I will most definitely be returning!

name: Joann Herring
text: Service and food was really good

name: M&K B
text: Good food, great service, nice atmosphere.  We dropped in without reservations (recommended) with a party of seven on a Sunday evening of a holiday weekend and were able to be seated almost immediately.  Despite being warned our food may take a little longer than desired, it was delivered fairly promptly.  Only think keeping us from giving it five stars was that food for several orders was warm at best, bordering on being cold.  The food temp was probably attributable in part to all the main courses being served at once (good thing, but they were clearly ready at different stages) AND the fact that we were eating outside on an early fall evening.

name: Kris Adams
text: Even though there are fewer customers, the service is lacking and the food was not cooked to order. Their signature dessert the moonpie cake is just ok. It's texture is coarse and it lacks any defining character. It's ok.

name: Adam Wirdzek
text: Awesome food. Good atmosphere. They also have innovative vegetarian options. Luray definitely needed this place.

name: Tom Tran
text: Service is a bit slow, and portion sizes were a bit small for the price. The dishes however were perfectly cooked and very tasty! Strongly recommend this place if you are in the area.

name: Rosemary Rhew
text: Everything was five-star, the food, the friendly efficient service, the ambience. Can't wait to enjoy it all again.

name: Holly Runion
text: This restaurant is adorable. Beautiful shady patio in the back, dog friendly porch in the front. The food is fresh and tasty, friendly service in a great atmosphere.  We will definitely be back.  Prices are extremely reasonable.

name: S Weyer
text: The food was very good and the service was super friendly.  Only the servings could have been bigger.

name: Joan Davis
text: I really wish that I could give it 5 stars because the food was that good.  We sat outside as the weather was magnificent!  This is a beautiful restaurant in which the owner apparently spent years in renovations.  Outdoor seating area in the back is beautifully manicured and landscaped.  Unfortunately , some of the staff was unorganized and we we're never assigned to a waitress.  It took 45 minutes before our waitress went inside and asked who's table we were.  From there on, service was good and the food is outstanding!

name: Mindy Gholson
text: Amazing how they turned this old house into a restaurant.  Lots of seating.  Great food and presentation.  Service was spot on!

name: Scott Speert
text: Excellent neighborhood restaurant.   The service and food were great.

name: elisabeth sours
text: Good food, great vibe. If your visiting or local its worth the stop! Personally I only bring my kids for brunch, but overall the staff and owners are very friendly and welcome to families!

name: Treva Suit
text: Sunday at 1pm, I was expecting more lunch type foods, it was still brunch time and the food was on the lighter side. But we managed to find something for everyone in our party of 5. The food was good but we felt a slightly brushed off by the staff. It happens that we had been in the area for work and took Sunday off to ride motorcycles on Skyline drive. Getting a sweeping once over and judged as "less" is never pleasant because we happen to enjoy  rididibg on 2 wheels. No we didn't have reservations but they had open tables and seated us inside with no problem. The food was served quickly and our glasses were refilled promptly.

name: Lisa Smith
text: Love the new menu! Very fresh and elegant. The service was professional yet friendly. I had appetizers for my meal. Was hoping for a cold soup but the carrot soup was amazing.

name: Some Guy’s Opinion
text: Having been here a few times now, I can say that everything here is awesome. All the food is delicious. Great service. Good atmosphere. Pricey, but well worth it. Possibly one of the best restaurants in the area. I highly recommend them

name: Rod Shepherd
text:
Flawless handling of a Saturday night party of 12 cyclists. Staff has skill. Pleasantly surprised how good the crab cakes were considering we were more than 50 miles from saltwater.
Really need to get over to Luray more often.  Seems like a lot going on in this town.

name: STEFAN MARKOV
text: If you're an artsy person then eat here! If you're not an artsy person then eat here!!!  Amazing food and service 👌👌👌  I will be back and I can say I won't be disappointed!!!

name: A.D. Carter IV
text: Pretty good food, our server was so personable I would definitely go again. The menu is dynamic changing with the seasons.

name: Michael Siemann
text: Great brunch but a little small

name: Boyd Grandstaff
text: Beautiful

name: Marty Sanders
text: Great intimate fine dining.godd selection of inexpensive wine and good craft beer choices.

name: Art Mirrow
text: Apparently the owners (husband and wife) took years to restore this old house into their dream restaurant. Food was very good. I'd tell you what to try but the menu changes by season. The desserts were outstanding and we could not believe that they were only $5 considering the work that went into crafting them. Very good restaurant for a small town like Luray. Reservations a must (we were there 4th of July weekend so maybe that's why).

name: David Moffit
text: The service was personal and they were very attentive.

name: Heather Bradley
text: We were in Luray on vacation and stopped here for Sunday brunch. The food was so tasty, and I was extremely happy to find a place with vegan options! My only complaint was that my vegan dish was nearly twice the cost of my other family members and half the size. It was so delicious, and I wanted there to be more. The portion sizes on what my family ordered were great for the price. Also, we thought the atmosphere was lovely. Would go again if we vacation in the area, but I (as the vegan not my whole family) would make sure to be snack before I go.

name: Peter Bahor
text:
Friend food poisoning after eating there.  Can confirm what exactly happened?  Possibly the salad.  I ate there 2x's and was fine.

My friend ate the Lamb ravioli and the lemon chicken and bread and a glass of wine.

He became feeling sick pretty much immediately after arriving back at the hotel - 20 min after eating I'm guessing. He was sick all night 😷 vomiting and could leave the hotel room until the next evening and was still weak  the next night.  He's not one to say anything but I was prompted about how Our dinner was by Google Bor some app.

We were forced to pay for another day in the hotel. This was this Saturday night we were with a group of about 12 people that came in about 7:30/8 pm.

resp.text:
Peter, we are so sorry your friend was ill. We really need more information to determine where the problem came from. When did your friend eat here? What did your friend order? How long did it take for the symtoms to appear?

Thank you for the information Peter. I am the Chef and one of the owners here. I take great pride in keeping a clean and sanitary kitchen. According to the Virginia department of health it takes 12 to 48 hours for the symtoms of food poisoning to manifest. So, it may be possible that your friend was ill from something he ate here but it is more likely that if it was food poisoning, it was from something he ate from a day or two earlier. Once again, I am sorry your friend was ill and I hope by now he is feeling better.

Chef John Moss

text:
We had just visited the Caverns and were passing through Luray and took a chance on this restaurant based on good Yelp reviews. It did not disappoint.  The food was excellent,  as was the atmosphere and service. The menu was varied with unique choices.
I had the pork steak with potatoes and broccoli. All was excellently prepared and presented.
Dining companions had the Rosti which no one had ever had before (excellent) and a well prepared chicken dish.  Everyone was very pleased.
Desserts were, as expected, very tasty.  We chose a chocolate mouse and Ladyfingers soaked in white wine with cream and strawberries.
I would recommend this establishment without hesitation.

name: Jeff Kuhn
text: Moonshadows is a fantastic restaurant in Luray. The food, wine, ambiance, and service were all excellent. My wife had a salmon entree with seasonal vegetables while I had seared scallops with spinach and risotto, both nicely done and arranged. Some thought clearly went into the recipes, which both had a bit of flair while remaining relatively straightforward. The scallops,  for example, were in a miso sauce. I really enjoyed it. We had a great bottle of cabernet blanc, and dessert (moonshadows pie) was excellent - more of a cake.

text:
First off, best Indian food and one of the best restaurants overall in the area.

Their portions are generous (except maybe for the Naan.) It's partly because the spice level slows me down but this is one of the only restaurants I frequent that I usually have left overs.

Finally, perhaps most impressively, the people here care and are attentive.  We ordered two dishes and made sure there was no dairy. When we asked for Naan the man we were speaking to (over the phone no less) told us there was milk in the Naan unprompted. I can tell you as someone with an allergy who often runs into errors elsewhere, this is not a level of care I frequently experience.

Finally, though I haven't been to the lunch buffet, if the quality in food is anywhere near their dinner food, it is the best lunch deal in town.

name: From Ballparks to BBQ
text:
The buffet isn't huge, but I felt like there was plenty to chose from - especially for the very reasonable price of $7.95. They offered two kinds of basmati rice, chicken curry, roasted tandoori chicken with peppers & onions, tandoori chicken with a creamy tomato sauce, korma curry, and a variety of vegetables that were prepared in different ways. There was a small salad bar, which also had fruit, chocolate mousse, & rice pudding. AND - they bring you a basket of garlic naan! I'm sure there are more appropriate names and descriptions of the food, but I'm not an expert and didn't really study the descriptions of the dishes. I was a huge fan of the curry and the two tandoori dishes. The curry and the tandoori with the cream sauce went great on top of the rice and the roasted chicken had a great skin and tasted like a really good rotisserie chicken. The garlic naan was delicious as well - and I particularly liked it with the tzatziki-like sauce (which was much better than the ranch dressing I accidentally got). I wasn't too fond of some of the vegetables (particularly the fried broccoli) or the rice pudding, but the chocolate mousse and orange slices served as a nice ending.

The service was very good and the atmosphere is cool. It's not the tacky Bollywood look that some Indian places have and there is plenty of space to handle busy crowds. As always with downtown restaurants, parking is a bit of an issue, but this is a good change of pace from many downtown Roanoke spots.

Cucina fantastica Signor Romano.

UPDATE 2/15/18:  8:00 pm, 2 hours before closing. All chairs were inverted and placed on top of the tables. A large group of men (14) were seated in a table. Looked like the place was closed for a special meeting or something. I called before I came in to see if they were open to the public. They said yes, so we came in. Bottom line is this...the chairs on the tables... not a good look 2 hours before closing. Food is still the best, but this look cheapened the experience. They need to re-think this. Also, only one waitress for 16 patrons.

UPDATE 8/12/18
Strangest thing.

I was craving a Romano's pizza so we went to Norton at about 7:00. Several cars parked there, people in the dining area, door locked. What? Closed early? (Closing time on Sunday is 9:00). The night manager came to the door when he saw us and apologized that he was having trouble with his staff and suggested we might want to reconsider dining there tonight. Have you ever heard of such a thing? A waitress who was standing there with him virtually said it would be a mistake to dine there tonight. Are you serious? I said, "Fire the crew and hire some descent employees.". He said Mr. Romano was out of town and he didn't have the authority. I think It needs a complete overhaul. (We went next door to Mi Finca's). Great food. Great service. Never disappoints.

name: RRF
text:
SCRUMPTIOUS (bring cash - no plastic)

My daughter-in-law and I had lunch here the other day while we were getting our windshield replaced.  It was our first visit, but will not likely be our last.

The food was exquisite.  Everything we ordered was freshly prepared, and cooked to perfection.  The service was nothing short of amazing, even with a brand new server; this place knows the value of teamwork.

I ordered the hamburger steak with onions and gravy, medium, with potato salad and steamed broccoli.  The meat was sweet and tender and cooked exactly as I asked.  The broccoli melted in my mouth, and the potato salad was perfect (definitely "home cooked").

She ordered the Delmonico, medium rare, with hush puppies and steamed broccoli.  Same as my food... everything cooked exactly as requested... perfection.

We both had sweet tea to drink.  If you are looking for real southern sweet tea, then this is where you will find it.  It has been a very long time since we have found this, properly made, in any restaurant.

For dessert, I had the banana pudding, and she had the Boston Cream Pie.  Again, obviously "home cooked" rather than store bought.

The atmosphere was about average for a family restaurant.  Keep in mind that this place is not new.

The only negative: They do NOT take plastic, so bring your cash and avoid the defective ATM inside the front door.
