text: Love going to Tommy's! Tried lunch instead of breakfast for the first time last weekend and was not disappointed. 4 stars because of the 20 minute wait when they had open tables. Besides that, the food was fresh, fast, and cheap.

name: Theresa B
text: Hustling staff, great food, doing the best they can during this...peculiar time.

name: Gail Brooks
text:
Food is great, wait is long,long,long, waitresses are courteous, needs handicap ramp & parking.
To be honest Tommy's needs a bigger restaurant with accessibility for handicaps!

name: Kirk McCullough
text: Excellent food and service at very reasonable service. The fried potatoes are wonderful!

name: Danny Preston
text: Due to covid 19 service was a little bit slower food is great as usual.

name: reina godinez
text: It was good long line

name: Homer Morgan
text: Ordered eggs, bacon, hashbrowns and toast. The hashbrowns were cold so the waitress got me another order and they were hot. Other than  that, the breakfast was ok.

name: Derry Haywood
text: Great food and service with a smile! Always a treat...

name: Private Citizen
text: Good food. Quick. No wait this morning! Portions are generous. Had to take half home. The service was very friendly and still efficient. Be prepared to wait sometimes. I've heard it gets really busy! I can see why. Prices are good too. $10 for eggs, biscuits, pancakes, crispy bacon, hash browns and lots of hot coffee.

name: Deisha Heckstall
text: Our meals came out super-fast and tasted AMAZING! It's a great local spot!

name: Todd Anderson
text: Great food and excellent service. This is our favorite breakfast spot in town.

name: Samantha Erb
text: Delicious breakfast with homemade sausage and corn beef hash available. Everything was cooked to perfection and the staff were friendly and accommodating. There can be a wait so go early!

name: Janice D Moore
text: Food is great and service is always great!

name: david blackett
text: Always great food and service.  Can get pretty busy though

name: Howard Smith
text: 2017-07-01 When we arrived, parking lot seemed full, cars parked on both sides of the building, there was a short line outside the building, we were told to wait  in line, the line moved quick and we stood in line for 10 minutes or less, lady waitress took our order was honest about orange juice that tasted sour, I ordered the apple juice and it tasted good, small apple juice was all I needed, waitress brought the wheat toast (with butter on top) first and it tasted so good, did not even need jelly on the toast, we waited 10 minutes or less to get the bread;  I got my breakfast, first and then my wife got her food a few minutes later. We had a very good lasting first experience and want to come again some time.

name: gloria flowers
text: Food was great. Server was attentive. Busy place, everyone had a great attitude*

name: John Miller
text: The staff were very patient and courteous while taking our order (9 people).  Our prepared food arrived in a timely manner and our food was warm and very tasty!

name: David Oquendo
text: As always Tommy's never fails. The fried catfish was deep fried deliciousness.

name: Eb O
text:
I placed my order over the phone. When we arrived the order was ready however the food was disgusting. The salmon cakes weren't cooked all the way through.

The middle was slightly soggy/undone. The hashbrowns were very salty. The salmon cakes left a nasty after tatste. We paid almost $30 and threw it all out. We will not be returning.

It's disappointing that I have to leave this review because I used to love Tommy's but this time the food was nasty. We couldn't return everything that we ordered because we checked our food in the parking lot, which is why I knew the hashbrowns were too salty.
My mom went back in to take them back & they replaced them with some sort of cubed potatoes instead of hashbrowns.

We didn't start eating until we drove off and we did not feel like going back. Rest assured I will not return.

name: Pamela Dale
text: Best homemade sausage!

name: roger durity
text: Great food. Excellent customer. Quick service. I could see why it is a favorite.  The pancakes are huge. Do not forget that it is Cash Only. A great Customer Experience.

name: Elizabeth Murphy
text: Long wait due to social distancing in the dining room. The Service was good and the food piping hot and very tasty. Will go back

name: Sherrina Ransom
text: It was well worth the wait. Only thing is I wish they would accept debit cards! The service & the food was great. Fast,efficient & tasty! Will return

name: Kimberly Bailey
text: Normally I have no problems when coming here but today the service was horrible... The waitress was not very good, my pancakes were cold she would only bring 1 thing to the table at a time she just wasn't a good waitress.

name: Karin Owens
text: Food here was suppppper yummy! I would highly recommend the catfish! The shortcakes are two huge pancakes and I also loved the French toast! The line was super long but it went fast and the food was definitely worth it. The parking lot is kind packed too but to me the food was so good i definitely back here. Also the wait staff ia so kind, we had Ms. Karen and she was the sweetest!

name: Bill Bullock
text: Always great food. Great service.

name: Tema Gee
text: A Hampton staple never disappoints!

name: Tiffany
text: Delicious, great service oh and did I mention delicious haha

name: Patrick Garman
text: Covid-19 time-frame review.  Went in this morning to have breakfast with my daughter.  Was seated as close to the doorway as we could be and within 3 feet of other people eating.  I looked to the front side of the restaurant and saw empty tables.  I asked the host, who i believe is the owner because i have seen her there many time over the years i have been going here, if we could move to one of the other tables and was told "no".  No reasoning for it, just "no".  I also had a problem with her few years ago.  She checks people out at the register.  I asked for change for the $5 she game me back to pay someone i was with the $2 i owed him.  She said "Stop being cheap and tip the whole $5".  I had already left the tip on the table and its none of her business anyway.  It is a shame, waitresses and bust boys work hard here.  Management is the problem and reason I will not return.

name: Sean Westmoreland
text: Delicious, plain, simple, fast.

name: Tracy Kimbrough

name: B.G. Randolph
text:
Good food, friendly atmosphere.

Fried catfish, shrimp, grits w/butter & cheese, 3 eggs over medium...

name: Jes Falconer
text: Long waits but totally worth it

name: Lucipurr Nope
text: First time back since I was a kid and I was not disappointed. The food was great and the steak was cooked to perfection! 10/10 will go again and 1000% recommended to anyone looking for a good  breakfast place

name: C Norville
text: A great local breakfast spot! Inexpensive! A lot of choices! Get there early the line gets very long but it's worth the wait!

name: Danielle Turlington
text: Jasmine is awesome! The food was amazing! The food quality and prices were unmatched! I went in Saturday...they were busy but the line moved extremely fast. I was pleased!

name: Carol Dodson
text: Great pork chops! Fast service. Friendly, down home atmosphere. My only complaint is the fake butter. I like the real thing 😄. Also, they only take cash or check which is fine. Just go prepared.

name: Greg Lowe
text: I travel from Norfolk to Hampton to come here every Sunday for breakfast if that doesn't tell you something nothing will

name: Sheena Crump
text: The food is consistently delicious! Well priced with generous portion sizes. The staff is always friendly! Just make sure to time your visit appropriately for breakfast or you'll end up in a line that winds through the parking lot (but the wait is absolutely worth it). This establishment also only takes cash, so be sure to have some on hand. There is an ATM on the premises in the event that you forget.

name: Faye Chappelle
text: Food is delicious you can not go wrong 😋.

name: Robert Boston

name: Anita Webb

text: Great old time breakfast spot. The service is excellent. They always have a line out the door. But surprisingly they move that line in and out quick. The food is really good like your country grandmother uses to make. The portions are huge. The prices are good but bring cash. They take checks not cards.

name: Jasmine Austin
text: Good local eatery! Line moves fast and the waitresses are always friendly and helpful. Family owned and operated, with a family atmosphere inside. Food is always hot and tasty! Check it out and don't be put off by the long line, it really moves! Lol

text: love the food Catfish breakfast and server was delightful in spirit and services.

text: This was my first time their and the food was bomb diggity 🔥🔥🙌🏾

name: Laura Pittman
text: Our waitress was kind. They kept my coffee filled and we're attentive even when they were super busy! This place is cash only. They were training a new cook and told us that the wait could be a little longer but I didn't really notice a delay. It's understandable why this place is busy: delicious food and great service!

text: Never thought I'd give Tommy 2 star rating. But when I ordered my fish sandwich it states that it comes with lettuce, tomato & mayo. But when it came. It had none I requested it this is what I got. It wasn't even green and the tomatoes were old. Won't be back for a while

name: Sophia Smith
text: I was planning to get a regular pancake and egg type of breakfast but when I walked in I noticed that someone had fish at 7 in the morning . I ended up getting the fish and shrimp breakfast and it was good. Couldn't eat all of it.   Great server as well.

name: David Franklin
text: Best food thus long lines during peak times, worth the wait for sure. Fast service once you get a table great service. Great country style cooking with very decent prices.

name: Janet Engle
text: Our local favorite for awesome home cooking! The staff is A-1, hustling your food out record time. Do yourself a favor and try it(and get dessert!)

name: Jason Harper
text: They are quick with seating and getting your meals ready

name: Deborah Leigh
text:
Visit Tommy's and you are in for a glorious experience!  This place, so reminiscent of diners in the past, tends to be jam-packed with those seeking breakfast and lunch. The staff here is marvelous in how they deal with the onslaught of so many hungry patrons.

The atmosphere is down-home and so very friendly. The minute you walk in the door you are literally treated like family!

The portions of what you order are huge - better be hungry when you eat at Tommy's. The servers never fail to take good care of you.

It's a one-of-a-kind establishment where you can't help that you've come home for a meal.

Tommy's only accepts cash for payment should you visit.

name: Amber Dobsovic
text: Food was awful. Service was just as bad. First and last time here. Can't imagine why this place is popular. Cold food. Limp bacon. Bad server. Just eww.

name: Nancy Morris
text: The place is in nice location and food is very good and people that work there is friendly

name: Patricia Byrd
text: Nice cozy restaurant with a home like feel. The food is always great and if it isn't to your liking, they will do it again to make it perfect. The waitress's are the best friendly people you could ever meet. They always aim to please. The bathroom could use some attention.

name: William Gibbs
text: Good food, not to expensive.  Friendly.

name: Natalie Artis
text: Our party of four ate at Tommy's Restaurant twice during our recent visit to Hampton, Virginia. The food was fantastic both times. I had catfish on each visit. The portions were large and cooked to perfection. I had grits and mixed greens on the second visit which were perfect. I must add that the mashed potatoes, which I had on my first visit, are missing something as they are bland. The hush puppies are excellent, too. All of us were well pleased which is why we visited twice.

name: Griselle
text: Service is great. The food is ok.

name: Patricia Viot
text: The food was awesome... Hot, fresh, delicious.. the service was fantastic.. Crystal made my first time the greatest.. will definitely be back😍😍

name: Craig Stephens

I had their Catfish for the 1st time and it was moist on the inside and a nice crunch on the outside. I would recommend anyone who love catfish and or a good breakfast to go to Tommy's. Thank you Nikki

name: LeRonica Moses
text: Breakfast or lunch, count on good service and great food with big portions. Ask for specials if you didn't check out the board. This place is always packed and don't forget cash they do not take cards!

name: The Hud
text:
TL:DR - Bland, basic food

The service was solid. However, the food was bland. It seems as if the recipes are tired and need new life to be inserted. The pancakes tasted...odd. They were a bit too sugary tasting? There is no need for syrup there.

The eggs tasted like cafeteria eggs on a mediocre day at college while the bacon was just barely cooked. The burger I ordered was just a basic burger, again, with little to no seasoning. The veggies on the burger were seemingly fresh, but the buns were not even toasted.

My wife got the tuna melt. It was completely cold...even the cheese was still stiff as a board. The tuna melt did not have melted cheese. The fries, like most other things here, were bland strips of potato with little or no seasoning - salt included.

The servers were quick and attentive with a good smile. The servers are the best part of this establishment.

name: Mimi Rhodes
text: I wish they were open later! Then I could get my catfish breakfast anytime!

name: P Taylor
text: The only complaint I have is my coffee was not hot. I suggest they invest in some thermal pitchers they can put on the table like the ones they have at IHOP. Other than that the food was delicious. They have a great breakfast menu with everything including pancakes, 2 kinds of fried potatoes, smoked ham, bacon, smoked sausage, corned beef hash. You can even get pork chops or steak. Will definitely be going there again soon.

name: Tommy Murray
text: The place is a little small but that is probably one of the reasons folks like it, but more than the size the food was good, the wait was rather long, folks lined up out the door, so it may be better to order take out on some days, but the staff is friendly and  hard working, and the service was very fast. Definitely recommend this spot for breakfast as the prices are also great

name: Frank Eason
text: Great food and services all the time 👍🏾👌🏾💙

name: ROY PERKINS
text: Hadn't been there for a while. Got my go-to dish of catfish; just as good as I remember.  Great service. Hope to go again soon.

name: Angie Chaffin

name: Terrance Harrod
text: Good food. Quality service. Combination plate still best thing in my opinion.  🙂

name: Pearl Terry
text: What's not to like. I really like this restaurant. It has a homey welcome feeling and the waitresses are friendly and professional. Often standing room only, but they have sufficient staff to make the line move quickly. You might thing with that, you are rushed in eating and getting out, but not so. There are plenty of seats that one can take their time eating and having a real conversation. The biscuits are great.

name: Ashley H

text: The service at this place is amazing. Yes, there is a line before you can even get in but it's all worth it. The food is superb. This is on of the best Diners in Hampton Virginia.

name: Misty Peters
text: You know the food is good when the wait line is out of the front door. Lucky for us, we were taking our food to go. The host was very friendly and gave us good suggestions on what to order. I opted for a chicken biscuit with fries. Our food was ready in 10 mins. Everything was delicious!

name: Judith Gladney

name: john f.
text: Great food in large portions.  A restaurant with SRO lines is a dead giveaway to great eats.

text: Tommy's never disappoints. Good food, fast and at really reasonable prices. The only downside is there is not enough room in the waiting area but that's also a good sign of a booming business.

name: John Mason

name: jk tx
text: Food and service were both great!

name: Ray Wolf
text: Great all around.

name: Tyrone C
text: Food is good. Service is friendly and good. Fish is delicious. MUST DO A BETTER JOB ON CLEAN SILVERWARE. A COUPLE OF TIMES I HAD TO ASK FOR CLEANER SILVERWARE. IF THEY ARE HAND WRAPPED THEY SEE THE DIRY SILVERWARE. MY LADY HAS ASKED AT TWICE HERSELF FOR CLEANER SILVERWARE

name: Purnell Almond
text: Great food and service

name: P Williams
text: Tommy's is the kind of place I look for when I dine out; classic American food, large portions, good service inexpensive prices.   I'd like to see more places of this sort in this area.  Places like this are a dying breed and we need to do our part to keep them going strong. I enjoy Tommy's every time I go, the staff is friendly sometimes it can be a bit crowded but I do like the place very much. I do recommend it and I revisit it regularly.

name: Trey Stambaugh
text:
I was sorely disappointed by my experience today at an old favorite. As a customer of over 10 years and a community member for 25+ years, I've had many a great experience in past interaction with this Restaurant; today was NOT one of those times.

Upon arrival we were made wait for 15 minutes while we could visibly see 4 tables within eyesight that were waiting to be cleared from clients that had already long taken their leave.

As we were placing out order a staff member came up and interrupted us to consult with our wait staff in the middle of our talking.

I ordered blackened tuna which came out raw pink in the middle.

I asked to have it recooked and I was actually asked if I was ok with them putting my bitten piece of tuna back on the grill with all the other clients foods.

At this point I have waited twice now for my meal; observing all this as it transpired, our wonderful wait staff informed me that she proposed to  management that my portion of our meal be compensated for the huge inconvenience provided, only to be told to deduct the price of the canned applesauce we got as a side to the meal. I don't even know how you would be able to discount an item off a meal price if it was prices into the total of the meal but I imagine it shaved cents off my order.

This was the worst day I've ever experienced eating at Tommy's and little to no care was shown to regard my expressing so when I did so I felt the only thing I could do at this point is allow other clients a heads up.

-Trey Allen S.

name: Mark W
text: Tommy's is a great Southern breakfast /lunch place. Service is friendly. I feel right at home when I sit down. Portions are generous.

name: L Wayman
text: There's always a line at Tommy's, and for a good reason. It's THE breakfast spot to go to. I've been going there over a decade, and I've always had sterling service and large, tasty portions at a great price. It's everything a diner should be, but it does close at 3.

name: Cheryl Kelley
text: The food was okay,  I have had better.  They take only cash so make sure you have cash because if you use the atm there you get ripped off.  The atmosphere is sort of loud too.  The waitress was nice and attentive to our needs but the cashier was a little gruff.

name: Darrell Wood
text: This place is truly a gem of the 757 area! I have been going here for 19 years of my life and every time the service, food, and hospitality is truly amazing! I would recommend anyone in the area to eat here! Also if you are visiting this is a great family run and owned restaurant. Support local! If the line is long it is worth the wait I promise!!!

text: Probably one of the best places to eat in Hampton . Cheap meal and they give you a lot of food .

name: kendra miller
text:
My experience this morning at Tommy's is not one I would pay to go through again.
Outside of the kindness and wonderful care from our waitress Jasmin, our service today was less than acceptable and as a long time customer I am disappointed in how this restaurant handled its customers today.
Upon arriving, we were left waiting for well over 15 minutes while watching as the employees ignored the four empty tables in plain sight,
When finally seated and given the opportunity to place our order, a waitress (one that had already addressed my husband in an extremely rude manner upon our arrival) interrupted us as we were speaking to our waitress.
When our food came out, my husband sandwich was undercooked, and when it was brought to the attention of staff we we're asked if it was okay to put the same, already bitten into piece of salmon BACK ON THE GRILL with other clients food.
He had to wait a long time for his food, and was poorly compensated for the lack of acceptable service at a restaurant that we've been spending money in for ages.

name: Bettina Cassanello
text: We actually ate here twice while I was on vacation because we liked the food that much. Food was yummy, servers were kind and very attentive, my only recommendation come early! Even then there might be a wait, but to me it was definitely worth it. Oh yeah and don't be like us and make sure to bring cash! This is a cash only establishment.

name: Kesh thanks you too

name: Mitchell Jones
text:
I have gone here many times over the years, countless. Today, I felt totally disrespected as I had no cash and forgot that Tommy's was cash only (It is 2018 - many of us are using NFC readers to pay).

I politely asked was the ATM still in the lobby as I wanted to get the cash to pay after she informed me that it was still only cash and CHECKS that were acceptable forms of payment.

As I proceeded to go to the lobby,  she says to my 11 year old son,  "You stay here"! Thankfully, I was well rested and for whatever reason the entire Universe held my tongue from ripping the elderly owner apart with words. At a minimum, she should have asked was it okay for him to stay. Better yet,  since you are concerned that I may walk out and not pay, ask for my keys, driver's license, or credit card, NOT MY SON as if he is yours to command.

Nonetheless,  I will only return to Tommy's if I am paid, at least, hundreds of dollars to do so. And then, I will order, and NOT eat.

Before all of this, my son had complained that his pancakes tasted like nothing more than undercooked cake batter.

Never again unless I am PAID to go to that establishment.

I am okay with what she wanted (payment) security,  but I am not okay with how she went about it.

name: Iree G
text: Today is our 2nd visit to Dok Khao within a month's time and it's officially and easily become one of my favorite places to eat. To start,  they are doing an amazing job with covid-19 protocol / guidelines. You can choose to go paperless menu by scanning a QR code on every table. Very elegant single-use utensils, disposable appetizer plates, and cups. Entrees come in carry-out containers. If you're a fan of the spice rack, as I am, they bring you a little of whichever you would like in tiny plastic condiment containers. As for the taste, I challenge anyone to find a restaurant with better tasting Thai cuisine in the area. It's to die for! And so far we have only had the friendliest and most attentive hosts/servers. They're great at their job and makes the experience even better. There is also a guy that came around, whom I'd like to assume may be the manager, during both visits to ask and make sure everything was to our liking. The Dok Khao Pad Thai, Pad Cellophane, and crispy salmon roll (appetizer) are my fave so far, but everything has been delicious. The drinks are heavenly. The Magic Margarita is my fave. They have so much food and drinks on their menu so there is still much more to try. Still haven't been able to save room for dessert. Both the Thai Iced tea and coffee are perfection. The prices here are as expected for amazingly great food, drinks, and service. Most definitely will be returning again soon!

- The Sparkling Thai Cider [which I had to send back] tasted like cough syrup :(
- the crispy duck was amazing! The sauce is fantastic, and they mean it when they say crispy. But I was really hoping they would serve it with veggies that made the dish worth 18.95 (it came with a few sliced carrots, 2 cauliflower  and a few broccoli)

name: Tom Conway
text:
Absolutely amazing food. The menu was varied and interesting, making choosing very difficult, but it didn't seem like we could do any wrong. The Healthy Rolls, the Dok Khao Pad Thai, and the Jungle Lover, made with red curry paste, bamboo shoots, peppercorns, eggplant, red peppers, and string beans, were distinctive and delicious, so good that we ordered some Panang Curry Chicken to eat for lunch the following day.  It was also beyond delicious.

If you like Thai food that goes a little beyond the traditional, this is your place. (If you prefer more familiar foods, though, I suggest Burger Fi, Firebirds, or Brixx Pizza oven nearby.)

Be warned, though. When they say a dish is spicy, they really mean it. Ask them to tone it down a bit if you prefer things more on the mild side.

We wanted to try a spicy southern Thai noodle soup, can't remember the name now. The mistake we made was to substitute chicken with tofu and they gave us the other bland soup similarly named. This is after the waiter asked us about the order carefully. We didn't feel any spice in the soup and spotted the goof up with the check only. text: I ordered this Philips 4K TV for my brother in law on Black Friday 2018 but did not receive it until the middle of December. There was a miscommunication with my brother in law so the driver, not understanding him, took the TV back to Richmond where it sat for weeks. I called BJ's, the carrier and NO ONE would help me get the TV delivered. No one would even tell me where it was! BJ's REFUSED to contact CEVA Logistics to get the TV delivered. I had to spend countless hours on the phone with the carrier and boy their hold times are measured in hours not minutes!! Finally CEVA Logistics gave me the number for Richmond (why couldn't this be done sooner?) and I was able to arrange delivery for late that week. After all this time my brother in law decided he did not want the TV and bought one from Walmart. I was stuck with the TV and decided I would keep it instead of returning it. I set it up and it worked for less than 15 minutes!!! I turned it on and after 10-15 minutes the picture began to fade from vibrant 4K to a dull unwatchable picture and would flicker from bright to dull. In the end I had to re-pack it and bring it to my local BJ's. In the short time I had it I did like the apps and the availability. But, navigating the TV was cumbersome. Nothing easy or intuitive. It was a pain to use, but had it worked I would have kept it. All in all a VERY nerve wracking experience with BJ's and their terrible customer service people. Delivery was a nightmare and even though I will NEVER order anything from BJ's online again: IF I were to I'd have the items shipped to the store because home delivery is not something you want to deal with.

name: Jeff Myren
text:
On a Sunday morning (Nov 1) there were just two people working and only one of them was making drinks and taking orders (I couldn’t tell what the other person was doing). It was pouring rain so I tried to order ahead on the phone but the first call got disconnected after I was placed on hold and then every time I called back there wasn’t any answer. The recording suggested placing an order online so I went to their website and the immediate pickup option said it would be ready in 30-35 minutes (too slow). When I showed up the person making drinks had to walk around the counter to get to the front window to take orders and collect payment. The people in front of me waited at the window for their order to be ready. When they were done and left, I stepped forward to place my order & pay and then stepped back to allow the person behind me to place an order (thinking this was more efficient). That person had a pickup order that did not appear to be ready yet so they made his order and then made mine after. I tried to order a soy iced latte and they did not have soy milk which was a bit surprising for a coffee shop. The straws are paper and turn to mush unless you chug your drink. The coffee itself was good, but the ordering process and staffing could use some improvement. I’d suggest biodegradable straws that aren’t made of paper or sippable lids like they have at Starbucks to avoid the straws altogether.

I haven’t tried the food options yet as they seemed a bit pricey for grab and go. Perhaps in a non-Covid, nice day outdoor dining experience it would make more sense.

text: This place has had a massive renovation and is now beautiful with two floors of seating and a nice view of the Plaza from the large windows on both floors.   They are still just a couple weeks into the reopening so have limited food (a few pastries and now a few small hot dishes for dinner) but their coffee drink selection is pretty extensive,  and includes Almond milk as a dairy alternative. No sugar free syrups yet but hopefully that will come in time too.   Their WiFi is a bit on the sluggish side -  at least on a busy Saturday morning,  but otherwise this is a great place to come and hang out with locals -  it's in a Plaza that isn't always easily discovered unless you know about it. But Lake Anne Plaza is a great place with a number of nice places to eat and shop,  and hosts a Saturday farmers market and craft market.

name: Jacob Barney
text:
Food is great and so is the location. However, the woman running the upstairs really makes you feel unwelcome. The upstairs is full service only, which is befuddling when it's the middle of winter and exactly one table being used at 12:30 on a weekday.

From a business perspective, I see the merits of full service to increase the avg ticket price, and discourage individuals from using the location as their personal offices, but it's a coffee bar! They should be encouraging people to visit and be happy that they are there, even if they aren't buying a full meal. That just means more repeat business and better word of mouth. The coldness of the service and lack of self-seating just makes me want to take my business elsewhere.

It's a service industry and making your customers feel welcome should be as equal a priority as the quality of the food. A real shame considering this is the only quality, independently owned coffee & wine bar in Reston.

name: Paulette Paglia
text:
Heidelberg Pastry Shoppe (& Deli) is the real-honest-to-goodness-deal. So many delicious cookies, cakes, tarts, pies, doughnuts, croissants, turnovers and other pastries as well as REAL bread - YES truly real bread - it's impossible to list them all.

Beautiful birthday cakes baked with love. Colorfully designed cookies. Pretzels both savory and sweet. Delicious German sausages and German delicatessen foods galore. Yes! They make sandwiches too!

Charming area to dine inside. Cute area outside with shade trees and tables topped with umbrellas.

There's also a small market with gourmet German foods, herbs and spices for bread dipping, birthday cards, candles, colorful paper napkins and plates.

While waiting to check out there were German folks in line ahead of me complimenting the staff on their cookies, cakes and sandwiches. Remarking that they "always come here" for the best European baked goods and authentic German-style sandwiches.

And the staff are so nice! Actual smiles and sincere thank yous.

This place is a true treasure. Please support this locally owned family business. You will not be disappointed.

name: maureen schafer
text:
Wedding cake tasting!  We set up our first tasting of cakes for the special day with Suzie at the Heidelberg bakery. . We arrived to find a table tucked in a quiet corner reserved for us with a giant book listing a multitude of delicious flavors. Suzie showed up with the 6 cake flavors for tastingthat we head ordered ahead of time. She offered us water and coffee.  Each cake was wonderful. We jotted down our thoughts with each taste.  For of us went for the tasting and we still had box of cake to bring home.

Separately,  the deli and bakery has a smooth, efficient and very friendly system,  there was about 12 folks expertly behind the counters keeping the many eager customers happy.  They  utilize a "pull a number"system which is fair and stress free. They have German meats,  noodles and an amazing array of freshly made bagels,  donuts and cookies. All tempting.

We left appreciating the Heidelberg business model, and with a better idea of our wedding cake and are returning for a second tasting soon.  Great experience.

resp.text: Maureen, thank you so much for sharing your experience here. We had a great time testing cakes with you. We look forward to having you back soon. Gratefully. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Dick Nicholson
text: One of the few places you can get actual bread in Arlington. By that I mean good, dense, dark whole grain bread, that makes you dream of German bakeries run by master bakers who work all night so you can can have real bread in the morning. No, it's not cheap, but considering that they have to import flour from Germany to get the right texture, you are getting your money's worth, believe me! Also lots of sweets for sale, but they're not my thing in general, plus they are fortified with four times the amount of sugar you would get in a pastry in Germany, which makes them shockingly sweet... to the American taste just right, I presume. Buy the bread!

resp.text: Dick, we're delighted hearing how much you enjoy our whole grain bread -- thank you for the kind words! Looking forward to seeing you next time. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Meredith Aquila
text: The best petite fours I've ever had (even my husband, who hates petite fours, loves these). They take special orders and requests. Their danishes are to die for (stay away from the butter crumb danishes- those are mine!!) and all of the employees are warm and helpful . Not a ton of seating, but we can usually find room. It gets pretty busy (go early if you have your heart set on a particular item!) but there are a lot of people to help you, so you won't have to wait. Nice deli selection and sandwiches. Small imports market, as well. Great, family-owned business.

resp.text: Meredith, thank you for taking the time to leave a detailed review. We're glad you enjoyed our bakery. You'll always be treated like a friend when you're here. We hope to see you again soon. Best regards. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: James Prewitt
text: Very nice shop with lots of great pastry

resp.text: Appreciate this review, James! Hope to have you back our way again. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Ken Ferrell
text: Delicious breakfast sandwich, donuts are good, free coffee, fast and helpful service. The various sausage/wurst sandwiches are absolutely wonderful, and the deals they have when the grill is set up in the summer are great.

resp.text: You can't go wrong with starting your day at our place, Ken! Thanks for joining us for a breakfast sandwich, donuts, and coffee. Hope to see you again soon for another round. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Tiff Cruz
text: Just awesome. Every category of baked goods available and fresh. Plenty of room to sit and enjoy a quick bite or some coffee. They have good hours and very attentive and friendly staff. 10/10.

resp.text: Tiff, your review means a lot to us -- glad you enjoy all of our different baked foods and coffee! We can't wait to welcome you back next time. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Joseph Raczynski
text: They produce some excellent pastry, but you're going to pay through the nose. An alternative to this location is the German Store over on Columbia Pike.

resp.text: Joseph, we use top ingredients to give our customers the best pastries and treats. It makes cost a little more, but to our customers the fresh taste is worth it. Hope you can join us again soon. All the best. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Valentina Gartner
text: This place been our family favorite for years.

resp.text: Thanks for the excellent review, Valentina! We can't wait to see you again. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Mike
text: Always awesome. Mid week purchased a few things that were 50% off. Great deal for chocolate croissant and coffee cakes. Jelly pastries as well. Just sad they don't seem to have free coffee anymore. However they have free sample bread and cookies which help the stomach block the view of feet.

resp.text: Mike, it was great having you here for a treat. Thank you for the review. We hope to see you here for more soon. Best regards. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Gary Potkay
text: It was okay, they had some interesting pastries. I would like to go back and check out the various Meats they had on display as some look like they might be incredibly delicious.

resp.text: Thank you for your review.  We hope we can "wow" you the next time you come in!

name: Douglas Graham
text: Great little bakery offering traditional German breads and pastries (slightly Americanized) as well as a few common Lebensmittel

resp.text: Glad you've loved everything you've tried, Douglas! Can't wait to welcome you back again soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: The Vibe
text: I was really excited to visit and try some of the pastries. Unfortunately I was highly disappointed I think the main reason people like this place is because it is not Starbucks or another franchise. I think the items are a bit over priced and don't have any type of memorable or fresh taste. I purchased a pumpkin pie which did not even taste like pumpkin at all. The bread I ordered was not very fresh and the taste was ok. I feel there are other bakeries in town worthy. This place is just ok for me it is not anything special.

resp.text: Thank you for visiting us.  We are sorry that you didn't care for our products.  Our pies, bread and pastries have been a hit for over 40 years. We bake bread and all the pastries every day.  Maybe you can give us another try?

name: Melissa Rhoads
text: Heidelberg is one of my favorite places, just be warned it's a small parking lot that gets busy on Saturday/Sunday mornings. And pre-order (and pay) is a near necessity for holidays (unless you can stop by midday on a weekday. Overall the baked goods are excellent, the service friendly and the prices beyond reasonable. Beyond the croissants, bread, apple turnover and strudels the giant pretzel is a must at all our casual gatherings!

resp.text: Melissa, we're grateful to be considered one of your favorites. Thank you so much for showing us your support here. We'll see you on your next stop by. Best regards to you. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Peter Lehmann
text: Typical German baking good, very delicious 👍

resp.text: Thank you for your review! Come see us again!

name: Lianne Romahi
text: I love this place. I’m a fan of their pies, sausages, bread, and biscuits. Make sure you try their spicy pumpkin dough during Christmas - to die for!! The quality of their cakes are good, just not exceptional. That said, most people I know that shop there love the cakes. Their coffee is also really good.

resp.text: Lianne, thanks for being a fan of what we do here -- we appreciate your support! Come join us for another bite soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Nicholas Bergh
text: I tried their pretzels and they were ok but really not much better than one you can get at a grocery store.

resp.text: Nicholas, we're sad to see you weren't a huge fan of our pretzels. We hope you can give us another shot in the future for a better impression. Respectfully. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Esther Lee
text: breakfast sandwich was magical. service was great!

resp.text: Thank you for your review, Esther! See you next time. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Carly Tew
text: Came here on a Saturday during their outdoor bratwurst grilling hours and absolutely loved it. I'll come back again for that. Their backery section inside was quite the selection, but I'm not sure how much of it uses real butter, as compared to substitutes. Overall super good experience though. ☺️

resp.text: Carly, thank you for taking time to leave us a review. We're grateful for you support. Come get some more treats from us soon.To the butter we use about 800lbs butter in a week so we are using lots of butter. Best regards. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Michelle Wynes
text: Yummy

resp.text: We're glad you stopped in, Michelle! Can't wait till next time. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Gloria Peters
text: Exceptional service, extraordinary product. LOVE LOVE LOVE this place!

name: Kromeklia Bryant
text: Always the best cakes. They did my wedding cake. This is where I go when I don't want to back. Birthdays and holidays.

resp.text: Kromeklia, thank you so much for the kind words. We're happy to know you're a fan. We hope to see you again soon. Best wishes. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Ned Swartz
text: Always great treats and excellent service.

resp.text: We're so happy you could swing by, Ned! Looking forward to welcoming you back again soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: CIBALE
text: The best bakery in town.

resp.text: We're really happy you enjoyed stopping by, Aleshia! Hoping you'll be coming back. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Stephanie C
text: Lovely local bakery. I would say their breads, pastry, and cakes are the best things there. Pies are very rustic and taste great. Definitely look homemade

resp.text: We're delighted you enjoy our baked goods and desserts, Stephanie! Rest assured, all of our creations are homemade. We look forward to sharing our passion with you again in the future. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Andreas Hake
text: A taste of German bakery (and sausages) - baked using German recipes and imported things like Stollen

resp.text: Thanks for visiting, Andreas! We're happy to see you're finding all your German favorites. Come back again soon for more! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Peter
text: All the items I've tried here so far have been super tasty. They also do fun events. During my last visit they had an open kitchen allowing you to walk through and see all the baking, have some free samples, and try you hand at making a few things yourself!

resp.text: Peter, so glad you made it to our open kitchen! That was so fun -- we love showing our guests more about how we prepare the foods you love. Can't wait till next time you make it by! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: A Fred
text: Amazing. No other words to describe. Eclectic. Ok, that was another word. Great pastries. Difficult parking because of where they are located, but good food.

resp.text: A, thank you for much for the five-star review. Feel free to come back and enjoy us anytime. Gratefully. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Robert Kaczorowski
text:
Great pastry shop that also has a small but very good deli selection. They often serve free coffee and samples. They also have really good wedding cake options, the almond flavor is so good!

My only issue is they have limited parking.

resp.text: Sounds like you love it all, Robert! Sorry to hear if you've ever had issues finding parking. We hope the treats that await inside are worth it! Till next time. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: tasha toppin
text: I'm giving them five stars for their pretzels, brats, pastries, ham salad and Parker house rolls. The staff gets 1 star for rudeness. But, no one goes there for the "friendly" people.

resp.text: Tasha, we're disappointed you found our staff to be rude. Everyone here is trained to be courteous and polite to guests. We welcome you to reach out to us. We'd love to do what we can to make you feel at home here. Respectfully.my number is 703-525-9231 That is the production number ask for the chef that is me I am rally sorry for the rudness - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Ali Dimashkieh
text: Great pastries and bread. The people are friendly and very helpful. Excellent variety of European/German cheeses, wursts, and cold cuts.

resp.text: Happy you could swing by, Ali! Hope to see you again soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Rob Tolson
text: Excellence in pastry

resp.text: Rob, we appreciate you stopping by our place! We hope to see you soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Michael Burmeister
text: Very friendly, helpful staff; lots of goodies to expand your waist line. I'll have to go back and try the chocolate Nutella eclair. Parking can be tight. They also have a Deli that I haven't tried yet.

resp.text: Michael, thank you for joining us here. We're glad you enjoyed your time with us. We look forward to having you back to try the chocolate nutella eclair. We know you'll love it. Best regards. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Lara Busch
text: So lovely! Give yourself time, the first time you go, because there is a LOT in this shop. I've had sightly better pretzels made by an Austrian in Portland, but they aren't bad here too. And it was nice to find a marzipan good luck charm to send to my mom for the New Year.

resp.text: Thanks for the shoutout, Lara! We love hearing you've enjoyed everything you've tried here -- we love that you're sending something special to your mom. Can't wait to welcome you back again! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Andrew Verdon
text: Love the HB

resp.text: Thanks so much for the review, Andrew! Hope to see you back soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Harlan Erker
text: Great people and great food.

resp.text: Harlan, thank you for the review. We appreciate the support. Come see us when you're hungry for more. Best wishes. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Hillel Weinberg
text: A classic family-run bakery. Wide variety of breads, fair pricing. Delicious. German specialty items. Also makes sandwiches to go or to consume at a few tables that are set up -- a bit of a (light) breakfast and coffee scene, at least on weekend mornings.

resp.text: Hillel, we love hearing you've enjoyed our breads, sandwiches, and breakfast! It's always fun having you in. Come see us again soon! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: zack siddique
text: A little pricey but great quality

resp.text: Zack, thank you for taking a moment to leave this review! We'd love to see you here in the future. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Retrograde Bolide
text: It's a good bakery with a nice selection of quality baked goods; breads, pastries, donuts, German sausages and a few sides.  On the weekends during the summer they offer various German sausages on rolls.  The prices are a little higher than other stores, but the quality justifies the price for me.  The place can get quite busy and parking is limited, so just be aware.

resp.text: Thanks for supporting local -- we're thrilled you enjoy stopping by for a bite! We look forward to welcoming you back soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Jonathan Stewart
text:
Great old time bakery that is perfect in 2018. Have been there twice now and both times I was not dissapointed. Very large selection including sandwiches.  Wonderful cookies that are tasty and not covered in sugar.

Great pastries and lots of options to should cater to any ones desires.  They also have a large assortment of marzipan items. Yummie.

Hard to find bakery places like this anymore. Hope they stay in business.

resp.text: Jonathan, thank you for appreciating our old school approach to serving up the tasty pastries you know and love. Your favorite sandwiches and cookies are here for you to enjoy again anytime. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Ricardo L
text: Heidelberg is my go to spot for breads. They also have great donuts and pretzels.

resp.text: R, we're happy to be your go-to bakery. Thank you for the review. Come see us for a treat anytime. Gratefully. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Rhonda Medina
text: We really enjoy the desserts, but we also love the food too. One of the best lunch deals - a sandwich and a piece of day old cake.

resp.text: Rhonda, it's all good here. Thank you for the review. We'll see you here for more soon. Take care.  - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Sean Crook
text:
Wunderbar! Meats from a local butcher - Binkert's in Maryland. Homemade pastries, cookies, cakes, breads, chocolates, candies; you name it they have it. Remember to get a number when you enter and enjoy the bakery experience. Go on a Saturday to sample many of their foods and have a warm bratwurst with sauerkraut on a freshly baked bun.

Be prepared to ham it up with tried and true patrons that have been coming here for decades. It's a testament to the authenticity of this bakery. German food products are everywhere. Make yourself a budget because once you see the bounty behind the glass cases you will want everything.

resp.text: Sean, we can't thank you enough for the wonderful review of our establishment. It means a lot to hear you enjoy our bakery goods and sweets and that you always have a great experience when you stop by. We look forward to seeing you again very soon! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Diane Fairchild
text: Wow.  The selections are like walking into a 5 and dime store:  you just want to keep looking to discover another hidden gem. Everything looks good,  but I came to pick up some "Berliners" for the office, which others raved about,  but to me weren't anything to right home about,  but breads,  breakfast sandwiches,  cakes and other pastries were looking mighty good.  I'll be back.

resp.text: Diane, we can't wait for you to come try some of our delicious sweets and sandwiches! Hurry back soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: William West Hopper
text: A gem in Arlington. This is real food, not some sales joint that has products shipped in. Real German Bakery. And as it turns out on Saturday morning a mini farmers market too.  And on occasion live music.  Great sweets, breads and other treats. Looking for unusual good gifts, this is the place.  Just don't sample on the way home, cause it smells so good, you will be tempted to.

resp.text: You're the gem, William! It's awesome our authentic German baked goods have always impressed you. We're happy to be your go-to place for live music, gifts, pastries, and other treats. Next time you're craving something delicious, we'll be right here waiting. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Patrick McNulty
text: Great quality, good selection, friendly service.

resp.text: Patrick, we're grateful for you taking a moment to leave your review! Hoping we'll see you here in the future. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Stephanie McCain
text: This place is amazing.  They so many different tasty pastries and really good deli sandwiches.  Also the staff is friendly and helpful.

resp.text: Thank you, Stephanie! Come join us for another bite soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Hristina Ridgway
text: Always good to be here. They have an extensive assortment of pastries and they even have wursts and salami. They didn't grill on the patio today because of the rain, but did grill inside. The wurst roll came with a free piece of cake and besides this they even had a free cookie for my toddler.

resp.text: Hristina, thanks for stopping by with your daughter -- we're thrilled you enjoyed the wurst roll and dessert! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Navid Ghaffarzadegan
text: We picked a small chocolate cake. It was very good.

resp.text: Navid, thank you for the nice review. Come join us for more soon. Best wishes. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Mai Nguyen
text: A wide variety of pastries and sweet treats - all pretty decent overall. Service is pretty quick in calling out numbers. Prices are reasonable.They also have a picnic area in case you want to eat your desserts right away on a nice day.

resp.text:
Thanks for reviewing, Mai -- we're happy you enjoy our pastries desserts! Come satisfy your sweet tooth with us again soon.
-Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Michael Voutour
text: Great experience. Fine baked goods, pastries and other treats. Loved the brats & brochen for lunch. thanks.

resp.text: Michael, we're so glad you enjoyed your visit! Come back anytime. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Brad B
text: This is a fantastic local bakery. I went on a Saturday mid morning and it was a little hectic inside. Everything seemed to be moving smoothly and the staff were great. They even had some great suggestions and comments on trying some new things.

name: Chris Shenton
text: Great old fashioned German bakery with good wurst sandwiches

resp.text: Chris, thank you for taking time to write a review. We look forward to seeing you again in the future. Best wishes. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Jens Witter
text: Great place but not as authentic as a few years ago and sometimes overcrowded and often out of items in the early afternoon. We recommend the Brezels and the Beer Cheese.

resp.text: Jens, we wish we knew why you felt things were not as authentic as they used to be. We want to deliver an amazing experience to each of our guests, so your feedback is always welcome. Looking forward to impressing you more on your next visit. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Valerie H
text: Fresh baked breads, beautiful cookies, delicious whitefish salad.

resp.text: Valerie, you'll always get fresh treats here. Thank you for the review. Come again anytime. Gratefully. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: meranda willyard
text: So many options and there all delicious!

resp.text: Meranda, thank you for taking a moment to leave your review! Hope to see you around. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Eddie Sneed
text: Doesn't get much better.   Chef Wolfgang and Carla run a tight ship and set the standard in pastries in Arlington, VA.

resp.text: Eddie, thank you for the support. Come see us again soon. We'd love to serve you more treats soon. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Will Pearce
text: Soon to be Christmastime at Heidelberg!

resp.text: Will, thanks so much for this great review! We look forward to welcoming you back again. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Donna Gray
text: Huge variety (not just pastries-they have deli items also), wonderful customer service.  On-site free parking-nice!

resp.text: Donna, thank you for the kind words. We're grateful for the support. Come see us when you're hungry for more anytime. Best regards. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Lama kanaan
text: Best bakery ! Delicious cakes

resp.text: Lama, thanks for showing your support! We can't wait to see you again whenever you're around. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Veronica Yeh
text:
My favorite place for pastries! This German pastry shoppe is a staple in the Arlington area. I have ordered the meats, cheeses, lattes, cakes, cookies, oversized german pretzels, and plenty more! The pastries are not overly sweet and are so beautifully decorated.

At it's peak times, it gets quite busy so they have a ticket system. Usually I just try to go in the non-peak hours to avoid the wait.

The parking lot is not big but I've never had any issues finding space. If you do, Heidelberg is located close to a residential area that doesn't require permits to park so customers could temporarily park in the residential area.

Be aware! They are closed on Mondays.

name: Paige Einstein
text: You wouldn't expect a German bakery to make the best bagels in the area, but it does! Get there early on weekends to pick some up before they sell out. They always have free samples of delicious goodies to nibble on while you are waiting to be helped. They also make great, buttery Parker House Rolls. Love their Florentine cookies too.

name: Gerald Butler
text: My new favorite place..

resp.text: Thank you for your review.  Come see us again!

name: Jericho McLeod
text:
We got our wedding cake here, and the service is a good as the food!

If you haven't tried the food, and don't have a point of reference, you should probably stop reading this and go visit them. Its the best pastry shop in the DMV.

name: Sharon Murphy
text: Great experience!

resp.text: Hope to see you back soon!

name: Bradford Baldwin
text: We buy our sliced bread here, the soft pretzels are great, cookies, donuts, yes yes. It's a legendary bakery in Arlington near Falls Church

resp.text: Bradford, we're honored to be called 'legendary!' Thank you so much. We look forward to seeing you on your next visit. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Michael G Viemeister
text: Always fun and great cakes and pastries. Customize your treat!

resp.text: Thanks, Michael! Come enjoy another sweet treat with us soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Stephen Perry
text: Yummy breakfast! Free coffee!!

resp.text: Stephen, we're really glad you enjoyed your visit! Hope you'll make it here again soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Anya Nebl
text: DELIGHTFUL

resp.text: Thanks for taking a moment to leave this review, Anya! Hope you come back our way. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Tom Bernhart
text:
Classic European bakery. Great
Holiday goods especially around Christmas.

resp.text: Tom, we appreciate the kind words and support! Looking forward to serving you in 2019. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: R Haywood
text: Delicious cookies, pastries, breads, and cakes. The shop also has some import seasonal goodies.

resp.text: R, you'll never find something not tasty here. Thank you for the nice review. Come by and enjoy some more with us soon. Best. - Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Aaron C
text: Traditional bakery with a large amount of pastries, pies, and breads. Serves coffee as well. There is indoor and outdoor seating. Wonderful service, but watch the hours they are open.

resp.text: Aaron, we're happy you enjoy our shoppe! Come join us for another cup of coffee soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Paul Galloway
text: Great service. Delicious cookies, bagels, croissants everything. Even good coffee, unexpected from a German bakery. Haven't tried their marzipan delicacies yet, but next time....

name: J C
text: Amazing bakery! The gingerbread cookies are the best I have ever had!

resp.text: You're the amazing one, Ja! Hope you'll be back for another gingerbread cookie soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Glenn Thomas
text: The smell as i walked in instantly reminded me of my grandparents German bakery which is the highest compliment i can ever give a bakery.

resp.text:
That means a lot to us, Glenn! We love sharing our passion with you.
-Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Ivett Leyva
text: Absolutely love this place. The pastries, cookies, cakes and bread are delicious. The sausages on the weekends are awesome. The sauerkraut and potato salad taste typical German.

resp.text: We love having you, Ivett! So glad you love what we're cookin' up. Hope to see you in again soon! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Giselle LP
text: Excellent cakes, pastries, breads, cookies, brownies, doughnuts, plus a German deli counter with delicious frankfurters, bratwurst, bauernwurst, cheeses, etc. even head cheese if you've been looking for that. You can also get a great New Orleans-style King Cake here after New Year's for those who celebrate Three Kings Day on January 6th.

resp.text:
Giselle, thanks for the wonderful overview of what we do here -- we're happy you're a fan! Looking forward to seeing you again soon.
-Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Carl Ziebe
text: Great products, fast, friendly staff.

resp.text: Thanks for the review, Carl! Hope to see you again whenever you're around. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Brian Holm-Hansen
text: Awesome assortment of delicous fresh baked  goods!  Great bread that you cannot get anywhere else.  Very friendly staff.  If you don't come here, your depriving yourself.

name: Monte Frenkel
text: Wide selection, knowledgable staff, great baked goods.

resp.text: Thank you, Monte! Hope you make it back to see us soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Rahul Gaitonde
text:
Being a transplant from the NJ area I can say that this is the only place in the DMV with real new york style bagels. They don't make a lot of them so if you come in after noon on the weekend you may not be able to get a dozen or your pick of flavors.

They also have great cookies and cakes. My favorites are the seasonal cookies.

Parking can be a pain in the butt though so I'd suggest getting there early.

name: Sandra LaBarge
text: Always a favorite!

resp.text: Really appreciate all the support, Sandra! Hope to have you back our way again. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Jeanette Wages
text: One of my favorite places. When I need a little taste of home (Heidelberg, Germany) I swing by here for a wurst or some sweets

resp.text: It's so great being one of your favorite spots, Jeanette! Can't wait to see you back again soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Patrick Lyons Dunne

resp.text: Patrick, we're so glad you could swing by! Hoping you'll make it back soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Scott Quirico
text: Fantastic food and selections as always, with lots of special holiday items (St Patrick's Day today, but that's true of any holiday). Sometimes service could be better, but it's still an amazing place!

resp.text: Thanks for coming by! We're happy you're a fan. Hoping you'll be back our way soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Kennan
text: Good but pricey.

name: Cameron Aljilani

resp.text: Thanks so much, Cameron! This means a lot. Hope to see you again soon! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: David Morris
text: Authentic German cuisine.  Lots of dessert options.  Saturday sausage stand is fun.

resp.text: Thanks for the support, David! Glad you love everything we're serving up. Hope to see you again soon -- maybe this Saturday! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Russ Adams
text:
Great European style pastry shop that also serves sausages and other sandwiches.

Highly recommended!

resp.text: Thank you, Russ! We're happy you enjoyed your visit. Come see us again soon! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Sheree Richter
text: Awesome desserts!!

resp.text: Thank you for taking a moment to leave this review, Sheree! Hoping you'll make it back our way soon. -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Jeanette Heideman

resp.text: Jeanette, if we're heaven, that makes you an angel! ;) Thanks for the kind review. Can't wait till next time you stop by! -Wolfgang and Carla, Owners

name: Thomas Meade
text: Nice peaceful pastry shop environment.  Sandwiches from the deli was decent, but a bit pricey.  I've heard the baked goods and cakes are good, but i've never tried them.

name: Julia Neumann
text: Really good but not really German anymore

text: Very disappointing experience. When we first walked in we immediately noticed the huge selection of not just bakery items but also a little deli meat section as well as some German groceries which we were pleasantly surprised by. A minute after walking around the store a lady walking around the store asked if we were ready and we told her we were still looking. It's a big selection and store so it takes a minute to see everything and figure out what you want. Not a minute afterwards she asked loudly "are you ready yet" . We told her that we were going to order once we were ready to order which took us another minute. grabbed some Bienenstich, Some Napoleons, Some Sacher Torte And some sweet pretzels. The pretzels were good, the cakes seemed to be days old, kept refrigerated. The Bienenstich absolutely not edible, hard and stale. I am from Germany and know what this stuff can taste like, even these would be way better and pretty authentic, but sadly you get days old cakes that are dried out, which such a huge store and selection I guess they can't make everything g fresh daily. Expectations ruined we won't be back.

name: Susan DeMarco
text: This place is really close to home so I have visited a handful of times. I thought it would be a nice friendly neighborhood bar that I could make a habit of. But, I get the same lukewarm reception from the wait staff EVERY time I go. I feel invisible. It seems to me like they love their regulars but don't care about growing new business.( Last night I had every one behind the bar (every female bar tender)see me standing there, look me in the eye, and keep on going.  Both when I tried to order and when trying to leave. Didn't acknowledge me at all. The male bartender was much more receptive. He had no problem talking to or waiting on me. ) They do not seem friendly in the least and only seem to FINALLY wait on me when they have to. If I sit at a table, my table never gets the service that the ones around me do. They walked right by me last night and didn't even look or ask.  I did finally get an ashtray, however. I tip at least 1.00 per drink. I say please and thank you. I smile. I don't get it. I guess you're "in" if you are a man or a regular. Sux to be you if you're neither one. I used to bar tend, so I know how its SUPPOSED to be. Although Bubbas is literally 2 minutes from my house, I will drive right  by to go someplace else and only stop in here if no place else is open or I'm desperate .

We are happy to hear that you enjoyed our food and drinks, in the other hand, we are really sorry to hear that we were rude, that was not our intention.

Clients should understand that we have to run a business looking to arrange all clients expectation and needs, keeping our table logistic and workflow, that is not an easy task, especially when clients try to set up their party in a different way.

name: Christopher Winkler
text:
Definitely a higher tier of restaurant in Blacksburg (finally). Que suerte que tenemos comida Sudamericana en Blacksburg! This restaurant goes above and beyond in most every way. The inside is beautiful, well lit, and has a romantic, suave atmosphere. The wait staff is fast, efficient, attentive, and highly professional. The menu features Brazilian classics at a reasonable cost. Expect to spend $15-30 per entree, depending on how much food you can pack away. The average price is closer to $20/entree unless you feel like eating a 3/4 of a pound of steak. The menu is awesome. You'll find Brazilian classics like picanha, German sausage, roast chicken, chicken hearts, black bean stew, and more. This is a meat heavy menu, as it should be for this cuisine. There are vegetarian options but you should be coming here for meats. You'll also find classics like fried yucca and fried plantains for appetizers. All of the meats we tried were perfectly cooked and seasoned. The quality of the meat and the skills of the parrilla-master are apparent at first bite. The black bean stew and rice was also perfectly cooked and seasoned. The portion size is generous without being overly so. It's hard to overstate how good the food is here!

The beer selection is small but good, and includes a couple of custom beers (including one containing another South American classic-yerba mate). Desserts are a potential weak spot here. The passion fruit mouse was a complete success. The flan was less inspired. The flight of dulce de leche, chocolate, and coconut creams was overly rich. This is just a minor quibble since the entrees are just so good. This is the best restaurant in Blacksburg, in my opinion. Great for a special date or anytime you need to impress. And really great if you want a delicious meal!

text:
Easily my favorite burger place in the area. The staff is always friendly and the wait is rarely longer than a few minutes.

The food is amazing, though I can only vouch for the steakburger, with some of the best fries at any fast food place I've ever been. The custard is, in it's many variations, definitely worth saving space for and the fact that you can pay for it up front and have it served after your meal is a nice little touch.

Every time I'm back in the area this place is on my must-go list and I suggest you add it to yours.

name: Monica Sohn
text:
5 Guys lover here, but I think I've officially been converted. This place is Frediculous!

I've been here two times and am in love with their steakburgers and fries! I asked for my #1 lettuce wrapped and this is the best lettuce wrapped burger I've ever had! My mom got a regular #1, and both my brother and dad got #6s. The fries are amazing and are a wonderful combination with their delicious fry sauce.

We also got the turtle concrete (regular sized), which was super melted--but they remade it for us and the second time was the charm.

The staff is very nice and the place is pretty clean! They have indoor and outdoor seating--and the place is pretty spacious! I definitely recommend! I wish they would open another location in Fairfax Station/Lorton area!

It is a bit pricey for burgers and fries...as 4 of us ate for $40 (3 meals, 1 burger, 1 dessert), but it was darn good.

FYI: Concrete vs. Sundae...per employee.
Concrete is sort of like a blizzard with everything mixed in. Sundae is having the toppings on top.
