name: Morgan Ramsey
text: Drive thru was quick and the employee was kind. My order didn't have any issues. Their fries are a bit salty. I like them but I would order salt free if possible if you don't like salty food.

resp.text: We are delighted that you are a fan of Freddy's! We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

name: Cat F
text: What's not to love about a thick frozen custard and seasoned shoe string fries?  The chops steak burgers are so juicy and always hot from the grill. I also love that I can get a lettuce wrap instead of a bun!

name: Rebecca Larson
text: Good burgers and make sure you get the rewards app if you go here often to get free food and ice cream.   Good soft serve ice cream as well

resp.text: Thank you for this great review! We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your Steakburger and Frozen Custard. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

name: Sean McElroy
text: A burger and frozen custard are my go to when here.  There can be a line but it goes fast.

name: DisBMichael
text: Great tasting food and great service!

resp.text: We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your Freddy's visit! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Chris Wood
text: Great place for burgers and fries. Beats Five Guys EASILY in my opinion. I will say that the last couple of times I went, the meat was less seasoned than prior visits, but still better than the competition!

name: Peter Woods
text: Was better than expected

resp.text: Peter, we're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your visit to Freddy's! We can't wait to serve you again!

name: M Hart
text: This place has very good service and tasty custards.  Today my wife and I stopped in for some lunchtime dessert. She had  2 scoops of vanilla custard in a waffle cone and I had one scoop vanilla custard with chocolate chips on top in a cup. The outside tables set the mood just right for our dessert date lol. Thank you Freddy and staff for helping me show my number one lady a good time!

name: Tommy Stavrev
text: Personnel is mostly high schoolers. Nice service for a fast food place. Clean and maintained.

resp.text: Tommy, thanks for taking the time to leave a review. Please let us know what we could do better via our site https://ffcsb.us/nr. We'd love to earn that 5-star review!

name: Walter Dowell
text: An enjoyable atmosphere in a clean friendly environment.  Food was timely tasty and warm. I love shoestring fries.

name: Suzanne Funesti
text: Excellent, superior zfrozen custard - especially the chocolate!! Burgers are too thin for my taste, but the thin fries with fry sauce are addictive! Go!!

resp.text: Suzanne, thanks so much for sharing your Freddy's experience! We look forward to serving you again soon! Have a great day!

name: Sana abobakr
text: I loveeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee Freddys. it is my favorite fast food. if u have not tried Freddys then go try it. (after corona).every time someone is introduced to Freddys they fall in love with it. for example:when I went with my friend I was obsessed with it then I told my parents and they did not understand what I was talking about. Then they went, now they love it as well. Then another time I took my friend there and she loves it too she always wants to go there. If you don't like Freddys don't talk to me.

resp.text: Thanks for being a fan!

name: Shay W.
text: I love this restaurant! Your food is extremely good. If you haven't had a steak burger you absolutely have to go here. I would definitely recommend the fries and cheese curds.

name: Megan Kvandal
text: First experience and it definitely won’t be the last.  The burgers were perfectly cooked and well seasoned.  The fry sauce is delicious.  After dinner we enjoyed a concrete custard and I was very impressed.  I told them I had an allergy to tree nuts and they wash everything before making my dish.  The scoops, the machines they take such care to make sure mine doesn’t come into contact with any allergens.  I very much appreciated this as I have had an allergic reaction from an ice cream store before.  Will absolutely be returning!

name: Yes TonyMontana
text: Best Custard in Virginia

resp.text: Hi Peter, thanks for your feedback! We hope to serve you The Freddy's Way again soon.

name: Alexis Schmidt
text: Really good burgers, amazing fries, and the crispy chicken sandwich can rival the ones from Chik fil A. I highly recommend this place for a good, family friendly, group friendly, high quality meal.

name: Polly Jayjack
text: Great burgers fries and yummy thick custard shakes. Had many of my kids sport teams meet here. Plenty of seating.

resp.text: Polly, we're thrilled that you're a Freddy's fan! We look forward to serving you again.

name: B VT
text: I love your food even though, you forgot my onion rings, and you make my ice cream too early and its melted by the time I get to the window and still have to drive home with it. Please don't make ice cream until the person is at the window and food is almost out. Quality goes down. Other than that, you rock! Just don't forget my onion rings again!

name: Stevie K
text: They've got delicious burgers and a wide range good menu. Everytime I think of them I want to go eat.

resp.text: Thanks for being a Freddy's Fan! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Elle
text:
I REALLY want to love this place.
Their frozen custard is outstanding. Atmosphere is bright and cheery. Very kid & family friendly.
The food.....eh
To be totally honest, I generally struggle ordering food that’s easily cooked at home.
That said, there is a (total lack of) seasoning issue.
There’s a lot of potential for deliciousness.
Less grease and a dash of salt & pepper would go MILES.

name: Nova Fine Homes
text: Boy is this place good! Delicious burgers and heavenly frozen custard for dessert...

resp.text: Nova, thank you so much for your feedback about Freddy's! Come back and see us again soon.

name: James Kruszka
text: One of the best possible burger places available. Their burgers are actually strips of steak. They have the best custard. The service is amazing and the food comes out pretty quickly. Great place to go if you are on a tight schedule.

name: AnotherDayToday
text: Great veggie burgers. Great kids menu. The location is off in the cut, so SLOW down or you might miss it. Speedy turn out. Ordered for 6, food came out faster than expected. Fries are small too, which was odd, but equally delicious. Aces in my book.

name: Brx Morrow
text: Found this place by accident.  Best ice cream cone I’ve had in a long time.  Would have given 5 stars but I would prefer somewhat lower prices.  Will definitely be coming back.

name: Katrina Taylor
text: The steak burgers are always delicious. Service is fast. Staff is polite and helpful.  This is one of my favorite restaurants.

name: Kyle Kammer
text: Good food, friendly service!  Great atmosphere like an old timey diner!  The frozen custard and the cheese curds are especially fantastic and I have yet to taste anything here I don't actually like.

name: Jamie Lyn
text: Today was our first time here. I got the California burger and chili dog combo. Huge portions. Loaded burger, tons of fries. And the custard was amazing. My husband is now in love with this place. It was so good. We'll be back.

name: Ruby Lowe
text: Friendly, we take a group of 10-15 people, move  tables, they dont mind. Ice cream is Best around

resp.text: Hi Ruby, we're so pleased to hear that you enjoy your visits with us here at Freddy's! Whenever you are in need of our famous frozen yogurt, make sure to stop by again so that we can serve you the Freddy's Way!

name: Nadine H.
text: I only get the custard when I'm here because Rita Frozen Custard is only open during the summer and sometimes a girl just wants custard even if it's the winter. Always delicious. It takes a while when you order but that's it's freshly made.

name: Darrell Collins
text: Great!  Loved the feel and the history pictures (not vouching for fact vs his-story...). I was not aware of the [signature features] being thin meat patties - presumably for the steak aspects - and shoestring fries. It was a great meal. Oh, and frozen custard, but that goes without saying, pretty hard to mess that up.

name: F Y
text: Some of the best fries in the fast food business. Always crispy.  One of the few places around here to get a Chicago dog.

name: Mark Loria
text: This place is the best at whatever price when it comes to burgers and fries. Excellent burgers, fries, bread, pickles, and sauces.  Their spicy fry sauce is great. Their prices are reasonable (Age 55+ 10% Senior discount available on certain weekdays).

resp.text: Thank you for your recent visit to Freddy's and for taking the time to leave wonderful feedback, Mark!

name: Ian Hickman
text: Consistently delicious and always a crowd pleaser, Freddy's never disappoints!

name: Jeff Crawford
text: What a great burger! Tastes like real ingredients that haven't been cheapened to save a few cents. One of my new favorites.

name: Mike k
text: This place. It's good.

resp.text: We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your Freddy's visit! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: T. M.
text: Love the pumpkin pie concrete

resp.text: Thank you for your recent visit to Freddy's, and for leaving a great rating!

name: NoVa Dashcammer
text: First off the service is great! Really friendly and pleasant staff. Food wise it's ok. We got a bacon cheeseburger,cheese curds,chili cheese dog and onion rings..We didn't try the shakes. Nothing we had was really all that  great.

resp.text: We're sorry to hear your Freddy's experience was not top notch! We would like to hear more about your visit. Please send us your contact info via our site freddysusa.com/connect so we can put you in touch with the local Franchise Group.

name: Nevan Tabbara
text: Chocolate custards is so good.  Burgers are good too

resp.text: Thank you so much for the amazing feedback, Nevan! We strive to provide an excellent service and dining experience to all of our Guests, and we're happy to see we are delivering. We will share your comments with the team!

name: Bebo Rosa
text: Came here not expecting anything special. Boy was I in for a surprise. The food was excellent and the customer service was exceptional. Will be returning !

name: Christina Stewart
text: The philly steak is amazing. Finished the meal off with a regular dirt n worm custard.

resp.text: Thanks for being a Freddy’s fan! We hope to serve you again. Have a great day!

name: Esther Lee
text:
We ordered double cali steakburger patty melt, chilly cheese fries , cheese curds and a concrete mix with cheeaecake

burger and patty melt were good, chilli and cheese on fries ok, cheese curds amazing.

took home theur jalapeno sauce and steakseasoning which were bomb.

concrete was ok

Service was FIRE!!!! 10/10

resp.text: Esther, we're thrilled that you had the full Freddy's experience! We look forward to serving you again.

name: D D.
text: Hours on the website and the door at the entrance say they close at 10. Went there around 930 to find the lights off and upon entering an employee very happy to tell me they were closed. Passed 3 other potential customers who were looking to get food on my way in/out. We all left to go elsewhere to get something to eat.

resp.text: Please tell us more about your visit via our secure site https://ffcsb.us/nr so we can reach out and get in touch!

name: N M
text: Custard is overwhelmingly sweet [but that may be my personal preference for less sugar].  Kids love their shoestring french fries.

name: Lisa H
text: Pretty good, and I liked that they have a veggie burger option. The food seemed old fashioned in a good way, with shoestring fries and really good ice cream. I will definitely stop by again if I am in the area.

name: Carol McCloskey
text: Great custard!  Thick and creamy!  Waffle cones are tasty.  Love the toppings - marshmallow cream is decadent!  Sometimes there's a wait line.  Free parking - some are a little tricky since the parking spots are tucked in every corner.  Worth the wait and the parking.

name: MaryBeth Ault
text: They didn't clean the grill and it was obvious in that there was beef on the grilled cheese sandwich on the outside bread. Pretty nasty for a vegetarian.

resp.text: MaryBeth, we thank you for your recent visit and appreciate your feedback! We are very sorry your experience was disappointing and have forwarded your comments to the local management team for their immediate attention. Please send us your contact information securely at https://ffcsb.us/nr so we can put you in touch with the local Franchise Group. They will absolutely want to hear more about your experience!

name: Rachel K
text: Great burgers and shakes. I really appreciated that an employee came by our table to make sure everything was good, he even asked if there was anything he could get us. Fantastic customer service! Looking forward to going back.

name: anthony miller
text: Awesome burgers

resp.text: Hello, thanks for being a Freddy's Fan! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Sumayyah Homeschool
text:
Great food with a nice old timey feel.
Staff was friendly and helpful, and the establishment was clean and well kept

name: Chris Ellison
text: Surprisingly great!  The burger was great, the chicago dog was good, and I actually stopped after 75% of the chocolate custard because it was so satisfying & delicious.  My little boy, who normally eats half a hamburger pattie at other places, ate 4 patties 😀, two orders of fries, and the cherries of his custard (too cold...he's picky right now).  Staff was super-friendly and the  place is reasonably clean for as busy as it is (it's really busy!). They are super supportive of service members and vets, offering a 10% discount & a free meal on Veterans day (Freddy was a WW2 Army vet, Hooah!).  Wonderful experience!

resp.text: Thanks for visiting Freddy's and for leaving an awesome rating! We look forward to serving you the Freddy's Way again soon, Chris!

name: Keith Glass
text: As good as it gets... Cooked to order, and nothing like the usual fast food.  And try the Fry Sauce..

name: Dawn Shook
text: Super friendly staff and good food. We love the Fairfax VA location because the kids can play at the play ground behind the restaurant after eating.

name: Jack Yu
text: Great ice cream (custard). I think they're a good alternative to in n out.

name: Danny Sloan
text: Great food.  Excellent customer service.

resp.text: Danny, thanks so much for sharing your Freddy's experience! We look forward to serving you again soon!

name: Matt Chase
text: Consistently good. Fries are delicious and never greasy. The burgers are great: flat and flavorful and also not greasy. Service is good, but there can be a line. They have all kinds of custard toppings, but it ain't cheap. The seasonal pumpkin pie custard - where they put a slice in the custard! - is the best thing hands down.

name: Bob Brotzman
text: A very different take on burgers and just goofy e Pugh to be fun.

resp.text: Thanks again for taking the time to leave us this information about your recent visit. Take care!

name: Bharo Chang
text: My wife and I always look forward to coming here. Their food is always great and consistent. The staff are always welcoming and give off good vibes. Definitely stop by if you’re in the area.

name: toum diomande
text: Clean facilities. Clean food .Freddys Steak burgers are the best.

name: Amanda Davidsen
text: Great food and service. Staff is super friendly and helpful!

resp.text: Amanda, thanks so much for sharing your Freddy's experience! We look forward to serving you again soon!

name: Gian Nair
text: Freddy's has some of the best food in Fairfax!

resp.text: Thanks for the 5 stars!

name: Kate Sullenger
text: Custard is unbelievable and rivaled only by the juicy, fresh burgers. 10/10 would recommend.

name: Hal Berens
text: Great food and desserts.

resp.text: We are so happy to hear you Freddy's experience was top-notch, Hal! Come back and see us again soon.

name: Habib Alam
text: Meh not the worst. Good atmosphere

name: Marilyn Breedlove
text: First visit...Wow!  The custard is the best I have ever had!  And the Burgers!  Could not believe how good they are....The Frys with the sauce!  Have been telling everyone.  Can not wait to go back!!  More locations needed!

name: Todd Pavela
text: Good food.  Usually pretty loud, mainly the music, which they have set to a Florida station.

resp.text: Todd Pavela, thank you for taking the time to leave us your feedback.

name: Jason Lee
text: Best burgers in Fairfax (to my knowledge). I believe that they do not put the patties on the grill until you order so you always get that hot-off-the-grill experience. Their custard is very good and their employees are very friendly and well trained. I appreciate that they give back to the local community as well.

name: Meaghan Kelly
text: Delicious burgers, crisp fries, fast service, custard is fantastic!

resp.text: Wow, Meaghan! We're blown away by your amazing feedback! Thanks so much for taking the time to share your thoughts about your time at Freddy's. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Greg O'Neill
text: Great food and very satisfying dessert options. Yes, it gets crowded very easily, though the staff still crank out the orders in a reasonable time.

name: Ross Mc Givern
text: Great food, but the guy taking orders at the drive through was very catty and condescending. Certainly needs improvement in regards to customer service.

resp.text: Ross, we're sorry to see you had a negative experience visiting our location. We would like to hear more about your visit. Please send details via our secure site https://ffcsb.us/nr so we can reach out!

name: Donna Kubiak
text: Freddie's food is fab! And the custard is to die for. A fun family restaurant, with friendly,  efficient service. One if my very favorite fast food places to take the grandchildren!

name: Viz Ea
text: One of the most chill places to go if you want a good burger. I love the atmosphere here. Been coming since they opened up in 2014 and have never had bad service. The manager recognizes me every time I come and I always end up getting extra fries, even when I don't ask for it. They always come and drop my food off rather than calling my number for me to come pick up me food. I will continue to come here for years and have told many people who only come here when they crave a good burger.

name: Chad Faubert
text: Great burgers, cheese curds and concretes!

resp.text: Chad, we're thrilled that you're a Freddy's fan! We look forward to serving you again.

name: Jonathan Tomek
text: One the best places to get a burger. The custard is phenomenal. Shoe string fries... Amazing. Need I say more? This place is family friendly and has lots of big seating tables if you have a group of 6 or more. I am excited to go back. Don't forget the cheese curds!

name: Jeff Fetgatter
text: Good burgers and hot dogs and really good custard.  I'm not a big fan of the shoestring fries though.  Fast and friendly staff.

name: nathaniel barnhill
text: One the best burgers 👌 had in a long time.

resp.text: Thanks for being a Freddy's Fan! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: Melissa Washington
text: Just left this location, the young girl at the window with glasses Terrible attitude

name: Charles Johnson
text: 1st timer. Drive through was quick, and service was friendly and efficient! Ice cream tasted good.

resp.text: Charles,we're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your first visit to Freddy's! We look forward to serving you again soon!

name: R Schrader
text: The frozen custard confections are the best. Sundaes, concrete (all the ingredients mixed in), and milkshakes in every flavor they offer -  and there's a long list!  My favorite sandwich at Freddys is the #5, kind of a patty melt on grilled toast.  Well worth a try next time you go. I've also liked every seasonal special; so keep an eye out for those.

name: Mark Huber
text: Burgers could be better! Too thin to be called Steak Burgers. Shakes are good

resp.text: Mark, thank you for your recent visit to Freddy’s! We appreciate your business and value your feedback. While a steakburger has characteristics similar to a hamburger, it is hand-pressed thin to create a caramelization effect around the outside of the burger with a juicy, flavorful center. We typically recommend our Double Steakburger since ours is unique compared to a standard hamburger. Our apologies if your steakburger was unsatisfactory. Please take a moment to send us your contact information securely via our website at FreddysUSA.com/connect so we can put you in touch with the local Franchise Group.

name: Justin S
text: Burger and fries were pretty good.  Their Sauces and seasoning are what make this place though. I wasn't even that hungry and enjoyed my food.  I also got a Worms in Dirt Sunday and thoroughly enjoyed it as well. Though the toppings were a bit limited leaving a big bowl of normal vanilla custard.

name: Jennifer O
text: Tasty classic burgers, shakes, and fries joint.  I thoroughly enjoyed the crispy edges of the burger patties and fresh pickles. Yum.

name: PacificFrostHeaves Gaming
text: A little pricey but delicious. All the food is good but I go there especially for the frozen custard,  which is hard to find in this area. Custard serving sizes are large. Has a drive through.

name: MiracleOne
text: They forgot to pack all 4 straws and sloppily put together one of the two pattimelts ordered. Also they asked what sauces but only packed two ketchup and two fry sauces for several order of fries.   The one in Fredericksburg is much more preferred and efficient.

resp.text: Veronique, we thank you for your recent visit to Freddy's, and appreciate your feedback! We are very sorry your Freddy's experience was disappointing, and have forwarded your comments to the local Franchise Group for their immediate attention. If you would like to be contacted directly, please take a moment to send us your contact information securely via our website at FreddysUSA.com/connect.

name: 東奈織美
text: They have a great service, great food!! Definitely come back again for some lunch on weekends! They will give you discount if you are military or even ex-military!

name: Nick Johnson
text: Burgers and fries! If I lived closer to this place I'd go more often, but as such, it's a guilty pleasure for my family.  We go every so often as a special treat and Freddy's never disappoints.  I love the burgers, love the fries and I love the ice cream!  A great place to bring the family, and the staff is always friendly.

name: Gloria Peters
text: I love this place! The burgers are always fresh. The staff is always super nice and the custard is to die for! Great restaurant, I just wish there was one closer to my house :)

name: Jessica Edwards
text: Amazing burgers! Plus they serve custard 😍

resp.text: Jessica, thanks so much for being a Freddy's fan!

name: Mark Lee
text: First time coming here and I'm sold. Great burger and burger options. Great price. Great people working behind the counter. You literally need nothing else.

name: j. gill
text: Best thing about this place is you can order your dessert (custard) when you order your food but have them delay making the ice cream until you're done with your meal.  The food is ... ehh.  Salty, greasy burger faire.  Perfect for certain situations,  You could find better, they just won't  have such awesome desserts.

name: peter stavrakis
text: We loved Freddy's, always the best steakburgers, wonderful fries, and frozen custard. I have moved from this area so it was great to have the chance to be back near Freddy's. If you want the best, head to Freud's, you won't regret it.

name: Bob Dresser
text: Unexpectly good. Only my 2nd time at a Freddie's

resp.text: We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your Freddy's visit! We hope to serve you again soon.

name: George Brightman
text: Classic, old school decor, traditional style burgers & drive-in soft serve. All the employees are truly gracious and completely customer service oriented! Try them out today for a good old fashioned meal

name: Justin Alexander
text: They did great with the ingredients they had to work with I thought the burgers were going to be a little more filling. the customer was out of this world plus you can get a pup cup for you little buddy if you have one with you. All in all such a great experience I couldn't imagine anything better from such an affordable eatery.

name: Leslie Kerns
text: Tried the steakburger. I wasn't sure what to expect. It was basically a steak'em on a hamburger bun. The flavor was good but some of it was a little crunchy.  Can't wait to try the frozen Custard! :-)

name: Hariton Wilson
text: Good service, reasonable prices. Personally Im not so sure how much I like steak burgers, they are kind of flat and crunchy on the sides. But the service is quick, the toppings are fresh, and the fries are the extra thin cut kind. Free sauce for the fries. Its a pretty decent place, Ill probably be back in a few montha.

name: Bret Halleran
text: Fantastic. Food really does come hot and fresh as advertised (and was delicious) and the custard is addicting

name: Hmnp US Group LLC
text: Great food great service and always a lively atmosphere

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave wonderful feedback about your Freddy's visit. We look forward to serving you the Freddy's Way again soon.

name: Carlos Suarez
text: Very nice experience. Good food in general. The shakes are Good!!! Excelent!

name: Topher Kurz
text: This was a surprise find. We thought it would be like every other chain and it wasn’t! The burgers are really good and the desserts and delicious too!

name: Said Ashna
text: Better than BK, MCD, Wendys, arbys and so on. Good burgers, fries and obviously their frozen custard.

name: Rob Bamberger
text: This was my second visit, and it left me puzzled and disappointed. Ordered a patty melt, and it was lay in the basket poorly assembled or coming apart. Didn't whoever set it on the counter care? I didn't pursue it...just ate it with plastic knife and fork. What the hell; I was hungry, but felt dissed. Fries on this occasion way too salty; fountain drink not well-balanced between soda and syrup. And, the custard is expensive. Will give Freddy's another chance, but for a place that trumpets itself as special, this was a disillusionment. This branch needs new, or better-focused management.

name: Peter Fricke

name: Jorge Rodríguez
text:
Love this place, fresh made hamburgers, I like the chili cheese fries.
Very good customer service!

name: Abbott Bray
text: Burgers are great.  Service is fast.  Fried Cheese Curds are AMAZING.

name: Justin M.
text: The manager (owner?) always friendly.  Good service and team.  Food always quick considering how busy they are.  Recommend  the custard sandwiches.

name: Cynthia Whitley
text: The food is usually pretty good. I had the single steak burger combo. Their fries are really good. They are shoestring fries and are nice and crispy. Didn't have ice cream on this visit, but it's usually pretty good too.

name: John B
text: Longer wait for fresher food however the fries are so skinny that if you don't eat it right away it goes cold. Staff was great though.

name: Charlie Choe
text: This place has a retro-burger feel to it. The fries are shoe-string style and I wish there was more to it. The burgers are smashed and very very thin and have a nice crisp to it. Probably would go on occasion but not out of my way.

text: Its pricey fast food place. Everything is fresh for sure, they do take a little bit more time than the usual fast food places but its worth it. I love the fries here as well as their hot dogs.

name: Mike Quotient
text: Clean, friendly, tasty, nostalgic.

resp.text: Thank you for your recent visit to Freddy's, and for leaving a great review! Take care!

name: Nicholas Gleason-Smuck
text: Great food. A change up in flavor from typical fast food places. Definitely a favorite.

name: David McAndrews
text: Freddy's has the feel of an old fashioned burger and shake shop. It is clean with a nice welcoming atmosphere. The staff are always friendly. The food is prepared when ordered and is usually ready pretty fast. The burger patties are really thin (and a bit salty), but very tasty. The fries are also very thin and very good, like shoestring potatoes. I still haven't tried the frozen custard, but it looks great. One of these days I'll have to give the custard a try.

name: Tom Snow
text: Came for a sweet cold treat. I ordered a large chocolate custard in a waffle cone. It turned out to be 3 large scoops of chocolate custard. Wow, delicious!!

name: Lynn Wheeler
text: Customer service and cleanliness on point. Food lack luster on this particular visit. Fries were neither fresh or hot. Lettuce on my burger must have come from the bottom of the containers as I got a lot of water that made my bun soggy.

resp.text: Lynn, we appreciate your recent visit to Freddy's and value your feedback! We sincerely apologize if the quality of food you received was not up to Freddy's standards and have shared your comments with the local management team. Please send us your contact information securely via our website at FreddysUSA.com/connect so we can put you in touch with the local Franchise Group. They will absolutely want to hear more about your experience!

name: elle b
text: Prices are a bit steep for hot dogs, burgers and fries and ice cream but the food is absolutely wonderful!  Especially the onion rings!

name: Beth Tripp
text: Steak burger and frozen custard were excellent.   Fast service

name: Andrew Griffiths
text: Awesome food and the register guy patiently helped me and my family decide what we wanted based on dietary preferences. Way to go the extra bit. Then later he came by to see how we like our food. We have nothing but good things to say.

name: R Justice
text:
A must try burger spot!!!
And the frozen custard and deserts alone are a reason to come here
Awesome burgers. Awesome staff. I sometimes get free shakes brought to our table just because. Awesome place... The Burgers are awesome. To they are thin but getting a double or triple layers the cheese and makes them awesome. The Freddie's sauce is awesome too. Hard to find good burger sauce like this.  The place has chilli cheese Fry's as well!
Tripple burger California style reminds me of in n out not as a exact replica as the place in Maryland caliburger that was sued by in n out but a good replica and good burger.

Awesome food.
Awesome custard.

name: Regina Davis
text: Good customer service.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback, Regina! We hope to serve you the Freddy's Way again soon.

name: Oswaldo Embus
text: 50's atmosphere, Great burgers, lots of ice cream options; this place is the most budget friendly I seen around.

name: Sarah Robinson
text: So good! Not a huge fan of the fry sauce though but it's neat they have it. Fairly cheap prices and the staff is always nice. It's also pretty clean and tidy.

name: Karen Baber
text: Good burgers and frozen custard

resp.text: Karen, we're thrilled that you're a Freddy's fan! We look forward to serving you again.

name: Michael Caruso
text: Very unique thin patty burgers and thin fries to match

name: Rich Riordan
text: Burger place with interesting dipping sauces.....service was good

name: Red P.
text: Extremely good custard! I got something simple for my first time there (a vanilla shake with hot fudge) and it was so good! I also had a burger and fries. They serve shoe string fries and they were very good with the jalapeño fry sauce. I reccomend stopping by!

name: Les Wiegers
text:
I wrote a rave review about the food and custard a month ago.  But this time, I tried the drive thru.  I sat in line without it moving for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile all the folks behind me backed out and left.  I finally bailed and left too.  Although the food is good, it seems that many of the staff are wildly unprepared and dismal and doing their job quickly.  I watched TWO employees do box recycling instead of staffing the restaurant during the busy lunch hour.
The food is good but incompetent staff and management outweighs that greatness of the food.  If you are gonna drop 11 for a burger and fries, expect they can provide it in under 10 minutes.
If the manager cannot hire more staff or competent staff, this franchise WILL GO UNDER.

name: Patricia Smith
text: One of my favorite places to visit. Love the fries, burgers and of course the ice cream!

name: Jason L
text: Very family-friendly, food comes out pretty quick. Music is PG or PG-13. No complaints at all, the big cool thing is the outside patio and the Plenty full parking everywhere

text: My FAVORITE burger place. I can eat the entire burger without feeling sick like I do at most places (5 guys) and they fries are so good! Only downside is they don't give you enough fries (even with a large meal). I don't eat a lot and I can finish a large meal and still have room for desert.

name: Rich Barron
text: Outstanding value and flavor!  Great Frozen Custard that is so smooth, it's hard to describe.  Delicious food.  Clean, comfortable, fun.  Brightly lit with a fun retro vibe.

name: Roy M.
text: I went to the Freddy's in Fredericksburg a while ago and I was craving it, so I decided to go to this one because it was closer. I went on a Saturday and the parking was beyond horrible. I rode around the parking lot several times until I finally got a spot. The ice cream on the other hand was great, which is what I went for. It was rather busy, which was expected. The was no where to sit,  inside or outside, but it is right beside a park so luckily it was nice outside so I sat on a park bench and enjoyed my sundae. All and all it was worth it.

name: Mr Cowen
text: If you like burgers alot come HERE

name: Fred theflo Oliver
text: 4th time at this establishment and I must say the consistencey of the food is incredible.  The ambaince of the restaurant is so dead on for the 50's.  Service is fast and accurate!!!!!

name: Kate Menda
text: Visit on a Friday night early summer. Almost every order in the place including ours was wrong. They lost our shake order (how?) And there was a colony of ants over taking the tables outside. All garbage cans were overflowing, condiment station was empty, restaurant exhaust wasn't working so it was smokey. I have seen it more crowded but better run so not sure what was going on.

text: This place is the best if you are dining in.  I would avoid the drive thru if you are in a hurry.  It's slow. I get it that all orders are made to order but I have to repeat myself over and over because the person working the window never gets the order right the first time. Dining in = best.  Drive thru = meh.

name: 김푸른

resp.text: Debbie, we're thrilled that you're a Freddy's fan! We look forward to serving you again.

text: I love this place.  The burgers are unique and very good.  So are the fries and shakes.  It's real busy at prime times and hard to get a table.

name: Golden Cobz
text: Love this place!! Stop here everytime I'm in Fairfax. delicious burgers and frozen custards.

name: Ishia Cadiz
text: My favorite burguers places. When I want to eat a good burguer I just go to Freddy's.

name: Genevieve Llames
text: Fast(ish) food the way it should be! Quality ingredients, friendly service, reasonable prices, retro atmosphere. I highly recommend the steakburgers and concretes. Definitely try their Fry Sauce with your fries and onion rings!

name: Erskin Hickman
text: Great burgers and custard with a side of nostalgia. Visit here every time I am in the area.

name: J C
text: Delicious steak burgers. Great variety. Onion rings really crispy.

name: Derek Campbell
text: Delicious burgers, hot dogs, french fries and everything in between.  This is a fun little place with reasonable prices.  I challenge you to try to not have a great day after you've eaten here.

name: Gideon Cripps
text: Very tasty and awaiting! A bit spendy though

name: Lona Saccomando
text: Awesome burgers and fries, and super creamy custard to boot!! The staff is very nice as well - they even come around and ask if need anything and help clean empty trays. How's that for fast food!?

name: Rick Large
text:
Good food, depending on when you arrive, could be a slight wait.
All in all still fairly quick, and good service.

name: Earle Bryer
text: Great food, prepared fast.  Staff is friendly.  Lately, orders are missing items and portions inconsistent at times. Attribute to revolving door high school age staff not being managed properly on QA/QC. Otherwise, a favorite go-to.

name: Christopher Olson
text: Nice fast food burger joint. Chickfila aesthetic, but with steakburgers and frozen custard. Good food, always been hot and fresh for me. City playground and soccer fields right behind. Drive thru and patio tables. Great for families with kids.

name: Robbi Walker
text: Great place! I actually had their fish this time! It was good!

name: Julian Rocha
text: Great place for a quick, delicious burger. Building is clean, employees are friendly and the food is always fresh. Drive thru is available, although I am unsure about the wait times for it. Every now and then, due to the amount of people that pack the place, your food might take slightly longer than normal, but it's not a normal occurrence (at least at the times I have gone). Loads better than most (if not all) Fast Food joints in the area. This place definitely sticks out. Five stars for Freddy's!

name: Donald Young
text: The best burgers in Fairfax.  After the burgers and fries,  you can add a delicious ice cream novelty or sundae.

name: Kaley Evans
text: Burgers are normally great, sometimes its a hit or a miss. Their shoe string fries are always delicious, as well as their very own seasoning and fry sauce. To top it off they give GMU students a discount.

name: George Cochran
text: Great food, reasonable prices, good service. I had the double bacon Steak burger even though I've never liked a steak burger, I loved this one. The fries were pretty great, shoe string style fries were great especially with the complimentary Freddys famous steak burger and fries  seasoning on every table; no ketchup needed. The custard was also great I had the mini pbc&b sundae. I posted a picture of the menu but like I said the prices are reasonable.

name: Tabatha Zocher
text: Love love love this place!! The burgers are great, the fries we cant get enough of (especially with some of their fry seasoning and special sauce), and we wrap it up with a delicious custard concrete! Can't go wrong with Freddys!!

name: D B
text: Pleasant experience.. Good food, always good service.  Try your burger in a lettuce wrap, you won't be disappointed.

name: Cam V
text: Great service even later at night. Ice cream here is awesome! The burgers aren't too shabby either, set back off the road slightly in the same lot as Hooters.

name: Victoria Bak

name: Haley Preski

The patty melt on rye is very tasty and the double burger with the super fresh lettuce and tomato really hits the spot. Freddy's is our new go to burger spot!

resp.text: We're thrilled to hear we've earned a new Freddy's Fan, Terry! We look forward to serving you again soon! :)

text: I was surprised to find a veggie burger on the menu! Service was fast and friendly, and the restaurant was spotless, even the bathroom! Freddy's is what every fast food chain should aspire to.

name: Anthony Tran Jr

name: Randolph Wardle

name: Martin K

name: Roy McCracken

text: I have never eaten at a Freddy's. I had no idea what to expect. I ordered the dbl patty melt not realizing it was rye bread. I dispise rye. But it was an excellent burger. If you can make this guy like rye, you get 4 stars at least. The staff was nice, the food was good and fast. I will return.

name: Ryan Cooley
text: Just had lunch for the 100th time. Always a pleasant staff willing to go the extra mile for the patrons. Great burgers and fries. Always a fan favorite with my wife and kids.

name: Cody Claxton
text: Great burgers at an affordable price. Fast drive-through service. Nice people.

name: Kim Casey
text: Similar to Steak n Shake, but better. Order at the counter and they either call your number or, if they're not too busy, they'll bring it to you. Burgers are yummy, fries is perfectly crisp, frozen custard yummy. Service always with a smile. I'm eyeing the cakes with ice cream AND cake for my birthday.

name: Stanley Darmofalski
text: This was our first visit. We ordered burgers and desserts. They let us hold off on getting the desserts until we finished our food. Burgers came out faster than expected. The reason is the patties are thinner than usual burger joints. But the thinner burger was not a negative in this case. I got a patty melt which comes with 2 patties. (The regular burgers come with 2 patties) The pattie melt was delicious and hot. I could still see steam coming off the meat. I was not too impressed with the thin shoe string fries but the portion was fairly large and they were included in the price. I could not finish all my fries. Plus I had to save room for dessert. I ordered my staple dessert, hot fudge Sundae. The custard was excellent. The point price vs. portion was spot on. Meaning you get what you pay for. And I can't forget the staff, they are nice, helpful, and attentive to our needs. I would visit more offen but it's a bit out of the way from where we live and work.

name: Casey Goodin
text: Good quality food. Love the Freddy sauce on both their burgers and fries, including chili cheese fries. And for a fast food/"fast casual" place their service is excellent, you can definitely tell they emphasize great service.

name: Jasmine
text: Burgers were awesome! Almost as awesome as in-n-out! The frozen custard was just okay to me..nothing too special. Maybe I have to try a different flavor next time!

name: Kelly Daly
text: Great food; great service.

name: Katherine Allen
text: Very yummy steakburgers and fries here, not to mention shakes and sundaes! Polite staff and quick counter service.

name: Karl Berger
text: Pretty good hamburgers. Hot dogs are good. Shoestring fries are real good especially with the fry sauce. Great ice cream custard.

name: J DeRoma
text: Always an excellent experience. Delicious steakburgers, good service, clean place.

name: Marihanna Euclides
text: Thin fries are their thing, but isnt mine. Nevertheless, burger was hot and fresh, and their concretes (milkshakes) were cold snd sweet. Definitely recommend!

name: Steven Cao
text: Great burgers and fries! Especially having veggie options :) great desserts! Good prices

name: Brandon Li
text: Love coming to this place for burgers and fries. Always friendly service whenever I come and never had a negative experience.

name: Bob B
text: Its unique!  Great chocolate shakes like you get at the old time diners

name: Richard Plocica
text: Ok with interesting twist on the everywhere burgers. Really a kids and family place even with the 1950s chrome and plastic decor. Their strong point is their offering of custards and shakes. The ordering process can be confusing at first but well organized for custom made orders and possible busy times. We need to try a few more times to enjoy the full varity of offerings.

name: Jeffory Hopp
text: Great place, clean and day service. Good was great! Will be back.

name: Kia Green
text: Friendly staff! First time there ever and enjoyed an oreo shake!

name: Zach Turner
text: Great fast food spot. Great burgers and fries and one of the only places around to get frozen custard. A grw at stop if you're in the area.

If you haven’t already ate here you’re missing out, by far the best steak burgers I’ve tried in the NOVA area.

name: Pam Henry
text: Friendly service, good food, thanks for the pup cup (small cup of ice cream with bone) but forgot the fry sauce i was sure to ask for twice... would have made the fries much better.

name: Josh Rose

name: Nick Stasiak
text: I go here all the time. There's always a bit of a wait since they make everything as soon as you order it, but the wait is well worth it. Food is fantastic, but the fries are super thin. It's all about the dessert though.

name: Carrie L.

name: Naveed A. Shah

name: Kipp burgoyne
text: Excellent burgers, friendly service, wide food selection, creamy tasty frozen custard.

name: Wayne Chan
text: Soft serve ice cream with toppings was very overpriced, ordinary and lackluster. Returned for their hamburgers, and had a better impression. Definitely a high-school hangout. Wish they would use real ice cream, maybe Gerbers or another local ice creamery.

name: Bryan Smalley

Please take a moment to send us your contact information securely via our website at FreddysUSA.com/connect so we can make it right with you!

name: G Griffin
text: My family and I really enjoy Freddy's - Burgers, fries, and ice cream are all awesome! Last night I had the brownie shake - to die for... Only reason for 4 stars vs 5 is the feeling I have afterwards. Gut bomb, just being honest

name: Manuel Artiles
text: Great burger and ice scream shop

resp.text: Manuel, thanks so much for being a Freddy's fan!

text: Fantastic frozen custard. Steakburgers are great. Excellent thin and crispy fries. True original restaurant different from the mundane burger fast food joints. Hope they expand soon.

name: K Batch

name: Eddie C

name: A E

name: Carl Slomowitz

name: Monica Nickel

name: Khoi Nguyen
text:
Burgers and food here are fresh. Stopped by the other day after craving some good burgers. My gf and I each ordered the single California style steakburgers with side of fries and onion rings. For dessert, we shared the Dirt N Worms Sundae. The steakburgers had the fresh green lettuce, ripe tomatoes, onions with their fry sauce. They were delicious you get nice little crush with steak griddle taste. Single patty size may be small for some. Might wanna consider the double. The onion rings were fried perfectly and large. I'm usually not a fan of the super thin fries, but its something about the way they season it or fry the potatoes that we both loved. The sundae was great. They definitely over load you with a lot of Oreos, but who cares. Ice cream was very creamy and milky.

This isn't your average burger joint. The staff and service here is top notch. The cashiers knew everything at the menu. Everyone was friendly and you are always greeted with a smile. The location is very clean. They have 2 sauce stations for their fry sauce and its kept very clean. Prices are a bit higher than your average fast food burger place. But you get your moneys worth with quality and great service. I'll be back to try their hot dogs and other desserts.

resp.text: Patti, thanks for your recent visit to Freddy's! There are many different ways to make fries, and we tried several before deciding that our shoestring fries are what best complement our specialty steakburgers! When compared to crinkle-cut or thick fries, we found that shoestring fries retain their crispy, crunchy texture longer - something our guests appreciate. We also receive feedback that many of our guests prefer to dip shoestring-cut fries into our fry sauce (and even into our frozen custard!). We genuinely appreciate your feedback, and we will absolutely make sure your comments are shared with our menu development team. We invite you to try our fried pickles or onions rings with your combo meal during your next visit!

I have a larger pickup and decided that it’s time for a walk in certain areas. Love Double Star Wednesday’s rewards. Thanks Starbucks

name: Chris Choe
text:
I love this Starbucks location. The baristas are friendly and service is great. The only downside is that this location can get very busy during the work week. If you do a mobile order, the food is most likely to be prepared well before your coffee is ready, so your food may be cold by the time your entire order is ready for pickup.

If you're only ordering coffee, this shouldn't be a problem.

text: So I've had some pretty good experiences here but staff turnover is very evident. And a better job could be done on keeping the restrooms clean. The last time I visited this location, I was told by the barista to do all the add-ins myself. And he was arrogant enough to point out where it all was as if I hadn't known or seen myself. Will never return to this location. I never have an issue ordering my drink anywhere else. And I was the only one at the time ordering anything

text: On Saturday morning, I purchased a tall Veranda roast. name: Dallas Kinard
text:
OK I have a bit of a rant on this place so get ready...

After my wife and I ordered, we waited a few minutes and had our treats in hand BEFORE we were told our cost. After being told our total, I handed over my credit card and got a surprised look from the cashier. She then proceeded to tell me they are a CASH ONLY establishment (yep, in 2017 we still have one of these!). So BEWARE before coming with only plastic! Now, she did say that there was a sign on the door, which there was, but neither of us noticed it to be honest because there was other stuff to look at on the door, and also the left side of the double door was locked, so we tried that, failed to open, then tried the other side, which let us in. Now, as we are standing there, ice cream melting in hand, I ask my wife if she has cash, and of course she left her purse back at the hotel. So I told the young woman if she wouldn't mind letting me leave to go get the cash, while my wife stayed there so she knows we aren't going to rip em off. The girl frantically went back to ask her manager and got the approval. After leaving, getting the cash, driving back and paying properly, we finally were able to enjoy our evening, even though they were closing soon...I personally think they should have let us eat our ice cream and THEN leave to get the cash, but that didn't happen.

With all that said, my waffle cone WAS good and my wife enjoyed her sundae.

resp.text: I'm sorry you had a bad experience, our normal policy is to let customers enjoy their ice cream then return to pay later, most of which do not, so thank you for that. We do have many new employees and we may just have misunderstood what she was asking. We do not accept credit cards simply for the expense we would have to pay on a small $2.00 cone and many of our other non-expensive items, we would then have to raise our prices, which we do not want to do to our loyal customers. I am glad to hear your Ice Cream was good!

text: This is a fantastic Jersey Mike’s location. I’ve been here a few times over the past months and have never had anything but a great sandwich and service! I highly recommend this Jersey Mike’s restaurant location to anyone passing through this area.

name: Timothy Huff
text: Order is always correct and ready to pickup when I order online.

name: Archit Harsh
text:
Absolutely love this place!
Jersey Mike's have been kinda like an underdog for me. I have seen them from outside on numerous occasions but never got the drive to try one, but when I did, I never looked back.

They have got excellent variety of protein rich subs (hot and cold) with fast service. The subs come in regular (six inch) and giant (foot long) with variety of breads to choose from.

This has become my go-to subs place (beats subway imo) and I strongly recommend anyone who wants to try a good sub to give it a shot.

Thank me later,
Archit

name: Sean Kurth
text: As good as local places? No, what do you expect, it's still a large chain. Better than Subway? By a mile, the bread, the toppings, the unprocessed cooked-to-order meat, everything. The prices are even a little better, if you count that a 6" here is equivalent to a footlong at Subway in its ability to fill you up. The cookies and 100% gooey brownies are much better too. I got the chipotle cheesesteak with jalapeños (come at me cheesesteak purists), and while I wish it had been spicier, all of the flavors and textures were perfect. Somehow, it managed to be stuffed to bursting, with tons of sauce, yet still not messy. It's a little slow because the meat is, again, cooked to order, but it's worth the few minutes' wait, which amazingly doesn't increase during lunch hour.

name: Steve Wojtyna
text: This has been our family's to go spot for breakfast lunch and dinner.  I'm sure it's been more then 20 years. Like I've said before, nobody is perfect.  Mistakes happen service might not be on top of there game. You cant say honestly that you have never had a bad day of off one. So dont expect to never see it or experience it. I once had a bad burger at five guys.  Didnt want to go back but said I'll give it another try. And have not stopped going since.  People need to stop being so critical to think that people need to be prefect.  I can I rate based on everything that happens. They are time this restaurant struggles but they rise above and make it right.  Watching and experiencing the owners and managers walking around to check on guest is something that should be done other places.  This restaurant and there sister one Olympian have managed to keep there reviews on the good side. A few good apples but for the most part 5 stars. As far as pricing. I've seen same prices for same type of food somewhere else but it's not as much as they give you. They have a good size menu with lots of options.  Next time you have a problem please talk to them they are there to please there customers.  They want you to leave happy full and with a smile and tell there friends about it. My experience here has always been great. Lots of memories have been made.

name: James Carlson
text: I am the father of young children and this eatery provides a stress free place to eat a family dinner. The staff is proficient and I have received above average service at times. The food is excellent and the portions are adequate for a large family. I personally like the Gyro dinner. I will often get takeout pizza from Spartan's and although it is pricier than a national establishment like Papa John's and Domino's, I like supporting small businesses. All in all well worth a visit.

text: I habe been eating at Spartans for years.  The food here is usually pretty good, not made from scratch but a little better than the usual American Greek restaurant.  Very busy around dinner time and sometimes there is quite a wait for food.  The staff is friendly and it has a good atmosphere.  The reason for my 3 stars is that as of late food quality has slipped.  I usually order a chicken gyro.  One recent time I got my gyro there were only 4 cubes of chicken on it, very dissapointing.  The last two times I got chips with my gyro I got bottom of the bag basically chip crumbs with only one or two actual chips.

After we ordered we had to find someone to get our meals delivered (30 minutes).  The food was good as usual.  Waitress never came back, we went to the cashier to pay what we felt were inflated prices.  Sorry to say we won't be eating here for a long time to come.

Not a five diamond anniversary spot, but as comfortable a family hangout spot as you could hope to find.

text: They used to try when they first opened, but the last time I went in it was dark and as usual no one was at the front counter to help. (Like the last five times I have been there.) It was dark and the table area was closed off.  They used to serve salads, ice cream, sandwiches and really great potato salad, but apparently NOT anymore. I have tried to give this place several chances because this is a small town and I believe in small business, but I will not be stopping in again. Just disappointed and my three stars are for the great food they used to have.

resp.text:
Lindsy...  firstly, thank you for supporting small businesses. Unfortunately you are in the minority and is the reason you come in and can't order those amazing sandwiches, soups and salads. We have had to make cuts over the years and focus on our core products... cakes and cupcakes. This is also the reason you come in to the store, and there is no one up front. I have had to cut payroll and on most days, I am there working alone. I am sincerely sorry for your disappointment in your experiences with us.

I dont know what the future holds, but I know who holds the future. It is possible that we will add those items back someday that we had to stop offering, but if not.... I hope that when you are looking for a beautiful custom cake or delicious cupcake, you will come and see us.

It took a good 10 minutes to get to the order screen, but then we were asked to wait, probably another 5.  I should have left and gone to McDonald's across the street.  When I finally got to the pickup window, I was handed the wrong drinks and not using a mug like other Starbucks do.  I'm sure those drinks had to be re-made since we touched them during a pandemic.  We were also asked if we wanted a receipt.  I responded with "Yes, since no one has told me how much it cost. "  Clearly the 2 people working this evening are undertrained and needed help. name: Natalie Lightstone
text: Still can't dine in but that's ok; online ordering was super easy. Order was ready in 40 minutes so it's not fast, but that's typical of fry-to-order Korean chicken. The bulgogi tacos are probably the best thing on the menu. Bulgogi fried rice is also delicious. Chicken is good, but not as good as Chi McChik. The plain chicken didn't have any flavor. The radish tasted like fake sugar. The cole slaw is ok, but I liked the kimchi cole slaw better. Fries dipped in any of the sauces are good. Dumplings were crisp and flavorful. If we go back, it will definitely be for those tacos!

name: Michelle Brewer
text: Obviously the chicken is the best part of this place. I wish the boa buns came in chicken and not just pork because the pork was dry in some parts. The bulgogi fried rice isn't anything to write home about. But I'll definitely go back for the chicken.

resp.text: Michelle we appreciate you taking the time to let us know how we are doing! Thanks for stoppin’ in and grabbing some of our double-fried chicken, pork buns and bulgogi fried rice. 😊 😊

text: Quality of chicken delivered has always been positive and the soft serve they have is delicious. Some of the other side dishes however could be served at better quality. The last time I went (pre covid) the fries were served on the soggy side.

resp.text: Michael it was our pleasure to serve you 🙌 We gladly share feedback like this with our Woodbridge team so we can make your next visit worthy of 5 stars. See you again soon for more of our double-fried chicken!

name: Na Mo '96
text: Bonchon has some good chicken. If you like a nice, reasonable price for lunch-go to Bonchon!! Very good and very good!

resp.text: Na we love to hear that! We’re so glad you enjoyed our famous double-fried chicken. See you again soon 😊

name: Robert Beathea
text: I really enjoy Korean fried chicken, definitely a different experience from good ole American fried chicken which I surely love.  Bon chon is one of the better, more consistent franchises to go to.  As is the case it can go up and down on location and whose in the kitchen today.  This location is good.  So feel free to try something new or if you've had it before.. Enjoy!  I will be back soon!

resp.text: Robert we love hearing our Woodbridge location took good care of you. We always love hearing what dishes people enjoyed and the Korean fried chicken gets mentioned a lot 😋 Hope to see you again soon!

name: Faustine Zamora
text: Friendly service. Yummy chicken! Owner gives 5% off for frontline workers.

resp.text: Faustine we’re glad you had a blast at our Woodbridge location! Thanks for singing our praises about our crispy chicken and awesome service! 🍗 😋

name: shoshana pursley
text: Really yummy food and good portion sizes for good prices! We ordered a lot of food (wanted to try different things and love leftovers!) and it was very reasonable. The chicken was super crispy (even after the 15 minute drive home) and flavorful, japchae had lots of veggies, the octopus balls were tasty. The only thing I didn't love was the salmon avocado ball. It was good, just not what I was looking for. We can't wait to eat here again!!!

text: I really enjoy their soy garlic wings and pickled radishes, however the last time I went the wings were a little soggy, they stay busy but consistency is key. I’m hoping my next visit my expectations are met.

resp.text: Nadia, we take our food quality very seriously and it is great to hear feedback on where we stand. We hope you stop in and dine with us again soon!

name: Alan Denz
text:
First time visitor to this place. We ordered the soy ginger wings. The glaze on the hot wings was a perfect compliment to the crispy, juicy meat of the legs and wings.

For the main course we ordered the Bibimbop with bulgogi. It came out in a sizzling hot bowl with a fried egg on top. The bowl was hot to the point it fried the rice that was touching it offering a subtle crunch to the mixture. I would recommend this place to anyone.

resp.text:
Hi Alan,
We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed your first dining experience with us. Thank you for deciding to give us a try and for taking the time to share details about your visit. We appreciate your compliments and recommendation and look forward to serving you again soon.

text: Had the 6 wing, 3 drumstick combo. Asked for Soy garlic and spicy. There was a small mix up so the manager added 3 more sweet crunch wings. All 3 flavors are good and love how the chicken was fried hard. Now my number 1 for chicken wings.

resp.text: Hi Cris, thanks for stopping by.  Sorry about the mix up.  Glad to hear we are your No. 1 for Chicken Wings!!  Hope to see you again soon!

text: Definitely a treat. I asked an employee for opinion on a food item which put things into perspective. The employee couldn't offer an opinion because the food is "too expensive". resp.text:

We're glad to hear that dining with us is a treat and we appreciate you bringing your comments to our attention. We certainly offer our staff a discount, with a large majority choosing to eat our dishes. Rest assured we always want to take the best care of our guests and staff. We hope to see you again soon.

name: T Little
text: I love this place.  The food is always awesome and the wait staff have always been friendly and have given me awesome service.  If you decide to do take out, definitely call ahead of time and place your order as it takes them a while to prep the food.  Not sure the two dollar signs is accurate as it is definitely a little pricey--but I don't mind as this is a rare treat for me.  Get the spicy chicken and the seasoned french fries with the sirracha mayo.

resp.text: Thank you for the love, Tyler! We love hearing that our food is awesome and our staff are the best. We appreciate your great recommendations and look forward to seeing you again.

text: Not a huge place, but the potstickers and tenders are amazing. It takes a long time to cook the food, so call ahead if your getting it to go. If your dining in, get some appetizers and a drink. Definitely check them out if you like Korean fried food.

resp.text: We appreciate your kind words, Karl! We are pleased to hear you love our delicious and fresh Potstickers and Tenders! We will make sure to keep up the good work! Come back soon!

They're  are always confused about any additional questions like ,what type of sauce comes with this? What type of seafood is in your dishes labeled "seafood rice, seafood noodles, seafood____? Food is good and very reasonable.

resp.text:

Thanks for your great comments and feedback. We're glad that our food is tasty for you. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Angelica Vargas
text: Haven't had bonchon in a while so i ordered boneless wings (sweet crunchy garlic soy) and seasoned fries. Fries were good just overpriced i usually order strips (spicy and garlic)  wings were just extremely dry and tough hard like maybe its been frozen forever idk definitely not worth the price and WAIT (25M) plus the new flavor is gross tooo sweet they put a divider in my wings but the syrup from the sweet mixed in with the other flavor was just gross probably wont be back anytime soon

resp.text: We're disappointed to hear you were not satisfied with your meal. Your satisfaction means a lot to us so please reach out to us at (703) 497-9464 at your earliest convenience.

name: Kaire Caballero
text: Their portions match their prices. The food always tastes and smells fresh! The food is hot as well. I’ve come here plenty of times, I work in the shopping center where they are located. Love their spicy and garlic wings, drums and tenders. Love their bulgogi rice.

resp.text:
Hi John,
It's great to hear that our food is always delicious and our portions a terrific for you. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Steffon Cumberbatch
text: Bonchon has really figured out something magical with their chicken! Last time I went, I tried the chicken strips for the first time as I normally go for the bone-in chicken. The skin was crispy and flavorful without the meat itself losing any succulent juiciness. The portions are large and filling but the prices are fair. I accidentally ordered way more than I could eat last time I was there and I took home 2 meals worth of food! In addition to the spicy chicken tenders, I had the seafood fried rice and spicy chicken tacos. Nothing disappointed.

resp.text:
Hi Steffon,
It's fantastic to hear that our chicken is so tasty for you! We appreciate all of your great comments and look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: dONNA W
text: I felt that I needed a change of taste so I treated my granddaughter to Korean style restaurant Bonchon and it was perfect. I have been wanting to try Bimbimap. It was so delicious,  the crackling sizzling rice chocked full of vegetables and meat with a nice spicy hot Korean sauce ..... yum. My granddaughter had a scrumptious beef fried rice and my husband had a shrimp fried rice. The meal wad topped off with a chocolate yogurt iceream. The price was reasonable considering we had enough left overs for our evening meal. Our waiter was very polite, thoughtfully asking if we needed refills of ice tea or soda.  We don't usually tip over 20% however,  he was very good at attending to his customers we decided he deserved a boost of sunshine 🌞 so we were a little more generous.  This is an excellent place to enjoy something different. 😉

resp.text:
Hi Donna,
Thank you for joining us and for all of your terrific comments. It's great to hear that your meal was delicious and our staff took wonderful care of you. We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Monica Stevens
text: Everytime I eat this food I get food poison..At it last week and almost had to go to the ER..Never again..and that smell in there..OMG!!

resp.text: Hi Money, thank you for taking the time to bring this to our attention. The situation you described is not at all typical of the excellent dining experience we strive to provide. Please contact our manager at (703) 497-9464 at your earliest convenience. We'd appreciate the chance to make your next visit a positive one.

text:
We waited for so long to be attended by a waiter. Terrible service. We couldn’t even get some water.
UPDATE: Thank you very much for your response. It means a lot that you care about your client's experience. We love Bonchon Fairfax. It was our first time at the Woodbridge location. Hope we can visit another day and experience a better service.

resp.text: Hi Catalina, I'm terribly sorry for the slow service today.  I have already discussed this issue with my manager.  We had a couple of last minute large tables that came into the restaurant, the servers was a little behind.  We noticed that you waited around 8 minutes for a server to get to the booth section.  Please give me a call at (703)497-8888 and ask for Peter or the manager on duty Victor, we would like discuss what we could do to make it up to you for this incident.  Thank you and again we are very sorry for the inconvenience.

resp.text: Thanks for the wonderful review, Charles! We are thrilled to know you always enjoy our fresh food and amazing staff when you come in! Come back soon!

Spicy, sweet, savory, crunchy. It's like a little piece of heaven, if heaven were a breaded and fried chicken wing

text: I had such a great time my first visit(happyhour..), i wanted to wait on the review, and its simply, I've fallen under their slogan.  Call answered on the second ring, friendly upbeat voice, accurately called time for order readiness.  I got outta there AND THE SMELL told me i didn't get enough.  Five stars is not enough. Decor, parking, the bath room was clean, employees smiling.. Cheers

resp.text:
Hi Johnny,
We're thrilled that your first visit with us was fantastic! Thank you for all of your great comments about our staff and food! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Bob Layton
text: On a Tuesday night, eight total customers, four staff, and a to go order that was promised in twenty minutes took forty. The bibimbap (at Woodbridge) cost half again as much as it does in DC, which is crazy. And my bibimbap had romaine lettuce as an ingredient! Why?

resp.text: Bob, thanks for reaching out to us. We want all our guests to have a positive dining experience, but it sounds like we let you down. Our Manager would like to discuss your experience in more detail. Please reach out to us at (703) 497-9464. We hope to hear from you.

name: Julian Rocha
text: Really great place for Fried Chicken. They have two options: a spicy and soy garlic. Both are very tasty, but beware, the spicy is rather hot. Might be a turn off for some. I love spicy foods so this is pretty much perfect for me. The breading of the chicken has a nice crunch to it and it never gets soggy. The only thing I can really ding them on is their customer service ,which can be rather spotty at times. Sometimes you get great service, other times not so great. Other than that, this is a really great place for chicken. They do have other food options, but I have yet to try them.  I will update once I do.

4.1 Stars

Food lovely.

What we got...

Two different steak dishes. All flavors were well balanced. Not salty or too acidic.

The cheese enchilada that came with the plate was silky and delicious 😋. Simple but delicious.

Customer Service,  Excellente!

Why 4.1, based on a pet peeve 😤 of mine, no mineral water or coffee, but staff went out of the way to find a solution and we settled tea.

And second detail which needs to addressed, is the appetizer, the  Chori-Queso Guacamole was a bit blind (very short on chorizo) there were some grains here and there but if buying a dish with Chorizo in it, it should have a positive impact in the amount of the chorizo.

Return factor
100%

Hope to see more chorizo in the Chori-Queso plate.....

name: Aarti Bansal
text:
I expect better Tex-Mex from Richard Sandoval and to be on par with his DC restaurants - El Centro, Masa 14, and ToroToro. Is La Sandia the long lost cousin in Tyson's?

Although there are good happy hour deals on drinks and apps, the food is subpar and don't recommend coming here for dinner. The cheese quesadillas and corn on the cob from the Sampler were good, I wish there was a wider selection with mushrooms and other veggies incorporated into the mix. My husband enjoyed the wings and the meat dishes from the Sampler.

I was impressed with the bento box presentation of the fajitas equipped with everything I need, but the portion size was too small. I couldn't make it past 1 fajita with just a tablespoon of subpar guac. Guac is the best part! What happened to sizzling fajitas? Was looking forward to fresh, pipping hot veggies...felt jipped of the full fajita experience.

The best part of the meal was the warm tasty chips and salsa. We devoured a basket before the Sampler came! The mango mojito and margaritas were on point and thoroughly enjoyed our drinks.

A good happy hour spot for drinks and apps, but wouldn't recommend dinner. With so many options at the mall, I would explore other restaurants for a satisfied belly.

name: Daniel A
text: Great vibes and a wide range of beverages! This compass coffee has a good range of things to drink and eat at a pretty good price (especially for Arlington). It also has quite a bit of upstairs indoor seating options which makes it great for working or studying. It is a great spot for students and young people to chill and meet up!

name: Keisha Shelton
text: Very clean, relaxing and pleasant environment.. Very friendly staff as well. Never had the coffee but it is now my STOP BY spot before heading into DC from Springfield. Definitely worth the stop🙂

name: Abdulrahman
text:
When it comes to Coffee, this the place to be!

I have tried many coffee shops in Virginia and DC; Compass is by far the best in terms of the quality of the coffee!

name: Sturg E
text: Great coffee! Use their beans for brewed coffee at home every morning.

name: Andrea Za
text: Great chai latte, friendly baristas...I cant wait to return!

name: Aziz Alali
text: Wish they fully reopened again,

name: Alan Alan
text:
The baristas here are top notch. They consistently make great lattes. I’ve tried the ones in Ballston and DC but this one is always better.

The space is also bright and inviting. This is definitely my favorite coffee shop in the DMV.

name: Sean Crook
text: Finally open! Compass coffee is a real delight and a caffeine lover's paradise. Modern setting with a lot of sitting. Compass is the new go-to spot in Ballston.

name: Valtteri Tamminen
text: Best coffee in Rosslyn

name: Drew Fernandez
text: Great coffee. Quick service. Pretty good baked goods. Not much else to say. I love the cups that have a built in hot sleeve <3

name: Drew Fernandez
text: Great coffee. Quick service. Pretty good baked goods. Not much else to say. I love the cups that have a built in hot sleeve <3

name: Hannah Cason
text:
THE BEST cold brew that I have tasted in my
Life. It doesn’t have the bite like the others do and actually doesn’t taste acidic. I actually went two days in a row because I loved it so much and got the vanilla sweet cream cold brew. I can’t speak to the pastries as I didn’t try those but I’m sure they’re delish (they looked like it). The man who took my order was extremely rude and rushed me on a Saturday afternoon when there was literally no one else behind me, but I can handle his rude attitude for the amazing taste of their coffee. 😋 The people at the downtown DC location are definitely much nicer.

name: Shanna Kormanik
text: Cute coffee shop that's a great option as compared to Starbucks just down the street. This location is bigger than said Starbucks, offers private seating and has a upstairs loft. I'd recommend a visit here if you're in need of  coffee, to do some work, or for a quick get-together with a colleague, friend, etc..

name: Scott Pawlowski
text:
Love the spacious and natural light in here. Mostly corporate clientele on the weekdays and although the line might look long it moves quick. Great space to chat downstairs and upstairs has some tables to get some work done.

Wifi was fast. Baristas were friendly, and the cold brew was great! Could easily spend a few hours here!

name: William Tremml
text:
Look at bottom for Bean review!!

Ambiance: 5 Stars. This is really a perfect coffee shop to do work in, and great interior design. The tins are also aesthetic, but more about this in the bean section.

Service: 4 stars. It’s really 50/50 whether I get somebody that’s happy and excited to talk to me about the coffees available. Sometimes they can be dismissive and generally sad. For context, I usually go in around 6:30 when there is no line so I can pick out beans to take home. It’s the end of the day – you can’t expect everybody to maintain high energy. The vibe is probably different as a morning coffee shop.

Beans: 2 stars. I’ve been consistently disappointed with their beans ever since they took the “Roast Date” off their tins. Yes the tins a beautiful, but they are pushing old, oily coffee. Everything is overstocked to look beautiful, so almost nothing is fresh. The coffee is also expensive for only 12oz – you get much better value out of something like Counter Culture. They should really put the “roast date” back on the tins.

My latest bean - First Bake – was truly awful. The tin had a layer of oily sludge at the bottom because the beans were burnt to a crisp. “Dark roast” is an understatement.

Cardinal is a good medium roast – kinda hard to dial in on an espresso machine because of the oils. Since even their mediums are oily too (oils decrease as the roast gets lighter), my best guess is that they aren’t cooling the beans fast enough after the roasting process.

I’ll be looking into other roasters going forward. That being said, a great coffee shop for when you’re on the go.

text: Great upstairs seating

text: Nice place. The staff are very friendly. I recommend to visit this café to try  very delicious coffee.

text: Two-level compass coffee just a stone's throw from the Rosslyn train station. Coffee and atmosphere not quite as good as the Georgetown location. It was a bit cold inside as well.

text: I ordered a hot tea, I didn't have my glasses and so the employee helped chose the type of tea, which I thought was great customer service, it was a good place.

name: Kate Covert
text: Love the coffee, americanos, and if you're looking for something a little different, the maple latte is a not-overly-sweet option. Small space downstairs, but they also have a loft area with tables if you're looking to sit and enjoy. Thrilled they brought this D.C.-based coffee shop across the river to VA. Started by a couple military veterans, Compass offers a discount to military and first responders.

name: Eric Frederick
text: Good coffee, strong but not bitter.  Nice place in the heart of Rosslyn, fireplace ready to keep you warm in the winter.

name: Jean Johnson
text: Good service and coffee. Pleasant staff.

name: Ka K
text: Super nice coffee shop, always packed. Serves the best Nitro Cold Brew in the DC area.

name: Joseph Raczynski
text:
Creative location with lots of space upstairs. They are consistent with their brew across locations. The only issue at this location, which I'm sure they're working on is the flow of ordering - it's not the best.

Always feel free to reach out to me on Twitter @joerazz

text: Shiny new coffee bar, with shiny new baristas! Everyone is smiling and chatty, and the ( peak hours ) lines forming to test out the grinds & staff skills  point to the reputation Compass has already earned. Seating is comfortable, and the computer toting, not quite-at-work crowd have discovered the upper floor. The coffee game has officially been upped!
