text: The coffee was really good and the atmosphere was excellent if you want to relax and get some work done or just chat!

name: CT Holling
text: GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!  Very helpful and knowledgeable!

name: Scotty ST
text: I love compass and having one in Arlington has made life nearly complete to say the least. The coffee is wonderful and the atmosphere of the place is sunny and happy. Come here and stay a little bit. The upstairs is a great place for a casual meeting, off site group collaboration or just catching up with your gossipy friend. I have to say the cold brew and the colada are my favorites. The hot coffee cups are a little odd. They tend to leak easily. I think they are bio friendly but I’d highly recommend to sip the coffee faster to not experience that. The staff here are always nice and friendly. I think I might fall in love with one of the baristas. Too be continued....

text: I love their coffee, great service, and a really nice space. Perhaps a bit loud to do work, based on the acoustics, but it's a nice place to break up the workday.

name: Jonathan Dagle
text: Yes, the people are nice and service is pretty fast, but they don't seem to get the espresso right consistently. I usually expect to to It's not a stretch to say Compass rates lowest of the area's up-scale coffee-bars. Baked N Wired, Chinatown, Peregrine, The Wydown, Filter, Swings, Commonwealth, and La Columbe all consistently produce better espresso-based beverages. Today I had a cortado remade because it was watery. Very nice people happily remade it 2 time before presenting the new one. Seemed to be some trouble with the settings. Still it was at the lower end of acceptable. I guess a lot of people don't know or care what espresso is supposed be. Yes, they're nice, but considering the capital investment behind Compass, they don't get a pass.

text: Go to coffee place in Rosslyn! Best service as always. I go here often!

name: Austin Graff
text:
Compass Coffee has become the Starbucks on DC in the sense that they have one on every corner. The quality of coffee is better than Starbucks and they offer a wide range of drinks from lattes to pour overs to nitro brews. In addition, they sell pastries like muffins (their chocolate chip banana is the best), kolaches, and more.

The service is fast and this location is the biggest I've seen! It's two levels of plenty of seats from single tables to long tables. If you need a good spot to work, it's perfect. They even offer free, strong wifi!

text: Yummy coffee outstanding service

text: Spacious + good coffee.

name: Ryan Haller
text: Best coffee in Rosslyn

text: The 3 of us decided on CAVA for lunch today, not crowded at all at 2:00pm. The people behind the counter were very friendly and knowledgeable, the food was great, and the music was pretty chill! 10/10 we will be back!

text: CAVA is SO good!!!! Fresh food, quick service, and lots of topping options! Definitely one of my favorite restaurants in town. And the staff are always so kind and friendly— they make it a very welcoming environment!

text: Delicious food- the kind that you don’t feel bad about eating too much (&portions are generous!) Also GREAT customer service! Tonight Michelle made my order and I didn’t mention no hot sauce in the order so it was put on. No Problem! Michelle made a whole new order for me without thinking twice- I really appreciate the customer care and service & am excited to get to enjoy my meal sans hot sauce 😊 Cava is a go-to for my meal rotations.

Be warned, it is saucy, so don't wear white.

text: Excellent chain for healthy food. This particular facility has great staff and the place is kept neat and tidy all the time. Parking can be an issue during rush hours and the entry to the building complex is also a little tight. Other than that it is a great place to eat if you like to choose your own bowl with your own choice of meat and veggies.

name: Matthew Stromberg
text: Great salads, they always knock it out the park.

name: Mike Buccola
text:
Dubbed the "Greek Chipotle" by some, CAVA is a unique food journey waiting to be experienced. Upon first entering, you'll find restaurant with modern architecture, lots of stainless steel, and an eclectic mix of music playing. There is a bit of a learning curve with their menu for those new to Greek cuisine, but after a close study and a call to my cousin I was ready to roll (luckily they have menus right as you walk in so you can prepare yourself for what's ahead).

In a Chipotle-esque style, you order your bowl or pita and then move down the line selecting your greens and grains, your meats, your spreads and toppings, and then your dressing. The staff is more than willing to explain what you're looking at and to allow you to have a few different spreads, dips, and toppings. I also highly suggest some of the homemade seasonal juices and teas that they offer as they are pretty exquisite. I enjoyed my time here and will absolutely be back!

name: Lauren Cattley
text: Greens & grains bowl is the thing to order. Teust me ;)

text: The newest Mediterranean bowl place in town. Great food, very flavorful. I had the lamb meatballs in the saffron basmati rice bowl and a bunch of toppings. They have fresh mint at the very end of line, my recommendation is to get it on your bowl,  it adds brilliant bit of freshness to the food that elevates it. The portion sizes were really good. Enough to fill up a hungry belly. Fantastic beverages too. Sweet tea and fruit lemonades. They are not sugar free so keep that in mind while you go for refills. name: Richard Dizon
text:
Following the recent surge of trendy make-your-bowl style restaurants around the Charlottesville area (see Roots, Mezeh, etc.), a newcomer has arrived to the Barracks Rd. area! For those of you familiar with the Northern Virginia area, this is the same CAVA that you may have seen popping up in various cities. For those unfamiliar, what sets CAVA apart from the classic, well known Chipotle-style of bowls is the Mediterranean flair, featuring ingredients and flavors that might sound slightly familiar like falafel, tzatziki, spicy lamb, tahini, feta, among other things.

I had my first taste of CAVA at this restaurant roughly a week after its grand opening and was delightfully surprised to see that it wasn't too busy. Service here was fast and the people behind the glass were friendly and helpful, especially to a first timer like me. I anticipate that this place will become more popular once the school year starts, but don't expect this to get as busy as the Chipotle down the road -- it's not quite as accessible to a student bus stop.

Enjoy this place while it's still fresh!

We never said a word. Walked right to the restaurant & bought 3 ginger beers & food that was very satisfying. We value date nights, so we plan NOT to return... name: Tim Kirkpatrick
text:
TLDR = Disappointed.

Pros:
-Great location in Stonebridge.
-Pear mojito was good as usual.
-Chicken lettuce wraps were tasty as usual.

Cons: *deep breath*
-In general, I think PF Chang's as a chain has lost it's novelty in the past decade but their prices still reflect bygone expectations.
Specific to this location on 14 Oct '18:
-Took ~10 minutes to get a staff response when we walked in.
-Had a baby stroller with us and was guided to a table in the back through a gauntlet of tightly packed chairs, right past many open tables near the front.
-Malfunctioning light on the ceiling-high backlit tapestry was strobing the whole time next to our table (and across the restaurant); staff apologized but couldn't address it.
-Floor beneath table littered with food from previous patrons; staff apologized and swept upon request.
-Appetizer was taking almost 1/2 hour to come out, yet magically appeared when we asked about it.
-Restroom unkept (paper towels unstocked and trash overflowing).
-Tables and menus were both unwiped and sticky.
-Silverware was dirty with some still having chunks of food still on.

I try not to be negative w/ Google reviews but this was not a good experience; maybe an off night but without a gift card we would have left (we did after the appetizer). Hope things improve.

text: Had the no buns Turkey burger and it was pretty good. It also came with cottage cheese on the side that was pretty tasty, like way better than I expected.  The first time I came here I had the salmon salad, it wasn't bad. I liked the Turkey burger better.

name: Alex Plott
text:
Zinburger is worth a stop just for the drinks! The unique seasonal drinks are made very well and at a great price too! I had the Orchard in Thyme and it was one of the best drinks I’ve tasted.

My fiancée and I tried the double truffle fries, but it tasted more like double Parmesan than any truffle taste. We didn’t even taste any truffle. So would not recommend this appetizer if you want it for the truffle taste.

The burgers were great! They were cooked to my order and very juicy. The burgers are definitely of the “gourmet burger” type.

Overall, I’ll come back here again probably.

text: Ate lunch here.  Onion straws on burger were flour covered onions that seemed like they had been lightly sauteed.  A gross wet flour covered soggy mess.  Side fries for 2 were $5.50 and the equivalent of a fast food medium order of fries.  Burgers were flavorless.  Will not be returning.

name: Mike
text:
The server was very nice.  Pictures is the Breakfast burger which includes egg, avacado, and smoked bacon.  Fries are a'la carte, and I had them tossed in old Bay as a true Washingtonian should.  Burger, fries, beer, and tip was about $32, par for the area I guess.
Good atmosphere, will return.

name: Brent Brooks
text:
UPDATE:Tried online ordering only to show and be told it would be 30 more minutes, 70 minutes to make 3 burgers and 2 fries. When I questioned the staff I was just blown off, it I hadn't already paid online I would have walked out.
VERY DISAPPOINTING!!!Deduct 2 stars, one for inability to deliver on time and one for bad attitude from staff.

Decent burgers, the Oktoberfest burger (with a bratwurst on top of burger) was amazing. A little filling but delicious. You can't go wrong with any of the "FRY" alternatives but the zucchini fries are the BEST.

name: Douglas Baldwin
text: Actually a really good burger. Whatever they put on it, it was one of my favorite burgers ever. Nice seating by a fireplace outside. Downside is that it took 15 minutes for someone to get my drink order after I was seated. Would not recommend if you are in a hurry, but if you have time to kill, great burger!

name: Michelle N.
text: Great social vibe. Easy bar seating. Food is savory and shakes are thick and rich.

name: Tilly Lo
text: I came here for happy hour. I arrived around 5:30 and it wasn't busy. There were 8 of us at a long table by the bar by the time I arrived. Some left before I got there. I was surprised that there wasn't a waiter or waitress assign to attend to us or the bar area. We had to order drinks and food at the bar, and it took a long time for the waitress to bring the banana cream pie to me. I had to check with the bartender. The banana cream pie was delicious. The crust was crunchy and the rest just melted in my mouth. There was chunks of banana in the pie. It was bigger than I thought and it was so easy to eat the whole thing. I will probably come back and try their food and milkshakes. I was too full to eat a meal today. The bartender was responsive and she was very professional and nice. The bar was more than half full and she worked the bar and took our drinks and food orders all by herself.  Impressive. Not having a waiter/waitress assign to our table is the only complain I have from this visit.

name: Rick Prokupek
text: So.... I'm going with 4-stars because I don't really remember the food all that well. I remember I got a burger with an egg... it was delicious... but I only remember that. Now.... the shake was phenomenal. I sucked the whole thing down within minutes. They have a wonderful open atmosphere, great servers and customer service. If I lived closer, I'd be there often. You should go check this place out. I did and I don't regret it.

name: Bradley Harrison
text: Some really tasty unique burgers here! Nice selection and variety to chose from, plus our food came out pretty quick which is always a plus.

name: Patti Arnett
text: Interior and exterior portions of the restaurant are kept clean as well as the public restrooms. Burger choices are plenty, and you can truly, "have it your way," if you recognize the slogan. The food arrives hot and service is significantly better than 95% of all of the established chain restaurants that have served the same menu choice for 40+ years. The menu has an interesting array of drinks for all ages and taste buds! Make sure someone at your table order the sweet potato fries and some other person orders a popular shake for sampling.

name: Heidi Behan
text: Delicious and what a bargain - drinks, apps, and a burger for under $20 at happy hour - what a great deal!  All of their food and drinks are delicious.  You can go wrong.  Great atmosphere too - live music and comfy sofas outside, with firepits to ward off the cold.  Perfect!

name: Aivy league
text: Not only does this place serve your standard burgers, but they have specialty ones and I had their burger of the week which was like a topless bun burger in a garlicky sauce with arugula omg it was so good. They also have AMAZING milkshakes and you can even spike them (; will be back. Bri was awesome at helping decide what to eat/drink and super sweet!

name: Eunkyu Lee
text: I thought the interior is too bright, but overall it was a great experience.

name: Jasmine Majors
text: I had went to a Zin Burger years ago in Charlottesville and was so happy when I realized there was one in Springfield. What drove me to come here was the truffle fries (which I absolutely love) but I was so glad I ordered the Farm salad with champagne vinegarette. First off the dressing itself was AMAZING, but I loved that the salad had quinoa and chickpeas in it! I will definitely be back for this salad and fries again. My friends and I sat outside and the outdoor seating area was great!

name: DeShawna V
text: Very very good! Excellent service. We went around lunch and the service was fast! I thought the burger was delicious until I had my milkshake. Words can't describe how delicious it was. I dream about that milkshake...

name: K Milton
text: The food was good. My friends and I had lunch here about a month ago. The three-star rating is because we ordered two drinks a piece. Both of our second drinks were super super weak. We asked the pregnant bartender about it and she basically said tough luck. Our waitress was gracious enough to refund us and we left the water down drink on the table. Good customer service is simply topping us off with liquor vs. Brushing us off.. I'm the customer if I complain do something about it!

name: Anthony Devino
text: Very pricey for a burger.  $21 bill for their company burger, fries and an Ice Tea.  The burger had caramelized onions but combined with the burger meat it just has no real taste.  The burger Patty is a nice size.  The burger was cooked to order.  Just needed some more taste

name: Ashley Stearns
text: Great food and a great place to catch the game

name: Coty Hager
text: Amazing burgers. The food is all fresh and organic, you can tell the restaurant has a special place for good food

name: A Dé
text:
I have a designated burger spot, that is delicious and conveniently located next to my job. I'm about to abandon that spot in order to go out of my way to go to zinburger going forward.

Last night, my girl and I were served by Marcellus, and he was a cool cat. He greeted us immediately, was very efficient, and took very good care of us.

We got the crispy chicken sandwich and the Diablo burger. Both were perfect. The chicken was actually seasoned well, had flavor, and was crisped perfectly. The Diablo burger had a great amount of heat, and literally melted in your mouth. It has been a long time since I've had a burger that was both seasoned well and melted in your mouth at the same time.

The maple butter sauce that goes with the sweet potato fries is unlike anything I've had in a very long time. I will definitely go back just for the sweet potato fries and the maple butter sauce. My goal this year is to try every burger on the menu because I am confident that none of them will disappoint me.

Thanks Marcellus for making me a fan of Zinburger.

name: Tohn T
text: Great burgers and many options to choose from. Happy hour prices are good and runs longer then most of the other bars located there. Atmosphere is nice, option to sit outside at the bar but yet still have some of the AC cooling you.

name: Stephanie Gernert
text:
Don't try the happy hour... Not enough bar staff, all of our food came out barely warm since no one helped them (despite other employees clearly standing around doing nothing).  Hard to judge a place with cold food and a manager who stood around chatting to employees rather than step up and help.

EDIT:  Gave them a SECOND try.. I just love punishment!  Dropped a star in rating too.  I emailed the manager, got a great response and a gift card to use.  So we went back.  Sat at the bar, not very busy again, got drinks.  I got fries which came out hot but were severely lacking in a truffle taste.  Friend wanted to order food, asked the bartender who said she'd be right back, never came back.  Was VERY attentive to the couples who sat at the inside part of the bar and her regular next to us, but just kept speeding by us or walking the other way.  Never came back.  Couldn't use the gift card on mainly alcohol either.  She never apologized for not returning even when something was said about her not returning.  Wrote back to the manager who hasn't responded in 3 weeks.  A shame as it has potential to be an awesome place, but will most likely fail.

name: Luke
text: Staff was friendly and the space was clean with a modern and welcoming decor. Food was underwhelming and under-cooked. Ordered a medium burger that came out medium-rare, leaning toward rare and generally lacked flavor. Beyond burger was also under-cooked and bland. However, the French Fries were well done and satisfying. Overall, if you are near the mall and in the mood for a burger, you'd be better served by going to BGR in the food court.

name: Erin Aurora
text: I tried the seasonal bison burger and it was really good. The shake of the month was Nutter Butter and it was AMAZING. The chef was out and about and even refilled drinks for us, which we thought was really nice.

name: Safiya Linley
text: Delicious. Burgers cooked perfectly! Fries cooked perfectly! And dipping sauces were amazing! I will definitely come back.

name: Alexis Rivera
text: Burger were good but I would questions the cleanliness of the place. My feet were sliding on the floor and we sitting a booth. The bathroom was ehhh. Our server was kind and efficient.

name: Tim Blake
text: I've been here a number of times and it never disappoints! ZB is one of the few places that will cook a burger exactly how you order it. The fries are house made and very good.

name: Robert Sturm
text:
GREAT burger. It's a bit greasy but they are very flavorful. This place is not fast food. It's a high end burger at a high end price. I highly recommend it, except the pretzel chicken special. Stick with the burgers. Also you don't need to spend the extra money on the Kobe.
However, do try the tots, zucchini fries, or a dessert. The shakes and pies are more than enough for two people.
The only reason for the star reduction is because of the price, but if you don't want to over eat, take a date, split a burger and a couple of sides and dessert. You'll be plenty full at a good price.

name: Raquel Mathieu
text: Amazing service, burgers, and atmosphere! Tried this place out for the first time a while ago and just keep going back for more. The burgers taste fresh, made to order, and are delicious.

name: Samantha Saunders
text: Delicious burger spot! When you want a real burger this is a great spot to go

name: Allyson Henning
text:
I am still full! Burgers were great. We got the El Diablo burger and the Zinburger. Well cooked, and delicious. Only real downside was the bottom bunk got soggy real quick. We also had a chocolate malt, which didn't have enough malt in it, but we mentioned it to the server and she got it remade real quick! (thank you!) Then it was perfect!  Now it's time to waddle off to bed.

Oh just a note so you know: the burgers come with -just- the burger. Sides are extra (and sized to share).

name: toni dee
text: Updated 10/30 - must take rating diwn to 3. Just there, for 1st x, charged 1.25 for sour cream. I said something tonour mediocre waiter who said we have to pay it. What!!! I just paid 14.25 for sn everything burger and now being charged fir a condiment. And, frie order getting less and less fries. Coleslaw same issue. Servers lacking basic skills like filling water glasses. On a Friday too. Need a break from Zinburger's. Updated Review 10/17 - service needs work. Waiters need training big time. Best burgers ever. What I like the most about this restaurant is the consistency of the food. You can depend on getting the same quality of food each time. Happy hour every weekday beginning at 5 p.m. and drinks and food items are half price. Wednesday is half off a bottle of wine and you can take the bottle home if you don't finish at the restaurant. TV'S are set to sports channels and the bar is large and quite nice and open. Outside seating available with half the bar on the outside as well. Each month they have different burger or sandwich specials.  You can sign up for a Zinburger VIP card on line, present each time you go and you receive $10 off when you spend a certain amount.

name: Jack Yu
text: Interesting, good burgers. 5 or so beers on draft. Service has always been good. They have happy hour.

name: R Howell
text: Awesome first time. Turkey and beef burger was the freshest I've ever tasted. Burgers are big too. Tater tots and fries are good. Manager was very attentive and accommodating

name: Thai V.
text: Very high quality burgers here as well a nice atmosphere and staff. I do like the happy hour special on burgers and beer, you can't beat it.

name: Ben
text: Amazing food at this place.  Service was phenomenal for lunchtime.  Pricier than my normal lunch stops, but I also usually don't have food this good for lunch!

name: J - Primary - H
text:
Note ----  This Zinburger location is/was offering a 10% discount for anyone with a same day movie ticket.
....
Location  -- Attached to Springfield Town Center, with exterior access only.
....
Food -- Very good burgers.
....
Service -- Great.  We announced we had upcoming movie tickets and the team did a wonderful job facilitating a quick turnaround.
....
Atmosphere -- Clean. Open.  Uncluttered. However, Hard surfaces may be difficult for individuals with sound sensitivities.
....
Summary -- We like this Zinburger.

name: Shane Jenkins
text: Good old american burger joint. Big burgers, so so nice. Extra nice staff and plenty of space. Definitely returning here for a few more burgers. Might try something new. Well priced and excellent kids meals.

name: Ethan Jansen
text: Very interesting concept, but pulled off wonderfully. There is a huge selection of creative burgers, in addition to a rotating burger of the week, and everything I've had was delicious. Sides of loaded fries or tater tots were also wonderful. Seasonal sangrias are a great addition to the standard wine list. I do enjoy their wine flights, as it's the only place I've seen have that take on a traditionally beer-centric tasting

name: Dre
text: We sat at the bar Saturday night. We had great service !!! Bartender was honest when we asked questions and super nice! Food was awesome !!!! Burger was cooked to perfection and the chopped wedge was AMAZING!! We will definitely be going back soon :).

name: Jeremy T
text: Some of the best burgers I've had, they might be gourmet burgers. Great service too. But the fries are a bit small. It's not cheap, but the burgers taste good enough. I've gone here for lunch on weekdays a few times and there's never a wait, not sure about evenings and weekends.

name: Susan Frazier
text: Service at Zinburger is always pleasant and professional. It's a bit loud for meaningful conversation, but aside from that, the atmosphere is great for families or friends. The burgers are consistently excellent (whether on the delicious brioche rolls or lettuce wraps) and the sides and wine selection are great.

name: Jeremy Thompson
text: Good food- worst service ever. Been there like 10 times and it’s always the same. My daughter loves the place so I take her.

name: Petra Holden
text: Huge location with table service and great happy hour specials. The food is greasy and delicious, but service is not always accurate. Huge bar with seven flat screen TVs.  Easy parking in the mall lot, though it's packed on Saturday nights. Summer special is $3 meals including drink for kids! Great deal anywhere, especially here.

name: Petra Holden
text: Huge location with table service and great happy hour specials. The food is greasy and delicious, but service is not always accurate. Huge bar with seven flat screen TVs.  Easy parking in the mall lot, though it's packed on Saturday nights. Summer special is $3 meals including drink for kids! Great deal anywhere, especially here.

name: 3DaHardWayz
text: Wasn’t greeted until about 10 mins after we sat at the bar. Got water which had stuff floating in it. Didn’t complain. Ordered drinks, okay. Ordered food, waited, still waiting 4 people come in we still, they all ordered food after us and got food after us. They brought out cold fries, not no burger. I could go on. The reason for the 3 was because of the food being good. However the service sucks and to wait I’ve 50 mins for just a burger and some fries. The food being good saved this review from getting a 1 star.

name: Nicole Lopez
text: Gotta say my burger was Fantastic. It looked so good and was so juicy, I forgot to take a pic. I'll show you the next one.....only  if I can resist eating it first.  🙄😁😁

name: Jason Vaughn
text: Great burger and awesome fries. I highly recommend you get the sweet potato waffle fries. The yogurt dipping sauce was amazing!

name: Aaron Lubben
text: Pretty good burgers!  Really good wine and a wide selection.  Their beer selection is ok, at least there should be something everyone likes, but maybe not the most exotic beers.  Happy hour is from 3-6 which seemed short, but I would go back.  Not usually a wait time.

name: Andre Gutierrez
text: The el diablo burger is great!

name: Jon Han
text: Good food and good staff. Recommend their truffle fries. Delicious.

name: Wendy Nilsen
text: This is a high quality burger joint. The burgers come with a gluten free bun, as do some of the fries. Hooray for a fabulous gluten free burger!!!

name: Joseph Morgan
text: Food is good and it is a relatively nice place. I don’t know why they do it but I am not a fan of any restaurant that isn’t full and they s at you right next to someone else. I am sure it has something to do with beaut staff sections or the software but I would prefer to not sit next to people when there are dozens of tables open.

name: Ed Ford
text: Just not the same experience it once was. It is like the staff doesn't want to be there. Still have Evo #3 on tap, which is the only reason I ever go. And that isn't very often.

name: James Hawkins
text: I have never been disappointed in the quality of food here. The burgers and great and the sides are amazing. This is my go to spot when I want to grab a quick bite when I'm in the area

name: Daisy Pierce
text: Service was good but the burgers have lost quality.

name: DaFran M. Ware
text: Good burgers. The Kobe burger was good, but I'm not sure I could tell the difference from non-kobe beef. There was a mess up with my order and I didn't like the tatter tots but the management took care of it no problem.

name: Aaron Lubben
text: Pretty good burgers!  Really good wine and a wide selection.  Their beer selection is ok, at least there should be something everyone likes, but maybe not the most exotic beers.  Happy hour is from 3-6 which seemed short, but I would go back.  Not usually a wait time.

name: Tasha Nelson
text: The food was great. Service was subpar. We were constantly looking for our server. So many servers just hanging out in the back of the restaurant but yet the chef was bringing out our food.

name: Chris Spain
text:
Underwhelmed overall. The shake was really good, the fried zucchini was nice, but not very crispy (the batter isn't very good). The burger was undercooked and super greasy, the bacon on the burger was chewy and the bun was mushy from the grease and sauce. Pretty bad burger experience especially for the price. BGR Burgers is way better.

The salad and tater tots was good. The interior is nice, but service was polite but slow.

name: Dynamite Mueller
text: Great food, somewhat attentive wait staff, a bit pricey.

name: Gaynne Zimmerman
text: Excellent date night location.  Eat outside for an extra special treat.

name: Jake Artin
text: The place is nice but the food is not that special. The description of the burger in the menu is not the same as the taste.  If you like a very greasy burger than you might like to try it. There are plenty of restaurants serving great burgers in town. For the price you pay it's not that special. Also, its overpriced.  I don't recommend it.

name: Courtney Greathouse
text: Best Burgers around.  This place will blow your mind.  Great food, amazing shakes, their zuccini fries are so good, and they have a great wine list.  This is our favorite for date night!!

name: Amanda Tyner
text: The 4 stars is for the service. I give the food and shakes 5 stars. Every time we go here the service takes forever, they get something wrong, and it’s never busy when we are there so we never understand. The food is wonderful. I get the Kobe burger and we share the loaded fries. For dessert you have to try the butterfinger shake its to die for!

name: Clinton Thacker
text: Nice place to splurge ($10-$15 hamburgers) once in a while.  Food and wine is great, the place is bright and open and airy, service is good, has big screen TVs all over showing all kinds of sports

name: Constance Hamilton
text: I had the veggie burger and zucchini fries. There were very good. The server was excellent.

name: Ronnie B
text: Love Zin burger! Atmosphere and food is awesome. Truffle fries are wonderful.

name: Anitra Malone
text: Food was good restaurant style cozy.

name: Jason Brown
text: The burgers are always really good. The service up front was good. The hostess' were very friendly.

name: Joe Lopsang
text:
Great burgers. Attentive service. Class of patrons is a bit middle of road but overall good dining experience. Keep it up.

Ps I was writing this review after the burger and 5 stars. I turned to 4 stars.

name: Sean Bain
text: Great, stylish place. Food was excellent. Good children's dining options. Carb-free menu option "wedge burger" was great.

name: John Masterson
text: $5 burger during happy hour and 1/2 priced drinks and sides. My burger fell apart pretty easily, making it difficult to hold and eat. Overall for the price it was right, but for full price , I wouldn't have been impressed. Also, the beers on tap could use some updating.

name: Johnny Schmuff
text: Usually really good. I dont know if Columbus day was understaffed or what but our service was terrible. The second star was for the alright food. Prices wrong and order wrong.

name: Ethan Cooper
text:
This is the premier location to get a hamburger. My plain and simple with mushrooms and swiss cheese was extremely good.

All ingredients were clean, fresh, and delectable. I was surprised on how well the flavors were apparent. I was able to taste everything. The cheese was aged, the vegetables were nice and fresh, all near-perfect.

My only quarrel was the high prices, but that was acceptable given the circumstances.

Very enjoyable, can be pricey, but overall a very nice (and delicious) experience.

name: Lynn
text: Food was hot and fresh service was great I will be going back again which they had wings just burgers, chicken sandwiches ,shakes,fries and wine.

name: Mike McGeever
text: Zucchini fries and the Kobe burger are the way to go! Some notable specialty drinks are available as well, like the Jalapeno Margarita, Mango Mojito and the Kentucky Smash! Love this spot!

name: Richard Brown
text: Pricey but good burgers. Waitress said to ask for more thorough cooking than a normal restaurant. My wife followed that advice and got an overdone burger. I ignored the advice and was happy with mine.

name: Ovaltine Jenkins
text: Food is delicious, but good luck ever getting your order taken in an even remotely reasonable time frame.  Even when they finally do show, drink orders also take forever.  Plan on what should be an hour-long meal taking 90 to 120 minutes. I've given up on this place due to the lackluster service.

name: Mike Maxfield
text: One of our sorta regular spots. Good burgers. Love the zucchini and sweet potato fries. Great happy hour deals during the week.

name: Ivey Bedsole
text: Been here several times.  The food is always great, and the servers are nice.  My son and daughter love it, too!

name: Vanessa A
text: First time here, food was fresh and hot milk shakes are good. Just wish they didn't get rid of the cheesecake milk shake

name: Carrisa
text: I WILL NEVER EAT HERE AGAIN. 3 out of the 5 times I've been here and the customer service is terrible when the guys with the big suits are not there. The first time I went was the very first week it opened and we had to wait at the table to be served longer then 15 minutes. We had to wait longer then 20 minutes to put the order in for dessert's and then we had to wait another 15 minutes in order to get the check. WTH I ended up giving the waitress 5 dollar tip but wrote on the receipt we should not have to look for our waiter. The second time I went service was great. The third time I went we were not greeted by the hostess right at all. There were some guys that came in first and there were three hostesses at the front and they sat up there flirting with the guys, having a personal conversation and didn't even acknowledge that I was standing there. Until my face got real unpleasant. The fourth time I went service was excellent and I really liked my waitress. The fifth time which was last night was horrible. I ordered a to go meal. I came and said I would like to order to go. The hostess said you have to order at the bar. I went to the bar and I got serviced pretty fast. I ordered and then she brought me this receipt that I ordered and walked away. She didn't tell me how long the wait was going to be or that I can come back and pay. I had to wait to ask her. Then I came back and I give them that they were busy so I stood there and waited and I saw my food just sitting there. The red head supervisor came to help some people and then looked me dead in my face and walked off. So, I walked off too because I thought to myself I don't have to eat here and keep waiting here. I stood there for about 8 minutes. That's crazy and customer service needs to be much better.

name: Mike McGeever
text: Zucchini fries and the Kobe burger are the way to go! Some notable specialty drinks are available as well, like the Jalapeno Margarita, Mango Mojito and the Kentucky Smash! Love this spot!

name: YBB_ Papertrail
text: The fries we got were a little over done but this is the only visit where that happened. Burgers were awesome.

name: Robert Fein
text: Enjoy the food and shakes. However service is always questionable. I feel like my server was a bit over self medicated for work today.

name: ckernel
text: I had the Zinburger with a Kobe patty and truffle fries. While it was not the best burger I ever had, it was very good. The patty was juicy and flavor full. I paired it with the red blend wine which was also decent.

name: Bruce Lowe
text: This is my favorite place to hangout with friends, eat and enjoy their decadent shakes. No reservations needed and family friendly. You always leave full and happy.

name: Heather Kapsak
text:
The service was incredibly slow. I was with a group of 8 for dinner. The restaurant had a lot of peoole, but not super busy. We didn't even have to wait for a group of 8 walking in. Our server seemed to be new, but he also had a guy shadowing him, we assumed to help train (although that was never said to us). I ordered a vodka soda and he asked me what kind of soda. I said soda water a little surprised and he told me defensively it could have been any kind... During our whole experience food took over 30 minutes to arrive, in the 1.5-2 hours we were there we were able to flag him down once for drink refills. We got a water refill once from another server. Half of our food came out, then a few more items, but we were missing about 2-3 sides and one person's entree after everything. Our server never came over to see how everything came out, we finally got a manager to come over and told him the problem. After a few minutes, the other items came, but they brought my friend the wrong burger. At that point she was too hungry and frustrated and just ate it. We were all so frustrated at the end of the meal and just wanted to leave rather than continue drinking there.
The food was not cheap. The drinks were not cheap. I would expect better from a place like this. That being said, the food was delicious when we finally got it, although the burgers were a bit overcooked. I understand the guy was probably new, but in a restaurant that wasn't that busy, he should have had more support and the guy who was with him, presumably training him, was less than useless. I don't think any of us will be back.

name: Rachel Hudgens
text: The burgers were yummy but overpriced for what you get. You end up paying $13 for a burger that's good but nothing to brag about. The burgers don't include any sides which are an additional $5-8. Honestly, the most off putting aspect of this establishment was the service. It was not busy and the service was super slow. We were never checked back up on and there was a lot of waiting around. I ended up going to the bar and sat there for about 10 minutes without any of the bartenders even acknowledging me. Out of all the restaurants at Springfield mall this is definitely one I don't plan on returning to. Try Yard House or Chuys if you want good food and drinks.

name: Jay Soesbee
text: I like this place.  It has an original feel and menu along with tasty food.  I eat here whenever I’m at the Springfield Mall (I’m there a lot because of Dick’s and Target) and have never had a bad experience.

name: C Henrick
text: My friend took me there to say how good it was. This is my FIRST TIME to be there since I'm from Arlington downtown for many years. So, I ordered the Turkey Burger (without mayo) and grilled mushrooms topping. They're SO good, wow but they're bigger than my small mouth, ugh! I cut half of them, hee, hee, hee... After that, we got the BUTTERFINGER shake to share of us. They're so delicious, yummy! I will go there again someday when I'm in town. Ta-dah!

name: Matt Bedell
text:
As an east coast chain in a mall, I didn't have very high expectations, but it was a nice day and they have a bar that opens up to the outside, so at least the environment would be pleasant.  When in Rome, I usually order what a place is known for, so I asked for a Zinburger and fries.  The burger is on brioche (ideal burger bun) and the burger itself was very tender and juicy.  The only patty that beats this is from Ray's Hell Burger.
The zinfandel sauteed onions and cheese were an excellent compliment.  The fries weren't the best I'd ever had, but they were still good.  I had a red streak cocktail (tequila, Campari, grapefruit) which was also exceptional.

I've been back a couple times since then and have been equally pleased with the food.  It is now my go-to place for a burger when I don't want to drive to Ray's in DC.  Highly recommended.

Update: I'm still going back, and now I've been to their happy hour and consumed a milkshake (salted caramel).  The happy hour deals are good.  You can get a smaller burger, though the bun is the same size.  If I want to pick a nit, I'd say the bun should match the burger size.  Don't get me wrong, the brioche bun is the gold standard of hamburger buns, but all burgers should have a bun matching the patty size.  The milkshake I had was very good, among the best I've had in the area.  Mine was too thick to drink with a straw.  This could be good or bad depending on how you like your shakes.  It is colossal, however, and way too big to have with a meal.  I only went for a "snack" so I ordered no other food, and I still was incredibly full.  I wish they offered a smaller size for less money so I could get it with a meal or at least an appetizer.

name: erin rexford
text: Awesome food. Good price. Great service!

name: Patrick Asoegwu
text: The food was amazing, staff was really helpful, it is kinda pricey in my opinion but food was worth it

name: Amar Mahabir
text: Zin's milkshake brings this boy to the yard- and that's about it. Chicken sandwich is better than most places. Hate the fries, like the onion rings. Service is horrible. Order was wrong, tables were dirty, staff didn't care.

name: Rachel Hudgens
text: The burgers were yummy but overpriced for what you get. You end up paying $13 for a burger that's good but nothing to brag about. The burgers don't include any sides which are an additional $5-8. Honestly, the most off putting aspect of this establishment was the service. It was not busy and the service was super slow. We were never checked back up on and there was a lot of waiting around. I ended up going to the bar and sat there for about 10 minutes without any of the bartenders even acknowledging me. Out of all the restaurants at Springfield mall this is definitely one I don't plan on returning to. Try Yard House or Chuys if you want good food and drinks.

name: Karun Ozcelik
text: They have great gluten free burgers! 🙃

name: Cheryl Tischler
text: We come here at least once a month as a family, with friends or even a night out. The burgers and milkshake are great. Happy hour specials and Wine fights make it great place to hang out after work and have appetizers and a drink.

name: Al Betts
text: Ordered the Zinburger with Applewood Bacon, Zucchini Fries and the special of the day's Koren Fried Chicken. Burger and fries were good. The chicken sandwich will never be ordered again. Excellent service however.

name: Chris Walker
text: Great service with an even better menu. I would recommend the Kobe beef style burger with one of their amazing milk shakes.

name: Karen Phumisithikul
text: Delicious quality burgers with a great happy hour menu

name: Josh W
text:
Amazing grass-fed burgers and the cheese fries were great too. Our waitress was amazing but the hostesses all seemed annoyed we showed up (maybe they were just new and forgot to smile).
A little pricier than your average fare but well worth it.

name: Finis Johnson
text: Service was better than expected. The food was really good. I'd go back.

name: Mary Velazquez
text:
I enjoyed my dinner tonight. I had the grilled chicken buffalo sandwich which was good. With a side of mac and cheese....it was perfect. Cheesey and the panko crust made it perfect. I also had the blackberry lemonadr...yum! Mr had a burger and asked for it to be medium...it came out perfect. Not too many places can get that right. To top of the experience, we had Mikhail as our server.  He was kind to recommend some items and it was spot on. He was friendly but not overbearing. He noticed the little things, refills...etc.
I will be back!

name: Ashley Redman

Everyone's fries were cold. Blackened tuna cold in the middle. Mashed potatoes and gravy were lukewarm.pulled pork sandwich was barely lukewarm. Hubby was not happy at all. name: James Davenport
text: County Grill had been a staple of my family dining for several decades. Just about everyone loves their complementary cornbread muffins and the house-made honey butter. We love the brisket and wings. The house made pickles include red onion giving them a unique flavor. The brisket is tender, but doesn't have a distinctive bark like others I've had. The beer selections are always on point. I went with the Alewerks Bourbon Barrel Porter. It paired well with my brisket platter dinner. My wife had their bacon wrapped buffalo shrimp appetizer and a Caesar salad as her meal. Unfortunately her shrimp made it out 10 minutes after everyone else at the table receive their entrees. The venue has expanded in the recent past, so it can cater to parties of up to a hundred people. The bar is typically packed out on Friday and Saturday nights; just be aware the regulars can be territorial.

I knew it would be fast and good. That is what I like about these smokehouses, you can still get in when you need it.

I was hungry for some smoked meat, specifically a smoked chicken.  Been wanting to go to County Grill & Smokehouse for a while anyway so what better time than the present?

As a pit-master myself, I know how good smoked meat is suppose to be. Tender, juice and with a bold smoked flavor.  To top it off, a good sauce really sets it off.

Now County Smokehouse hit most of these characteristics. The chicken we was good and tender.  The sauce was good as well however it was nothing to brag about.

Service was Great! Practicing social distancing we were able to pull up, order, and take our food to go.

Before I go any further with a full review, I'll give them another try later.

Happy Googling.

name: Joe D
text:
I was over in Newport News last weekend helping my mother find a new car and when it was time for lunch I decided to give the Yorktown location of the County Grill a try. I've been to their Hampton location several times over the years and felt pretty good about trying out what I'm told is their original location.

We popped in around 1pm and the place was just starting to clear out a bit from their lunch crowd. There was no wait at all and we were immediately seated by the hostess. Likewise our server was there immediately to drop off menus and silverware and take our drink order. He returned a couple moments later with the drinks and a basket of corn muffins.

I ordered the Pork Shoulder BBQ Sandwich. It comes with 2 sides so I added Fries and Collards. Mom ordered the same except she had the Sweet Potato fries with her meal. After a short wait, our lunches arrived. I had warned Mom that it was going to be a lot of food and while she was expecting a big lunch she wasn't prepared for the sheer size of her sandwich.

The BBQ as always was delicious. I finished my meal, Mom ate about half of hers and boxed the rest. We also tucked the remaining corn muffins in her box. We were in and out of there in about an hour and back out to the car dealerships after that.

All in all, a great visit. Pros: Friendly, Clean, Fast Service, Great Food. Cons: None. If you're yearning for some BBQ, check them out if you're in Yorktown or Hampton.

text: For the first time i had a Ceasars salad w/ grilled chicken breast.  It was outstanding!!  My friend loves th brisket.   He orders it every time.   Always good!!

text:
There food is so delicious; even with the
the covid. I have always loved that place,
when I wanted a dinner; I go there.

name: Erich Meier
text: Great food and service.  Truly enjoyed my visit and was surprised to find good BBQ in Virginia.

name: chrystal kromidas
text: AMAZING!!! It's the best bbq spot with a menu that feeds anyone with any type of eating preferences!

name: Marjie Brown

name: Ree Cherry-Evans
text: Placed an order and arrived at the designated time, had to wait an additional 35 minutes which meant my order took me over an hour an no apology.

name: T Rowlette
text:
Selections are worth the price. Ranch dressing for the wings is indescribable.
Creamy and delicious

name: Shawn Yearton
text: Waited too long for average food that I swear was cold. Every person in my party of four had cold food. They all complained to me and asked not to return.

name: frank orris
text: Very good food the banana pudding was amazing

name: M Napier
text:
The Country Grill and Smokehouse has always delivered friendly service, a great atmosphere, and amazing food.

If you're on a low carb diet like I am, it can be a challenge because everything is cooked with sauces or breaded but OH SO GOOD.  However, you do have large salads, rib eye, tuna and veggies as sides to choose from.

The beer selection is always great and they usually have low carb options.

name: Victoria M
text: Enjoyed a delicious half chicken with mashed potatoes and vegetables. We were part of a private event function and the staff was attentive and courteous. The corn bread was nice and hot. The chicken was juicy with a good flavor (even without one of the bbq options). I also had a slice of the key lime pie which was delectable.

name: SleeperZzZ28
text: Great food, good prices. Highly recommend and would visit again.

name: Darrell Wood
text: This place was one of my favorite places to go over the past 20 years. However last week I went and it was an utter gross and disappointing venture. The staff was not being covid 19 safe by using masks appropriately especially the kitchen staff WHILE TOUCHING PEOPLES FOOD! And the pulled pork sandwich platter I ordered came out cold. The bar tender that was assisting asked me and my mother what we needed after delivering our food and I said more water, bbq sauce, and utensils. She proceeded to go to the outside patio take someone else’s drink order then go to the amber make their drinks and never bring us what we asked. Our server was nice but was very overwhelmed by the lack of support she was getting from her fellow staff. I will never go here again and if I were you I would not even tempt fate.

name: Mary Easley
text: Food was very good.  Our server did not wear her face mask properly, (she wore it under her nose).  Dead and dying flies were all along the window sills.  Light fixture hanging over table had dust and webs on it, and it was not Halloween decorations.

name: Charlene Jones
text: Alex, our server was awesome!  He made excellent menu and drink suggestions. And the banana pudding was top notched. We will definitely visit again.

name: Jai Cail
text: The only thing I say bad about this places the half a chicken is tiny like the size of a pigeon the rest of the food wonderful and the service there spot on our server tonight he was kind considerate helpful never left a glass go dry he was an excellent person

name: Ann Gi
text: The food was delicious, the staff is very friendly and helpful so the service is excellent and fast. EVA was awesome introducing us to the mimosa and margarita's bar as well as recommending food. Very knowledgeable about the menu.

name: Chris Ramsey
text: We were running late to my son's baseball practice and got the orders to go. Had a unnamed guest pay our bill no explanation. Not only the wait staff but also the Patrons are world class!

name: Lee Wolff
text: We got seated right away on a Saturday night. It was chilly at our table. Food arrived quickly. Hubby got the corner beef special. The cabbage was peppery. My roasted veggies were cold. Overall a good time. We will be back.

name: Susan Wincher
text: To make a long story short everything is freaking delicious and the service is the best. You cannot go wrong with anything you order. They're always busy so call ahead for a table.

name: Bill Fielden
text: Always a great place for good food. Great southern BBQ and the meals are large for the price. Enjoy this restaurant every time we get down to Newport News, VA.

name: Richard Abernathy
text: A local's favorite, for sure.  Good service, but considering the prices they charge, the food is just *okay* in my opinion.

name: Ricky Wamble
text: Great food, fast service, and nice portions.

name: JOHN BRANSFORD
text: Pretty Much anything cooked on WOOD makes it Awesome  .

name: Jess Hartel
text: Amazing experience and tons of great food and brews on tap!!

name: James Colligan
text: Great food, good drinks and good service...

name: Wendy Ali
text: Fiance keeps bringing me! Food always wonderful, cornbread heavenly, drinks alright! Great staff! Great atmosphere!

name: Krystina
text:
YORKTOWN STAPLE awesome cornbread muffins and (seems like) homemade butter, they make you beg though, they know they don't give enough, it's so good...also:

Tender BBQ, great sauces, tasty wings, better beer, key lime pie! Fresh salads, smoky collards, not a bad item on the menu!! Such a fun environment too, always lively, great patio...

Just go give them your money!!

name: Rebecca B-B
text:
Delicious!!! Great experience. The whole family loved it. If you are in Yorktown it’s a must stop.
Gluten Free menu available for easy ordering.

name: Robert Dillard
text: Service was friendly. The BBQ beans and collards are delicious. My only complaint is the brisket was overcooked and a little dry but based on my experience there, I feel this was probably a one off moment.

name: Karon Greene
text: They have the best banana pudding that I have ever had. If you want good food in a nice down home restaurant then this is the place. I am a  huge bread eater and I will tell you they have the best corn bread and muffins that I have ever had. They also have good salads and amazing,barbecue  sandwiches. Do not think twice about eating at the County Grill, (you will be completely satisfied  in every way )

name: Ellen3
text: Great ribs, collard greens, bbq back beans, bbq bacon shrimp skewers. But the muffins were not hot at all.

name: Minnesa Wise
text: We love this place. Service has always been timely and with a smile. The food is good and lots of options. They are kid friendly and my child loves to color on the paper on the table. They have specials throughout the week so there's always opportunity to try different things at a better price. We will be back.

name: Bonnie Nelson
text: Service was great. Had brisket,  so good and tender.

name: John P
text:
Only been twice and each time we waited over 20 minutes for a waiter.
Each time they always have forgotten drinks and food which we had to remind them about.
Don't understand when there's servers just standing around.
Had to grab chairs for our table each time also.

name: Jean Leise
text: Service was great and so is the food!

name: John Hoffman
text: Excellent bbq. Sides were delicious and good mix of sauces.

name: Andrea Johnson
text: Service and food portions were awesome

name: William Davis Jr
text: Food here is amazing. If you like authentic barbecue this is the place for you.

name: Dr. Philip Golinsky
text:
Meat loaf was amazing.  The variety of sauces, also up to par.  They were also amazing. If you like spicy, then you may be disappointed since the spicy sauce wasn't very spicy.
I've had better brisket, but it came lean, the way we asked for it.
Overall quick service, price was reasonable, and I would come back in the future.
Still the best BBQ place is smokey dreams in Greenville, SC.

name: Karen Waters
text: Fast  service, food was excellent!  Adorable decor.  Have been to Hampton location many times, discovered this one and was impressed.  Tried chicken for first time and very moist!  Front end mgr came off to ensure we were happy, friendly but not disruptive.

name: Joe Inqui
text: Great BBQ, beer, and service.  Well worth a stop!

name: Sheeda Chisman
text: There food is always delicious...my favorite there is the collard greens 😋

name: Tailored Toya
text: The chicken wings are so delicious. They are seasoned and cooked to perfection.

name: Arlon Mattison
text: fried ribs are awesome,  back loin ribs are awesome.   best smoked meat I can find round here

name: Willie Murphy
text: Bbq beans tasted like soup with barely any bbq and Ruby Tuesday has way better Ribs 💯

name: Giuseppe Di Pietro
text: Best place to eat amazing Ribs,Very good. I enjoyed very much, i also had the chicken was delicious

name: Rebecca Best
text: Went with a large group. Ambiance was cozy & felt tight yet was roomy at the same time, hard to explain. Service was quick, responsive,  helpful & friendly. One person had an issue with the special but the manager corrected it quickly. Food was overall very tasty. I had the brisket which was so tender & delicious. Everyone ordered something different of the menu& all were satisfied.

name: Judy Pine
text: The ribs are terrific!! Large portions!!

name: Howard Waxman
text: Excellent. Not sure if there has been a change in ownership but the food is still great - just a slightly different vibe to me. Love the wings and pulled pork. You must arrive very hungry! Love the sauce options.

name: Robin Ayers-Austin
text: There is no such thing as a bad meal at County Grill. Visits might be far between, but the food is always delicious; and the staff is always friendly and efficient. Today, my husband enjoyed his perfectly cooked ribeye. My beef brisket sandwich was a piled high mound of tender,  juicy goodness. Since it was New Year's Day, we both ordered their home-style collards and black eyed peas, and they did not disappoint.

name: Samantha Calver
text: Oh my Goodness!!! Why have we Not heard of this place before tonight?!! If you LOVE BBQ don't walk but run to your vehicle and go to County Grill & Smokehouse right Now!! We had a party of 8, didn't call ahead so we had to wait for a table, and I tell you what!! It was Well worth it!! (When I got my menu I thought it was a little pricy until I got my meal and changed my mind. The prices were Great for the amount of food you get.) I ordered the Mississippi Peacemaker (In which was HUGE!! A huge chunk of pork, a sausage, and lots of bacon, cheese, & fried onions, All on a bun) with slaw and beans as my sides and also ordered potato boats in which were potato skins with bacon, chilli sauce, and cheese. When my food arrived I was like "😮Wow!!!" & Yes, I definitely had to get a doggy bag! It was so Yummy-licious!!  Ace, my son, ordered a double cheeseburger with sides of fries and mac-n-cheese! He said his burger was the biggest he's ever had, the fries were really good, and he loved the mac-n-cheese. He also recommends this place. There's a bar too in which has a Great assortment of different beers on tap! The waitress was Awesome! The people were Awesome! The food was Amazing! Most definitely going back for more! You have to go!! My son, Ace and I give this place a 4 thumbs up! And give it more thumbs up but we only have 2 each 😜

name: Cody Bishop
text: Purely amazing per usual... great staff and great atmosphere

name: Shey C
text:
Double cheeseburger with fries and coleslaw - homemade pickles on the side.
Not only was the customer service excellent. But the atmosphere was warm, welcoming and food was beyond satisfying as well  as delicious. This business is a definite recommendation for its barbecue and inhouse made specials.

name: Jimmy Williams
text: Fantastic food, great staff!

name: Carla Christie
text: The service was slow even though the restaurant was empty

name: Adam Wright
text:
Top notch brisket sandwich. Loved the hot potato salad and beans too. But to me what makes a great BBQ restaurant is the sauce. And this place delivers there in a big way.
Fast efficient service too. Definitely will go back.

name: Ade Brayboy
text: Update-Tried the Southern Fried Chicken Family feast today. Wow, pleasant surprise. It was crispy, juicy, and flavorful. Great job.

name: Ant B
text: Best bbq

name: Jim Stinger
text: The food is good.

name: Miriam Gourdine
text:
ALMOST a perfect dinner
Came to this restaurant for a new years eve dinner with my family. Got there, greeted warmly, waiter was friendly, food arrived in good time, family enjoyed the entire experience.....until...it was time to pay. I paid for my family's food, left a tip on the card. I guess my tip was not what the waiter wanted and actually came back and asked if he did something wrong because the tip percentage was low. He recvd a good tip on the card and the fact that he questioned it was very surprising, rude and unprofessional. I was so taken aback by his rudeness about his tip that my family just left. I tip well and he did a great job...right up until the end. Very unfortunate as everything else was really good. :(

name: Daniel Melton
text: Fantastic food that fills you up!

name: Hovanes Egiyan
text: I went to Country Grill to watch a football game and eat some baby back ribs at around 4pm. I took a seat at the bar but the bartender did not approach me for over 15 minutes. There weren't that many people sitting at the bar, this wasn't a really busy time.  Eventually , after 20 minutes of  sitting and waiting, the bartender approached me and I got to order my food and drink. The ribs came pretty soon, but I never got asked for a second  drink. The collard greens had a big piece of bone in them, which was pretty gross, and it clearly did not look like a part of the ribs. The ribs were ok. I just ate the ribs and fries, payed for my food and left. Hopefully,  the other bartenders are better with  clients . Or maybe she just didn't like something about me.

name: Jason McConnell
text: Great food and experience. My colleague wasn't happy with the ribs, but I loved everything I had. Including our waitress. I've been here a few times 3-5 years ago on business and it's as good as I remembered.

name: Maria VAWitch
text: Fries were cold...burger was good...waitress was great!

name: Janessa Haynes
text: Food and service was great! Lots of food and options! Definitely recommend!

name: Tyanna Cherice
text: One of the best bbq restaurants in the area!! Hands down, my new go to spot. Oh, and my server was so incredible, he deserves all the tips!

name: jason scholes
text: Little pricey but well worth it. Portion sizes are good and food tastes great. The staff that i interacted with were courteous and polite. Food came out in a reasonable amount of time. Definitely worth going.

name: Sally Schwaner
text: Great food.  I had the special, steak and shrimp.  My ribeye was perfectly medium rare and delicious.  Shrimp were great.  Husband had the brisket and said it was very good.  BBQ is not served with a sauce.  There are 6 sauces to choose from on the table. The place was loud, but that's part of it's atmosphere.  Wait staff was great.  Bathrooms clean.  Fun.

name: Duane Langenfeld
text: Great food both times I've visited.  Quick.  Simply yummy.

name: Brad Richmond
text: Always outstanding! I actually had the burger last night and I was not disappointed.

name: Kevin Simon
text: Excellent service and great food thank you Country Grill & Smokehouse.

name: Brittany Key
text: Enjoyed my food but to be recommended banana pudding and be told it's the best. I was not pleased.  First of all it was warmed up which was a whole texture issue. Then had meringue on top.  No thanks. Keep that in the back. Wasted my money on that.  Great food tho. Stray from the deserts

name: Kurt
text: Extremely friendly staff that serves decent barbeque at fair prices

name: james harrison
text: pulled pork sandwich was excellent and large.

name: Liliana Camacho
text: Always very friendly and great food. Im from Texas and this place makes me feel like home.

name: Teresa Lymn
text: Server was awesome and food was great, as always!

name: Stephanie
text: Best brisket I've ever had. Even the sides were amazing. The only thing that sucked was the service was super slow. I get that it was busy but we had to wait forever for our check and had to ask for refills twice.

name: Britany Dowd
text: Great experience. Food was awesome!

name: Dib Nailbunny
text: The burgers are ok. The sauces are not spicy but they have variety. The price is fair. Good service tho.

name: Christy Jackson
text: We just went here for the second day in a row, the food is AMAZING! Yesterday was our first visit and we were blown away by the food and service...so much so that we woke up this morning talking about it and decided to go again! Whatever they are doing, I hope they never stop! This is our new go-to spot when we're hungry and want something we know won't disappoint! My husband always adds his own hot sauce and seasoning (kept in my purse at the ready!) when we go out to eat, he hasn't used it at all the last 2 days when visiting County Grill! Highly recommend to everyone!!!

name: Kyle King
text: Solid ribs, good pulled pork, ok mac & cheese, and great service.

name: Anna Davis
text: Loved it!! Alex our waiter was very attentive and kept our drinks filled!

name: Cindy Madison
text: Overall, food was good. Pulled pork portion I received had too much fat. Corn muffins were delicious! Banana pudding was awesome. Our waitress, Jessie, was terrific.  Probably won't order collards again.

name: Joel Perry
text: Never had a bad meal here.. alex our server was a awesome dude. Great place to eat.

name: markiss bess
text: definitely good tasting food

text: Good food but man the wait is LOOOOONG after you order. Need a hotel room. Its not like its crowded.

text: Never had a bad meal here.. alex our server was a awesome dude. Great place to eat.

name: Tamara Jones
text: Food was great!

name: Neal Smith
text: Huge servings! Sides were good, collard greens a bit too heavy on the vinegar for my tastes and almost half of it was stems, would not order that side again. The rest was great! Good service too!

name: Zach W
text: I have been coming here for years, there service has always been great and very polite, the food is typically quick to get to you, and the atmosphere is what you would expect from a smoke house.

name: Kelley Jacobs
text: Ate outside due to the pandemic. The food was tasty as usual and the service was good.

name: Kimberly W
text: DO NOT ORDER ONLINE. Placed order, paid online...food was to be ready in 10 minutes...arrived and been waiting for 15 minutes now. Extremely disorganized...requested refund. Lesson learned; should have went to Scoot's BBQ instead.

name: Don Forshey
text: Had a very good server.  My BBQ shrimp was pritty good.  My first time trying that.  More food than I could eat.

name: Brian Lyon
text: Awesome food

name: Di HAZE GoMEZMERIZE
text: We love our waiter CLAY!! The chicken w bacon quesadilla is so-o good! Food is always hot n fresh. Drinks are ice cold n created really well.

name: Randall Furrow
text: Great food and atmosphere.

name: Doug Hershberger
text: I've never had a bad bite of food here, their staff is amazing and they simply rock their BBQ. The warm potato salad is amazing and you have to try the banana pudding!!!!!

name: tracy the jazz lifer
text: Humongous portions, great food and ribs are fall off the bone tender generous goodness. Oh my the cornbread muffins 😍.

name: Donald Kimberlin
text: Covid-19 has had a bad effect on this place. Won't be going back til it returns to before. Pay more and get less. Sad.

name: Tink Wilds
text: The most A-MAZING hot potato salad! Its like you cant stop eating it. Perfectly seasoned, perfect potatoes. Its not your normal potato salad though. After one bite, you say ok one more bite, then you have to keep going and have another bite... i cant show a picture because I ate it all smh

name: Cathy Talley
text: Not as good as the other times I've been there. Barbeque was a little dry.

name: Charles Daniel
text: I LOVE County Grill... Especially since they up sized their dining area. Never a bad meal there, and great bar section

name: kathy holcombe
text: Food was ok. Ribs were overcooked and a bit dry. Ordered the table banana pudding..it only had 2 pieces of banana and barely any nilla wafers. A bit disappointed.  The service was great however.. that's why the 3 stars.

name: Bonnie Vosburg
text: We were a big party, there for 50th birthday celebration!  Service was great and the food was delicious!

name: Darmailya Boone
text: Get the BBQ egg roll and wings delicious 😋 !

name: Alex Hannagan
text: I've been coming here since I was a kid! The pulled pork and smoked wings are the best in the area, and the nachos have tided me over at the bar on many occasions. Just don't overdo those warm cornbread muffins because the portions for a Pick 2 or 3 are humongous. They've embraced local craft beer alongside some of the best regional/national brands. Be sure to call ahead on weekends! If there is a complaint, it's that smokers completely ruin trying to sit outside.

name: Kellymarie Robinson
text: They make the best holiday feasts

name: V.
text:
There's something for everyone here,  BBQ, chicken, ribs, steak-  even a vegetarian can get in on the sides. They have  squash mixed veggies, homemade mashed potatoes, greens, mac & cheese, warm corn muffins & more.
If you have any room left the banana pudding is crazy good!

name: Ron Smith
text: Good food and good service.

name: Karen Fischer
text: Alex was the sweetest and easiest server to have! Food and was great as usual (as the last ten years)

name: Mr Pete
text: Good Hogg

name: Vera Staffon
text: prime rib baked beans warm potato salad  was great  I couldn't eat it all next days lunch

name: Joseph Hammer
text: OMG!!! This place is great! The staff here were so awesome and professional. I literally let the waitress pick out what she would order and it came out amazing. I am from Virginia Beach area and I came this far for this place. Will definitely bring friends and family to this one again soon.

name: Bill Bieckert
text: Good

name: Sonny Oliver
text: Great dining experience. Tons of craft beers to choose from. (if you like beer) Super friendly staff, and the food is awesome. The pulled pork is really good. The rib-eye was most excellent. I hear the brisket, and BBQ shrimp are great as well.

name: Bryant Watson
text: Just an amazing experience!   Delicious food and great atmosphere... try the warm potato salad!!

name: Tiffany Finegan
text: The food and service were excellent. Easily one of the best restaurants in the area. Great specials and make sure not to pass up the cornbread with honey butter. Food came quickly and the prices were a good deal for what you got.

name: Nathan White
text: Atmosphere is great!  Service is fast and the food is great. Brisket is hot and all the sauces at the table are great!  Nice to have so many local brews available. Oh, and the cornbread! Sweet as pie and the honey butter feels just like home!

name: Linda Batt
text: County Grill & Smoke fumbled the ball with my order, BUT they made a quick recovery. Way to go County Grill. That's why we keep coming back for more. You ALWAYS show you care about us!

name: CeCe
text: Came in for a work luncheon. The service was horrible. The waitress was irritated because a colleague ordered chicken salad and the waitress thought she heard tuna. He corrected her, she argued, and the service went downhill from there. He conveniently didn't get his salad until we were almost finished eating. She wouldn't wait on our end of the table even after she made eye contact when I tried to get her attention. Very petty and unprofessional. Big contrast from the Hampton location.

name: Jeffrey Miller
text: Good food and good service. Very consistent on both.

name: Chad C
text: great food and atmosphere  you will get all your money worth,  the muffins are delicious  and the customer service was great thanks to our server Caityln

name: Hilda Jenkins
text: The corn bread is to die for

name: joshua alcodray
text: Waited an hour longer than the expected ready time, and was served raw chicken on top of that.

name: Mike Abbruscato
text:
Some of the best barbecue on the peninsula. All of their meats are amazing.  Their smoked chicken wings are unique and delicious.  Prices are great for their daily specials, but a bit on the high side otherwise.

The waitstaff has generally been very good and attentive.  Service has always been quick.  However, be prepared to wait to be seated- this place gets crowded.

name: Cheryl Sloggie
text: ❤❤👍This was a 1st. Got a starter. OMG it was so, BIG. I got the Nacho it had, cheese, meat, sauce, peppers, tomatoes, chips,   then a chunk of BBQ, then, sour cream. The flavor was kind blowing. 1 the price was unreal, 2. food you just have to go. Give them a try, you also will fall in love.

name: Joe Meadows
text: The best barbecue ribs &chicken I've eaten in a while & good service

name: Sharolyn Graybiel
text: Pick 3: sausage,  burnt ends,  and smoked wings! Favorite place is Country Grill in Hampton as the atmosphere is better.  Don't like seeing the kitchen and all the hustle at Yorktown restaurant.

name: Babbs2299
text: My experience was not very good. I ordered at Avocado BLT that came out to my table WITHOUT Avocado! They ended up bringing me a plate of avocado instead of taking the sandwich back and doing it themselves. The rest of the people in my party ordered prime rib and briskets. They were unseasoned and did not have much of a taste. I also ordered collard greens that did not have much of a taste and weren’t very good. You should pick Burger Threoy instead of this place. They have very good for a low price.

name: Karen Molloy
text: Always amazing at county grill! Definitely try the County Grill salad. You can get all the meat and feel like you are eating healthy.

name: Steven N
text: Amazing food with sufficient quantity relative to the price. Expect a wait if coming during a popular time, but service does not suffer. Food is out quite, is delicious, and the service is prompt and mindful. Great place to get together and relax with some buds as well and they have a good selection of beer to top off with as well.

name: Jon Cameron
text: You just can't get better barbeque anywhere! I had the ribs and the pork shoulder. Their pork is phenomenal! And I love the Lexington sauce! My family had been going for decades and we will continue to go. 2nd to none!

name: Nickolas Draper
text: Best BBQ in the 757

name: Ketra Honeycutt
text: Quick service & good food

name: Mike Grant
text: excellent food easy pick up

name: Tiffany Sanders
text: I've never had anything there that I havent enjoyed and I've been around 20 years. I'm not sure exactly what the difference is but for some reason I just like the Yorktown location better.

name: Katelyn Harlan
text: The food here is so delicious!  We enjoy coming on Sunday for their Bloody Mary bar and their incredible fried chicken.  Prepare for a wait during peak hours, but I promise it's worth it.

name: Dan Isaacson
text: Good food. Large portions. Mostly good service. Sweet "tea" was sugary water, and didn't refill any of the drinks.

name: chris guimond
text: Love the food and atmosphere.  The wait staff is awesome.

name: Valerie Warren
text: Really good atmosphere & good food

name: dickie wilem
text: Wilem's Plumbing, LLC highly recommends County Grill! Excellent service, where the management is serious about your satisfaction! Don't forget to try the tuna steak!

name: Ro Drop
text: Another good spot. Good food

name: Chris Smith
text: Good place to go on Friday nights for karaoke. Drinks are great.

name: Ken C
text: We had a group of 11 people and our waitress was amazing. text:
Fantastic Brisket, Pulled Pork, and Sausage.  Sides were mashed potatoes and collard greens.   Both were excellent.  I can't wait to try the chicken and ribs.  Haven't had 'que this good since I stopped at the County Line BBQ in Austin, TX.  It's a family owned business,  and they seem to really take pride in their product. As the previous poster mentioned, all six of their sauces are a little spicy (fine by me).  If I was bringing my wife along, I'd sneak in some Sonny's Sweet Sauce.  I don't normally write reviews, but the BBQ at this place really impressed me...
The next time I went, the chicken (in particular) and ribs didn't impress me.  However, I still give it 5 stars because the prices are good and the brisket is some of the best I've ever had anywhere (and believe me, I've traveled extensively and tried a lot of places)...

name: Steven Giacci
text:
Authentic Italian? Not exactly, but a really interesting blend of Italian regions from north to south with a bit of French, and a touch of American.

Pros:
Fresh, quality ingredients
Great combination of tastes
Reasonable portion size
Value vs cost is good
Service is on the upper end for the price point
Well kept and clean
Comfortably lit and easy on the eyes

Cons:
Atmosphere could use a bit more personality / romance to reflect the eclectic tastes
Italian authenticity is a little off, but the balanced tastes make you forget it
The price point could justify a small salad, but it is al la carte

Would I recommend Mangia Qui Italian Bistro to friends, yes, but I would temper expectations so they can enjoy the eclectic mix with an Italian base.

resp.text: Thanks Steven! 🙂

name: tuffy braithwaite
text:
i eat italian food all around town and this has become my number 1 spot.  few years back it was known as the Chefs Table when i first found it, great food then and it just seems to get better with each visit.

we had to go back for the short ribs last night - sat oct 24th........ribs x 2, chris tried a new dish tuna and shrimp puttanesca and E got the special on the board - Chicken Imperial - wow on both, we also shared the app. special on the board:  coconut shrimp and another bottle of ghostrunner red - thank you austin for another great dinner out....wow, i forgot the dessert special on the board:  pumpkin cheese cake......we loved it

Back once more for dinner:  Nov 28th

Back once more for dinner for 5 Feb. 20th
Ghost Runner to start
chicken noodle soup for 3  -  caesar salad for 3 - 1 Focaccia Bread
T & E shared a Chicken Marsala, C & H both had Puttanesca and i tried the nightly special:  Fried Veal with omg...........Austin took great care of the 5 of us once more.
see you soon
.

we met T & E there around 5:30 - Austin had us all set up and a bottle of ghost runner was on its way.

several specials on board, one was appetizer called:  Shrimp Bruschetta on homemade bread topped with good stuff and jumbo shrimp split....Outstanding.  T &E shared large greek salad.

the other dinner special was pan seared flounder with crabmeat:  Called it Flounder Imperial - E tried that as her dinner and yet another OMG - T and Chris got their all time favorite:  Bolognese, for me the greek salad  t&E had looked great, so i ordered a small and added grilled tuna.

we passed on dessert for once and we all carried our leftovers home.

thank you John, Cherly and Austin  - see you soon

Back Jan 16th......bottle of Ghost Rider

Chris and i shared a large greek salad, T & E shared the special app.......chicken noodle soup.  both of our choices were great.

Our many visits here Chris and T have always gotten the Fettuccine Bolognese, well it was my turn, so we ordered 3, E got the salmon and then we finished with 2 orders of the Spumoni Bomba.

see you soon Mr Austin
.

March 28th - sunday dinner for 4.

ghost runner to start, nightly app. special frutti di mare, one salmon special with shrimp, one salmon from menu and i opted for the big daddy porkchop - oh boy what a fat double bones baby it was toooo....dessert was creme brulee.
see you soon Austin.

resp.text: Thanks Tuffy!!!
